en: However, fees and other charges related to legal obligations existing at the signature of this Agreement, as referred to in Annex 3, shall continue to apply for a maximum period of ten years.
sl: Vendar se pristojbine v zvezi s pravnimi obveznostmi, ki obstajajo v času podpisa tega sporazuma, navedene v Prilogi 3, še naprej uporabljajo v obdobju največ desetih let.

en: This period may be extended by decision of the EPA Committee if this is necessary to respect these legal obligations.
sl: To obdobje se lahko z odločitvijo Odbora SGP podaljša, če je to potrebno zaradi spoštovanja navedenih pravnih obveznosti.

en: Article 12
sl: Člen 12

en: Customs duties on products originating in Ghana
sl: Carine na proizvode s poreklom iz pogodbenice Gane

en: Products originating in Ghana shall be imported in the EC Party free of customs duties, except for the products indicated, and under the conditions defined, in Annex 1.
sl: Proizvodi s poreklom iz Gane se uvozijo v pogodbenico ES prosto carin, razen proizvodov, navedenih v Prilogi 1, pod pogoji, določenimi v navedeni prilogi.

en: Article 13
sl: Člen 13

en: Customs duties on products originating in the EC Party
sl: Carine na proizvode s poreklom iz pogodbenice ES

en: Customs duties on imports into Ghana of products originating in the EC Party shall be reduced or eliminated in accordance with the schedule of tariff liberalisation in Annex 2.
sl: Carine na proizvode s poreklom iz pogodbenice ES, namenjene v Gano, se znižajo ali odpravijo v skladu s časovnim razporedom liberalizacije tarif iz Priloge 2.

en: Article 14
sl: Člen 14

en: Rules of origin
sl: Pravila o poreklu

en: For the purposes of this Chapter, ‘originating’ applies to goods fulfilling the preferential rules of origin in force on 1 January 2008 between the Parties.
sl: Za namene tega poglavja se izraz „s poreklom“ uporablja za blago, ki izpolnjuje preferencialna pravila o poreklu, ki veljajo med pogodbenicama 1. januarja 2008.

en: The Parties will establish a common and reciprocal regime governing rules of origin at the latest on 30 June 2008, that will enter into force not later than the first day of provisional application of this Agreement, based on the rules of origin as defined by the Cotonou Agreement and providing for the improvement while taking into account the development objectives of Ghana.
sl: Pogodbenici na podlagi pravil o poreklu iz Sporazuma iz Cotonouja najpozneje do 30. junija 2008 vzpostavita skupno in recipročno ureditev, ki bo začela veljati najpozneje na prvi dan začasne uporabe tega sporazuma in določala njihovo poenostavitev ob upoštevanju razvojnih ciljev Gane.

en: This new regime will be annexed to this Agreement by the EPA Committee.
sl: Odbora SGP bo to novo ureditev priložil k temu sporazumu.

en: Not later than three years after the entry into force of this Agreement, the Parties will review the provisions in force governing rules of origin with the objective to simplify the concepts and methods used to determine the origin taking into account the development objectives of Ghana.
sl: Najpozneje tri leta po začetku veljavnosti tega sporazuma pogodbenici pregledata veljavne določbe, ki urejajo pravila o poreklu, da bi poenostavili koncepte in metode, ki se uporabljajo za določitev porekla z vidika razvojnih ciljev Gane.

en: Within this revision process, the Parties will take into account technological development, production processes and any other factor including the ongoing reforms with regard to rules of origin which might require amendment of the reciprocal negotiated regime.
sl: V okviru tega pregleda pogodbenici upoštevata tehnološki razvoj, proizvodne procese in vse druge dejavnike, vključno s tekočimi reformami v zvezi s pravili o poreklu, zaradi katerih bi lahko bile potrebne spremembe dogovorjene recipročne ureditve.

en: Any amendment or replacement will be made by decision of the EPA Committee.
sl: Vse spremembe ali zamenjave se izvršijo s sklepom Odbora SGP.

en: Article 15
sl: Člen 15

en: Standstill
sl: Sedanje stanje

en: Notwithstanding Articles 23 and 24, no new customs duty on imports shall be introduced on trade between the Parties and those currently applied on trade between the Parties shall not be increased as from the date of entry into force of this Agreement.
sl: Ne glede na določbe iz členov 23 in 24 se od začetka veljavnosti tega sporazuma v trgovini med pogodbenicama ne uvajajo nove uvozne carine, že obstoječe pa se ne zvišujejo.

en: Notwithstanding paragraph 1, in the context of the finalisation of the implementation of the Economic Community of West African States (ECOWAS) common external tariff, Ghana may revise until 31 December 2011 its basic custom duties applying to goods originating in the European Community as long as the general incidence of those duties is not higher than the one of the duties specified in Annex 2.
sl: Ne glede na določbe iz odstavka 1 bo lahko Gana v okviru dokončne uvedbe skupne zunanje tarife Gospodarske skupnosti zahodnoafriških držav (ECOWAS) najpozneje do 31. decembra 2011 spremenila svoje osnovne carine, ki se uporabljajo za blago s poreklom iz Evropske skupnosti, če splošne posledice teh carin ne bodo višje od posledic carin, določenih v Prilogi 2.

en: Article 16
sl: Člen 16

en: Customs duties on exports
sl: Carine na izvoz

en: No new customs duty on exports or equivalent charges shall be introduced on trade between the Parties, nor those currently applied increased as from the date of entry into force of this Agreement.
sl: Od začetka veljavnosti tega sporazuma se v trgovini med pogodbenicama pri izvozu ne uvajajo nove carine ali dajatve z enakim učinkom, že obstoječe pa se ne zvišujejo.

en: In exceptional circumstances, if the Ghanaian Party can demonstrate specific needs in terms of revenue, protection of infant industry or environment protection, temporary customs duties on exports or equivalent charges may be introduced, and the incidence of those existing could increase, after consultation of the EC Party, on a limited number of additional goods.
sl: V izrednih okoliščinah in če pogodbenica Gana obala lahko utemelji posebne potrebe zaradi prihodkov, zaščite mlade gospodarske panoge ali varstva okolja, lahko začasno in po posvetovanju s pogodbenico ES na izvoz omejenega števila dodatnega blaga uvede carine ali dajatve z enakim učinkom ali poveča učinek obstoječih carin.

en: The Parties agree to revisit the provisions of this Article within the EPA Committee not later than three years after the date of entry into force of this Agreement, fully taking into consideration their impact on the development and economic diversification of the Ghanaian Party.
sl: Pogodbenici soglašata, da bosta ponovno pregledali določbe tega člena v okviru Odbora SGP najpozneje tri leta po začetku veljavnosti tega sporazuma ob doslednem upoštevanju njihovega vpliva na razvoj in diverzifikacijo gospodarstva pogodbenice Gane.

en: Article 17
sl: Člen 17

en: More favourable treatment resulting from free trade agreements
sl: Ugodnejše obravnave na podlagi sporazumov o prosti trgovini

en: With respect to matters covered by this Chapter, the EC Party shall accord to the Ghanaian Party any more favourable treatment applicable as a result of the EC Party becoming party to a free trade agreement with third parties after the signature of this Agreement.
sl: V zvezi z zadevami, ki jih zajema to poglavje, pogodbenica ES pogodbenici Gani prizna ugodnejšo obravnavo, ki se uporablja zaradi tega, ker pogodbenica ES po podpisu tega sporazuma postane stranka sporazuma o prosti trgovini s tretjimi strankami.

en: With respect to the matters covered by this Chapter, the Ghanaian Party shall accord to the EC Party any more favourable treatment applicable as a result of the Ghanaian Party becoming party to a free trade agreement with any major trading partner after the signature of this Agreement.
sl: V zvezi z zadevami, ki jih zajema to poglavje, pogodbenica Gana pogodbenici ES prizna ugodnejšo obravnavo, ki se uporablja zaradi tega, ker pogodbenica Gana po podpisu tega sporazuma postane stranka sporazuma o prosti trgovini s katero koli trgovinsko partnerico.

en: If the Ghanaian Party obtains from a major trading partner a substantially more favourable treatment than the one offered by the EC Party, the Parties will enter into consultations and jointly decide on the implementation of the provisions of paragraph 2.
sl: Če bi pogodbenica Gana pri velikem trgovinskem partnerju dosegla bistveno boljšo obravnavo, kot ji jo ponuja pogodbenica ES, se bosta pogodbenici posvetovali in skupaj odločili o izvajanju določb iz odstavka 2.

en: The provisions of this Chapter shall not be so construed as to oblige the Parties to extend reciprocally any preferential treatment applicable as a result of the one of them being party to a free trade agreement with third parties on the date of signature of this Agreement.
sl: Določbe tega poglavja se ne razlagajo tako, da pogodbenici zavezujejo k vzajemni razširitvi preferencialne obravnave, ki se uporablja zaradi tega, ker je katera od pogodbenic na dan podpisa tega sporazuma stranka sporazuma o prosti trgovini s tretjimi strankami.

en: For the purposes of this Article, ‘free trade agreement’ means an agreement substantially liberalising trade and providing for the absence or elimination of substantially all discrimination between or among parties thereto through the elimination of existing discriminatory measures and/or the prohibition of new or more discriminatory measures, either at the entry into force of that agreement or on the basis of a reasonable time frame.
sl: Za namene tega člena „SGP“ pomeni sporazum, ki znatno liberalizira trgovino tako, da ob začetku veljavnosti navedenega sporazuma ali v doglednem roku z neobstojem ali odpravo praktično vsega neenakopravnega razlikovanja med pogodbenicami takega sporazuma odpravi obstoječe diskriminacijske ukrepe in/ali prepove nove ali dodatne diskriminacijske ukrepe.

en: For the purposes of this Article, ‘major trading partner’ means any developed country, or any country accounting for a share of world merchandise exports above 1 percent in the year before the entry into force of the free trade agreement referred to in paragraph 2, or any group of countries acting individually, collectively or through a free trade agreement accounting collectively for a share of world merchandise exports above 1,5 percent in the year before the entry into force of the free trade agreement referred to in paragraph 2 [1].
sl: Za namene tega člena pomeni „večji trgovinski partner“ katero koli razvito državo ali katero koli državo, ki predstavlja delež svetovnega blagovnega izvoza, večji od enega (1) odstotka v letu pred začetkom veljavnosti sporazuma o prosti trgovini iz odstavka 2, ali katero koli skupino držav, ki nastopajo individualno, kolektivno ali skozi sporazum o prosti trgovini in skupaj predstavljajo delež svetovnega blagovnega izvoza, večji od enega in pol (1,5) odstotka v letu pred začetkom veljavnosti sporazuma o prosti trgovini iz odstavka 2 [1].

en: Article 18
sl: Člen 18

en: Prohibition of quantitative restrictions
sl: Prepoved količinskih omejitev

en: Notwithstanding the provisions of Articles 23, 24 and 25, all prohibitions or restrictions on import or export between the Parties, other than customs duties, taxes, fees and other charges provided for under Article 11, whether made effective through quotas, import or export licenses or other measures, shall be eliminated upon the entry into force of this Agreement.
sl: Ne glede na določbe iz členov 23, 24 in 25 se z začetkom veljavnosti tega sporazuma odpravijo vse uvozne ali izvozne prepovedi ali omejitve, ki vplivajo na trgovino med pogodbenicama, razen carin, taks, pristojbin in drugih dajatev iz člena 11, če se uveljavljajo s kvotami, uvoznimi ali izvoznimi dovoljenji ali drugimi ukrepi.

en: No new such measures shall be introduced.
sl: Ne uvedejo se nobeni novi ukrepi te vrste.

en: Article 19
sl: Člen 19

en: National treatment on internal taxation and regulation
sl: Nacionalna obravnava na področju notranjega obdavčenja in ureditve

en: Imported products originating in the other Party shall not be subject, either directly or indirectly, to internal taxes or other internal charges of any kind in excess of those applied, directly or indirectly, to like national products.
sl: Uvoz blaga s poreklom v drugi pogodbenici ni predmet neposrednih ali posrednih notranjih davkov ali katerih koli drugih vrst notranjih dajatev, višjih od tistih, ki se neposredno ali posredno uporabljajo za podobne domače proizvode.

en: Moreover, the Parties shall not otherwise apply internal taxes or other internal charges so as to afford protection to national production.
sl: Pogodbenice tudi sicer ne uporabljajo notranjih davkov ali drugih notranjih dajatev za zaščito domače proizvodnje.

en: Imported products originating in the other Party shall be accorded treatment no less favourable than that accorded to like national products in respect of all laws, regulations and requirements affecting their internal sale, offering for sale, purchase, transportation, distribution or use.
sl: Obravnava uvoženega blaga s poreklom iz druge pogodbenice ne sme biti nič manj ugodna od tiste, ki jo podobnim domačim proizvodom zagotavljajo vsi zakoni, predpisi in zahteve glede prodaje na notranjem trgu, ponudbe za prodajo, nakupa, prevoza, distribucije ali uporabe.

en: The provisions of this paragraph shall not prevent the application of differential internal transportation charges which are based exclusively on the economic operation of the means of transport and not on the nationality of the product.
sl: Določbe tega odstavka ne nasprotujejo uporabi različnih notranjih prevoznih dajatev, ki temeljijo izključno na gospodarskem izkoriščanju prevoznih sredstev in ne na izvoru proizvoda.

en: No Party shall establish or maintain any internal quantitative regulation relating to the mixture, processing or use of products in specified amounts or proportions which requires, directly or indirectly, that any specified amount or proportion of any product which is the subject of the regulation must be supplied from domestic sources.
sl: Nobena pogodbenica ne uvede ali ohranja nobenega notranjega količinskega predpisa glede mešanja, predelave ali uporabe proizvodov v določenih količinah ali razmerjih, ki neposredno ali posredno zahteva, da je treba določeno količino ali razmerje katerega koli proizvoda, za katerega velja predpis, dobaviti iz domačih virov.

en: Moreover, no Party shall otherwise apply internal quantitative regulations so as to afford protection to national production.
sl: Pogodbenice tudi sicer ne uporabljajo notranjih količinskih predpisov z namenom zaščite domače proizvodnje.

en: The provisions of this Article shall not prevent the payment of subsidies exclusively to national producers, including payments to national producers derived from the proceeds of internal taxes or charges applied consistently with the provisions of this Article and subsidies effected through governmental purchases of national products or for their benefit.
sl: Določbe tega člena ne preprečujejo plačila subvencij izključno domačim proizvajalcem, vključno s plačili domačim proizvajalcem, ki izhajajo iz prihodka od notranjih davkov ali dajatev, ki se uporabljajo skladno z določbami tega člena, in subvencij, ki se izvajajo prek vladnih odkupov domačih proizvodov ali v njihovo korist.

en: The provisions of this Article shall not apply to laws, regulations, procedures or practices governing public procurement.
sl: Določbe tega člena ne veljajo za zakone, predpise, postopke ali prakse v zvezi z javnimi naročili.

en: The provisions of this Article are without prejudice to the provisions of the Chapter of this Agreement on trade defence instruments.
sl: Določbe iz tega člena ne vplivajo na določbe poglavja tega sporazuma o instrumentih trgovinske zaščite.

en: Article 20
sl: Člen 20

en: Food security
sl: Varnost hrane

en: Where compliance with the provisions of this Agreement leads to problems with the availability of, or access to, foodstuffs or other products essential to ensure food security, and where this situation gives rise or is likely to give rise to major difficulties for the Ghanaian Party, it may take appropriate measures in accordance with the procedures laid down in Article 25.
sl: Če se izkaže, da izvajanje tega sporazuma povzroči težave z razpoložljivostjo ali dostopom do živil ali drugih proizvodov, bistvenih za zagotavljanje varnosti hrane, in če to stanje povzroči ali utegne povzročiti večje težave pogodbenici Gani, lahko ta pogodbenica sprejme ustrezne ukrepe v skladu s postopki iz člena 25.

en: Article 21
sl: Člen 21

en: Special provisions on administrative cooperation
sl: Posebne določbe o upravnem sodelovanju

en: The Parties agree that administrative cooperation is essential for the implementation and the control of the preferential treatment granted under this Title and underline their commitment to combat irregularities and fraud in customs and related matters.
sl: Pogodbenici se strinjata, da je upravno sodelovanje bistvenega pomena za izvajanje in nadzor prednostne obravnave, odobrene na podlagi tega naslova, in poudarjata svojo zavezo boju proti nepravilnostim in goljufijam v carinskih in s tem povezanih zadevah.

en: Where a Party has made a finding, on the basis of objective information, of a failure to provide administrative cooperation and/or of irregularities or fraud, the Party concerned may temporarily suspend the relevant preferential treatment of the product(s) concerned in accordance with this Article.
sl: Če pogodbenica na podlagi objektivnih informacij ugotovi, da se upravno sodelovanje ne zagotavlja in/ali se pojavljajo nepravilnosti ali goljufije, lahko zadevna pogodbenica začasno opusti preferencialno obravnavo zadevnih proizvodov v skladu s tem členom.

en: For the purpose of this Article a failure to provide administrative cooperation shall mean, inter alia:
sl: V tem členu nezagotavljanje upravnega sodelovanja med drugim pomeni:

en: a repeated failure to respect the obligations to verify the originating status of the product(s) concerned;
sl: ponavljajoče se nespoštovanje obveznosti preverjanja porekla zadevnih proizvodov;

en: a repeated refusal or undue delay in carrying out and/or communicating the results of subsequent verification of the proof of origin;
sl: stalno zavračanje ali nepotrebno odlašanje pri izvajanju in/ali sporočanju rezultatov naknadnega preverjanja dokazila o poreklu;

en: a repeated refusal or undue delay in obtaining authorisation to conduct administrative cooperation missions to verify the authenticity of documents or accuracy of information relevant to the granting of the preferential treatment in question.
sl: stalno zavračanje ali nepotrebno odlašanje pri pridobivanju pooblastil za izvajanje misij v zvezi z upravnim sodelovanjem, da bi se preverila verodostojnost dokumentov ali točnost informacij v zvezi z odobritvijo zadevne preferencialne obravnave.

en: For the purpose of this Article a finding of irregularities or fraud may be made, inter alia, where there is a rapid increase, without satisfactory explanation, in imports of goods exceeding the usual level of production and export capacity of the other Party, which is linked to objective information concerning irregularities or fraud.
sl: Za namen tega člena je nepravilnosti ali goljufije med drugim mogoče ugotoviti, kadar se uvoz blaga, ki presega običajno raven proizvodnje in izvoznih zmogljivosti druge pogodbenice, brez zadovoljive obrazložitve močno poveča in je to povezano z objektivnimi informacijami o nepravilnostih ali goljufijah.

en: The application of a temporary suspension shall be subject to the following conditions:
sl: Za uporabo začasne opustitve veljajo naslednji pogoji:

en: The Party which has made a finding, on the basis of objective information, of a failure to provide administrative cooperation and/or of irregularities or fraud shall without undue delay notify the EPA Committee of its finding together with the objective information and enter into consultations within the EPA Committee, on the basis of all relevant information and objective findings, with a view to reaching a solution acceptable to both Parties;
sl: Pogodbenica, ki na podlagi objektivnih informacij ugotovi, da se upravno sodelovanje ne zagotavlja in/ali se pojavljajo nepravilnosti ali goljufije, brez nepotrebnega odlašanja obvesti Odbor EGP o svojih ugotovitvah skupaj z objektivnimi informacijami ter na podlagi vseh ustreznih informacij in objektivnih ugotovitev začne posvetovanja v okviru Odbora EGP, da bi se sprejela rešitev, ki bo sprejemljiva za obe pogodbenici.

en: Where the Parties have entered into consultations within the EPA Committee as above and have failed to agree on an acceptable solution within three months following the notification, the Party concerned may temporarily suspend the relevant preferential treatment of the product(s) concerned.
sl: Kadar se pogodbenici posvetujeta v okviru Odbora EGP, kot je navedeno zgoraj, in se v treh mesecih po obvestilu ne dogovorita o sprejemljivi rešitvi, lahko zadevna pogodbenica začasno opusti preferencialno obravnavo zadevnih proizvodov.

en: A temporary suspension shall be notified to the EPA Committee without undue delay;
sl: O začasnih opustitvah se brez nepotrebnega odlašanja obvesti Odbor EGP.

en: Temporary suspensions under this Article shall be limited to that necessary to protect the financial interests of the Party concerned.
sl: Začasne opustitve na podlagi tega člena se omejijo le na tiste, ki so potrebne za zaščito finančnih interesov zadevne pogodbenice.

en: They shall not exceed a period of six months, which may be renewed.
sl: Ne presegajo obdobja šestih mesecev, ki se lahko podaljša.

en: Temporary suspensions shall be notified immediately after their adoption to the EPA Committee.
sl: O začasnih opustitvah se takoj po njihovem sprejetju obvesti Odbor EGP.

en: They shall be subject to periodic consultations within the EPA Committee in particular with a view to their termination as soon as the conditions for their application are no longer met.
sl: O opustitvah potekajo redna posvetovanja v okviru Odbora EGP, zlasti z namenom, da se opustitve prenehajo uporabljati takoj, ko pogoji za njihovo uporabo niso več izpolnjeni.

en: At the same time as the notification to the EPA Committee under paragraph 4(a), the Party concerned should publish a notice to importers in its Official Journal.
sl: Hkrati z obvestilom Odboru EGP iz odstavka 4(a) mora zadevna pogodbenica v svojem Uradnem listu objaviti obvestilo uvoznikom.

en: The notice to importers should indicate for the product concerned that there is a finding, on the basis of objective information, of a failure to provide administrative cooperation and/or of irregularities or fraud.
sl: V obvestilu uvoznikom je treba navesti, da je za zadevni proizvod na podlagi objektivnih informacij ugotovljeno neizvajanje upravnega sodelovanja in/ali nepravilnosti ali goljufije.

en: Article 22
sl: Člen 22

en: Management of administrative errors
sl: Obravnava upravnih napak

en: In case of error by the competent authorities in the proper management of the preferential system of export, and in particular in the application of the provisions concerning the definition of the concept of ‘originating products’ and methods of administrative cooperation, where this error leads to consequences in terms of import duties, the Party facing such consequences may request the EPA Committee to examine the possibilities of adopting all appropriate measures with a view to resolving the situation.
sl: V primeru napake pristojnih organov pri ustreznem vodenju preferencialnega sistema uvoza in zlasti pri uporabi določb v zvezi z opredelitvijo pojma „proizvodov s poreklom“ in metod upravnega sodelovanja, pri čemer zaradi te napake nastanejo posledice na področju uvoznih dajatev, lahko pogodbenica, ki se sooča s takšnimi posledicami, zaprosi Odbor EGP, da prouči možnosti za sprejetje ustreznih ukrepov za razrešitev položaja.

en: CHAPTER 2
sl: POGLAVJE 2

en: Trade defence measures
sl: Ukrepi trgovinske zaščite

en: Article 23
sl: Člen 23

en: Anti-dumping and countervailing measures
sl: Protidampinški in izravnalni ukrepi

en: Subject to the provisions of this Article, nothing in this Agreement shall prevent the EC Party or the Ghanaian Party from adopting anti-dumping or countervailing measures in accordance with the relevant WTO agreements.
sl: Ob upoštevanju določb tega člena nič v tem sporazumu pogodbenici ES ali pogodbenici Gani ne preprečuje sprejetja protidampinških ali izravnalnih ukrepov skladno z ustreznimi sporazumi STO.

en: For the purpose of this Article, origin shall be determined in accordance with the non-preferential rules of origin of the Parties.
sl: V tem sporazumu se poreklo določa v skladu z nepreferencialnimi pravili pogodbenic o poreklu.

en: Before imposing definitive anti-dumping or countervailing duties the Parties shall consider the possibility of constructive remedies as provided for in the relevant WTO agreements.
sl: Preden pogodbenici uvedeta dokončne protidampinške ali izravnalne dajatve, morata proučiti možnost konstruktivnih rešitev, opredeljenih v ustreznih sporazumih STO.

en: To this end, the Parties may hold appropriate consultations.
sl: O tem se pogodbenici lahko posvetujeta.

en: The EC Party shall notify the Ghanaian Party of the receipt of a properly documented complaint before initiating any investigation.
sl: Pogodbenica ES obvesti pogodbenico Gano o prejemu pravilno dokumentirane pritožbe še pred začetkom kakršne koli preiskave.

en: The provisions of this Article shall be applicable in all investigations initiated after this Agreement enters into force.
sl: Določbe tega člena se uporabljajo v vseh preiskavah, ki se začnejo po začetku veljavnosti tega sporazuma.

en: The provisions of this Article shall not be subject to the Dispute Settlement provisions of this Agreement.
sl: Določbe tega člena niso predmet določb o reševanju sporov iz tega sporazuma.

en: Article 24
sl: Člen 24

en: Multilateral safeguards
sl: Večstranski zaščitni ukrepi

en: Subject to the provisions of this Article, nothing in this Agreement shall prevent the Ghanaian Party and the EC Party from adopting measures in accordance with Article XIX of the GATT 1994, the WTO Agreement on Safeguards, and Article 5 of the WTO Agreement on Agriculture.
sl: Ob upoštevanju določb iz tega člena nič v tem sporazumu pogodbenici Gani ali pogodbenici ES ne more preprečiti sprejetja ukrepov v skladu s členom XIX GATT 1994, Sporazumom STO o zaščitnih ukrepih ter členom 5 Sporazuma STO o kmetijstvu.

en: Notwithstanding paragraph 1, the EC Party shall, in the light of the overall development objectives of this Agreement and the small size of the economy of Ghana, exclude imports from Ghana from any measures taken pursuant to Article XIX of the GATT 1994, the WTO Agreement on Safeguards and Article 5 of the WTO Agreement on Agriculture.
sl: Ne glede na odstavek 1 pogodbenica ES ob upoštevanju splošnih razvojnih ciljev tega sporazuma in majhnosti gospodarstva Gane izloči uvoz iz Gane iz ukrepov, sprejetih v skladu s členom XIX GATT 1994, Sporazumom STO o zaščitnih ukrepih in členom 5 Sporazuma o kmetijstvu.

en: The provisions of paragraph 2 shall apply for a period of five years, beginning on the date of entry into force of the Agreement.
sl: Določbe odstavka 2 se uporabljajo pet let, začenši z datumom začetka veljavnosti Sporazuma.

en: Not later than 120 days before the end of this period, the EPA Committee shall review the operation of those provisions in the light of the development needs of the Ghanaian Party, with a view to determining whether to extend their application for a further period.
sl: Najpozneje 120 dni pred koncem tega obdobja Odbor EPA prouči izvajanje teh določb v luči razvojnih potreb pogodbenice Gane, da ugotovi, ali naj se njihova uporaba podaljša.

en: The provisions of paragraph 1 shall not be subject to the Dispute Settlement provisions of this Agreement.
sl: Določbe odstavka 1 niso predmet določb o reševanju sporov iz tega sporazuma.

en: Article 25
sl: Člen 25

en: Bilateral safeguards
sl: Dvostranski zaščitni ukrepi

en: After having examined alternative solutions, a Party may apply safeguard measures of limited duration which derogate from the provisions of Articles 12 and 13 of Chapter 1, under the conditions and in accordance with the procedures laid down in this Article.
sl: Pogodbenica lahko po proučitvi alternativnih rešitev uporabi časovno omejene zaščitne ukrepe, ki odstopajo od določb iz členov 12 in 13 poglavja 1, pod pogoji in v skladu s postopki iz tega člena.

en: Safeguard measures referred to in paragraph 1 may be taken where a product originating in one Party is being imported into the territory of the other Party in such increased quantities and under such conditions as to cause or threaten to cause:
sl: Zaščitni ukrepi iz odstavka 1 se lahko sprejmejo, kadar se proizvod s poreklom iz ene pogodbenice uvaža na ozemlje druge pogodbenice v tako povečanih količinah in pod takimi pogoji, da to povzroči ali grozi, da bo povzročilo:

en: serious injury to the domestic industry producing like or directly competitive products in the territory of the importing Party, or
sl: resno škodo domači industriji, ki proizvaja podobne ali neposredno konkurenčne proizvode na ozemlju pogodbenice uvoznice, ali

en: disturbances in a sector of the economy, particularly where these disturbances produce major social problems, or difficulties which could bring about serious deterioration in the economic situation of the importing Party; or
sl: motnje v sektorju gospodarstva, zlasti tam, kjer te motnje povzročajo večje socialne probleme ali težave, ki bi lahko privedle do resnega poslabšanja gospodarskih razmer v pogodbenici uvoznici, ali

en: disturbances in the markets of like or directly competitive agricultural products [2] or mechanisms regulating those markets.
sl: motnje na trgih podobnih ali neposredno konkurenčnih kmetijskih proizvodov [2] ali v mehanizmih, ki te trge upravljajo.

en: Safeguard measures referred to in this Article shall not exceed what is necessary to remedy or prevent the serious injury or disturbances, as defined in paragraphs 2, 4 and 5(b).
sl: Zaščitni ukrepi iz tega člena ne smejo trajati dlje, kot je nujno za odpravo ali preprečitev resne škode ali motenj, kakor so opredeljene v odstavkih 2, 4 in 5(b).

en: Those safeguard measures of the importing Party may only consist of one or more of the following:
sl: Ti zaščitni ukrepi pogodbenice uvoznice lahko vključujejo le enega ali več naslednjih elementov:

en: suspension of the further reduction of the rate of import duty for the product concerned, as provided for under this Agreement;
sl: opustitev nadaljnjega znižanja stopnje uvozne dajatve za zadevni proizvod, kot je opredeljeno v tem sporazumu,

en: increase in the customs duty on the product concerned up to a level which does not exceed the customs duty applied to other WTO Members; and
sl: povišanje carin za zadevne proizvode do ravni, ki ne presega carine, ki se uporablja za druge članice STO, in

en: introduction of tariff quotas on the product concerned.
sl: uvedbo tarifnih kvot za zadevni proizvod.

en: Without prejudice to paragraphs 1, 2 and 3, where any product originating in Ghana is being imported in such increased quantities and under such conditions as to cause or threaten to cause one of the situations referred to under paragraph 2(a), (b) and (c) to one or several of the EC Party's outermost regions, the EC Party may take surveillance or safeguard measures limited to the region or regions concerned in accordance with the procedures laid down in paragraphs 6 to 9.
sl: Kadar se kateri koli proizvod s poreklom iz Gane uvaža v tako povečanih količinah in pod takimi pogoji, da lahko povzroči ali grozi, da bo v eni ali več najbolj oddaljenih regijah pogodbenice ES povzročil eno od situacij, navedenih v odstavku 2(a), (b) in (c), lahko pogodbenica ES brez poseganja v odstavke 1, 2 in 3 sprejme nadzorne ali zaščitne ukrepe, omejene na zadevno regijo oziroma regije, skladno s postopki iz odstavkov 6 do 9.

en: Without prejudice to paragraphs 1, 2 and 3, where any product originating in the EC Party is being imported in such increased quantities and under such conditions as to cause or threaten to cause one of the situations referred to under paragraph 2(a), (b) and (c), the Ghanaian Party may take surveillance or safeguard measures limited to its territory in accordance with the procedures laid down in paragraphs 6 to 9;
sl: Kadar se kateri koli proizvod s poreklom iz pogodbenice ES uvaža v tako povečanih količinah in pod takimi pogoji, da lahko povzroči ali grozi, da bo povzročil eno od situacij, navedenih v odstavku 2(a), (b) in (c), lahko pogodbenica Gana brez poseganja v odstavke 1, 2 in 3 sprejme nadzorne ali zaščitne ukrepe, omejene na zadevno regijo oziroma regije, skladno s postopki iz odstavkov 6 do 9.

en: The Ghanaian Party may take safeguard measures where a product originating in the EC Party as a result of the reduction of duties is being imported into its territory in such increased quantities and under such conditions as to cause or threaten to cause disturbances to an infant industry producing like or directly competitive products.
sl: Pogodbenica Gana lahko sprejme zaščitne ukrepe, kadar se proizvod s poreklom iz pogodbenice ES zaradi znižanja dajatev uvaža na njeno ozemlje v tako povečanih količinah in pod takimi pogoji, da lahko povzroči ali grozi, da bo povzročil motnje v mladi gospodarski panogi, ki proizvaja podobne ali neposredno konkurenčne proizvode.

en: Such provision is only applicable for a period of ten years from the date of entry into force of this Agreement.
sl: Taka določba se lahko uporablja le deset let od datuma začetka veljavnosti tega sporazuma.

en: Measures must be taken in accordance with the provisions of paragraphs 6 to 9.
sl: Ukrepi morajo biti sprejeti v skladu z določbami odstavkov 6 do 9.

en: However, if agreed by both Parties, this period may be extended if, despite the industrial development potential and the efforts actually undertaken, this objective has not been achieved due to the world economic situation or serious troubles affecting Ghana.
sl: Vendar se lahko ta rok s soglasjem pogodbenic podaljša, če kljub razvojnemu potencialu industrije in resničnim dejanskim prizadevanjem ta cilj ni bil dosežen, zlasti zaradi globalnega gospodarskega gibanja ali resnih težav, ki so prizadele Gano.

en: Safeguard measures referred to in this Article shall only be maintained for such a time as may be necessary to prevent or remedy serious injury or disturbances as defined in paragraphs 2, 4 and 5;
sl: Zaščitni ukrepi iz tega člena se ohranijo le toliko časa, kolikor je potrebno za preprečitev ali odpravo resne škode ali motenj, kakor so te opredeljene v odstavkih 2, 4 in 5.

en: Safeguard measures referred to in this Article shall not be applied for a period exceeding two years.
sl: Zaščitni ukrepi iz tega člena se ne uporabljajo več kot dve leti.

en: Where the circumstances warranting imposition of safeguard measures continue to exist, such measures may be extended for a further period of no more than two years.
sl: Kadar okoliščine, ki upravičujejo uvedbo zaščitnih ukrepov, še vedno obstajajo, se lahko taki ukrepi podaljšajo za nadaljnje obdobje največ dveh let.

en: Where Ghana applies a safeguard measure, or where the EC Party applies a measure limited to the territory of one or more of its outermost regions, such measure may however be applied for a period not exceeding four years and, where the circumstances warranting imposition of safeguard measures continue to exist, extended for a further period of four years;
sl: Kadar Gana uporabi zaščitni ukrep ali kadar pogodbenica ES uporabi ukrep, omejen na ozemlje ene ali več svojih najbolj oddaljenih regij, pa se tak ukrep lahko uporablja največ štiri leta, in če okoliščine, ki upravičujejo uvedbo zaščitnih ukrepov, še vedno obstajajo, se jih lahko podaljša za nadaljnja štiri leta.

en: Safeguard measures referred to in this Article that exceed one year shall contain clear elements progressively leading to the elimination of the causes and measures at the end of the set period, at the latest;
sl: Zaščitni ukrepi iz tega člena, ki veljajo več kot eno leto, morajo vsebovati jasne elemente, po katerih so vzroki in ukrepi postopoma, najpozneje pa po preteku določenega obdobja, odpravljeni.

en: Except in exceptional circumstances submitted for the approval of the EPA Committee, no safeguard measure referred to in this Article shall be applied to the import of a product that has previously been subject to such a measure, for a period of at least one year from the expiry of the measure.
sl: Razen v primeru izrednih okoliščin, ki jih mora oceniti Odbor SGP, se pri uvozu proizvoda, za katerega je pred tem veljal zaščitni ukrep, vsaj eno leto po izteku ukrepa ne sprejme nov zaščitni ukrep iz tega člena.

en: For the implementation of the above paragraphs, the following provisions shall apply:
sl: Za izvajanje zgornjih odstavkov se uporabljajo naslednje določbe:

en: Where a Party takes the view that one of the circumstances set out in paragraphs 2, 4 and/or 5 exists, it shall immediately refer the matter to the EPA Committee for examination;
sl: Kadar pogodbenica meni, da obstaja ena od okoliščin iz odstavkov 2, 4 in/ali 5, zadevo nemudoma predloži v proučitev Odboru SGP.

en: The EPA Committee may make any recommendation needed to remedy the circumstances which have arisen.
sl: Odbor SGP lahko oblikuje priporočila za odpravo nastalih okoliščin.

en: If no recommendation has been made by the EPA Committee aimed at remedying the circumstances, or no other satisfactory solution has been reached within 30 days of the matter being referred to the EPA Committee, the importing Party may adopt the appropriate measures to remedy the circumstances in accordance with this Article;
sl: Če v 30 dneh od dneva, ko je bila zadeva predložena Odboru SGP, slednji ni pripravil nobenega priporočila za popravo okoliščin ali če ni bila dosežena nobena druga zadovoljiva rešitev, lahko pogodbenica uvoznica sprejme ustrezne ukrepe za odpravo okoliščin v skladu s tem členom.

en: Before taking any measure provided for in this Article or, in the cases to which paragraph 8 applies, as soon as possible, Ghana shall supply the EPA Committee with all relevant information required for a thorough examination of the situation, with a view to seeking a solution acceptable to the Parties concerned;
sl: Gana še pred sprejetjem katerega koli ukrepa, predvidenega v tem členu, oziroma v primerih, za katere se uporablja odstavek 8 tega člena, čim prej Odboru SGP predloži vse ustrezne informacije, potrebne za temeljito proučitev položaja, z namenom, da se za zadevne pogodbenice poišče sprejemljiva rešitev.

en: In the selection of safeguard measures pursuant to this Article, priority must be given to those which permit to correct efficiently and quickly the problem in question while disturbing to the least extent possible the good operation of this Agreement;
sl: Pri izbiri zaščitnih ukrepov v skladu s tem členom je treba dati prednost tistim, ki omogočajo učinkovito in hitro odpravo problema, ob tem da kar v najmanjši meri motijo dobro delovanje tega sporazuma.

en: Any safeguard measure taken pursuant to this Article shall be notified immediately to the EPA Committee and shall be the subject of periodic consultations within that body, particularly with a view to establishing a timetable for their abolition as soon as circumstances permit.
sl: Vsak zaščitni ukrep, sprejet v skladu s tem členom, se takoj sporoči Odboru SGP, v katerem o njem redno potekajo posvetovanja, da se predvsem določi časovni razpored za njegovo odpravo, takoj ko okoliščine to dopuščajo.

en: Where exceptional circumstances require immediate action, the importing Party concerned, whether the EC Party or the Ghanaian Party as the case may be, may take the measures provided for in paragraphs 3, 4 and/or 5 on a provisional basis without complying with the requirements of paragraph 7.
sl: Kadar izredne okoliščine zahtevajo takojšnje ukrepanje, lahko zadevna pogodbenica uvoznica – pogodbenica ES ali pogodbenica Gana – sprejme začasne ukrepe, predvidene v odstavkih 3, 4 in/ali 5, ne da bi izpolnila zahteve iz odstavka 7.

en: Such action may be taken for a maximum period of 180 days where measures are taken by the EC Party and 200 days where measures are taken by the Ghanaian Party, or where measures taken by the EC Party are limited to the territory of one or more of its outermost regions.
sl: Taki ukrepi lahko trajajo največ 180 dni, kadar jih sprejme pogodbenica ES, in 200 dni, kadar jih sprejme pogodbenica Gana ali kadar so ukrepi, ki jih sprejme pogodbenica ES, omejeni na ozemlje ene ali več njenih najbolj oddaljenih regij.

en: The duration of any such provisional measure shall be counted as a part of the initial period and any extension referred to in paragraph 6.
sl: Trajanje katerega koli začasnega ukrepa se šteje kot del začetnega obdobja in kakršnega koli podaljšanja, na katero se nanaša odstavek 6.

en: In the taking of such provisional measures, the interest of all Parties involved shall be taken into account.
sl: Pri sprejemanju takih začasnih ukrepov se upoštevajo interesi vseh udeleženih strank.

en: The importing Party concerned shall inform the other Party concerned and it shall immediately refer the matter to the EPA Committee for examination.
sl: Zadevna pogodbenica uvoznica obvesti drugo zadevno pogodbenico ter zadevo nemudoma predloži v proučitev Odboru SGP.

en: If an importing Party subjects imports of a product to an administrative procedure having as its purpose the rapid provision of information on the trend of trade flows liable to give rise to the problems referred to in this Article, it shall inform the EPA Committee without delay.
sl: Če pogodbenica uvoznica pri uvozu proizvoda uporablja upravni postopek, katerega namen je hitro zagotoviti informacije o gibanju trgovinskih tokov, ki bi lahko povzročili težave iz tega člena, o tem nemudoma obvesti Odbor SGP.

en: The WTO Agreements shall not be invoked to preclude a Party from adopting safeguard measures in conformity with this Article.
sl: Sporazum o STO se ne uporabi za to, da bi se pogodbenici preprečilo sprejetje zaščitnih ukrepov v skladu z določbami iz tega člena.

en: Article 26
sl: Člen 26

en: Cooperation
sl: Sodelovanje

en: The Parties recognise the importance of cooperation in the field of trade defence measures.
sl: Pogodbenici priznavata pomen sodelovanja na področju ukrepov trgovinske zaščite.

en: The Parties agree to cooperate, in accordance with the provisions of Article 4, including by facilitating assistance measures, notably in the following fields:
sl: Pogodbenici soglašata, da bosta sodelovali v skladu z določbami člena 4, vključno z omogočanjem ukrepov pomoči, zlasti na naslednjih področjih:

en: development of regulation and institutions to ensure trade defence;
sl: razvoj regulacije in institucij za zagotavljanje trgovinske zaščite;

en: capacity building for the use of trade defence measures provided for by the present Agreement.
sl: razvoj zmožnosti za uporabo ukrepov trgovinske zaščite, predvidenih v tem sporazumu.

en: CHAPTER 3
sl: POGLAVJE 3

en: Customs and trade facilitation
sl: Olajševanje carine in trgovine

en: Article 27
sl: Člen 27

en: The Parties acknowledge the importance of customs and trade facilitation matters in the evolving global trading environment.
sl: Pogodbenici priznavata pomen olajševanja carine in trgovine v razvijajočem se globalnem trgovinskem okolju.

en: The Parties agree to reinforce cooperation in this area with a view to ensuring that the relevant legislation and procedures, as well as the administrative capacity of the relevant administrations, fulfil the objectives of effective control and the promotion of trade facilitation, and help promote the development and regional integration of signatory countries.
sl: Pogodbenice soglašajo, da na tem področju okrepijo sodelovanje z namenom zagotoviti, da ustrezna zakonodaja in postopki ter tudi upravna usposobljenost ustreznih uprav izpolnjujejo cilje učinkovitega nadzora in spodbujanja olajševanja trgovine, ter da pomagajo spodbujati razvoj in regionalno povezovanje držav podpisnic.

en: The Parties recognise that legitimate public policy objectives, including in relation to security and the prevention of fraud, shall not be compromised in any way.
sl: Pogodbenici soglašata, da legitimni cilji javne politike, vključno s tistimi, ki zadevajo varnost in preprečevanje goljufij, nikakor ne bodo ogroženi.

en: The Parties undertake to ensure the free circulation of goods covered by this Agreement, within their respective territories.
sl: Pogodbenici se zavezujeta, da bosta na svojih ozemljih zagotavljali prost pretok blaga, ki ga zajema ta sporazum.

en: Article 28
sl: Člen 28

en: Customs and administrative cooperation
sl: Carinsko in upravno sodelovanje

en: In order to ensure compliance with the provisions of this Title, and effectively to respond to the objectives laid down in Article 27, the Parties shall:
sl: Za zagotovitev skladnosti z določbami tega naslova in učinkovitega odziva na cilje iz člena 27 pogodbenici:

en: exchange information concerning customs legislation and procedures;
sl: izmenjata informacije o zakonodaji in carinskih postopkih;

en: develop joint initiatives relating to import, export and transit procedures, as well as towards ensuring an effective service to the business community;
sl: oblikujeta skupne pobude o uvoznih in izvoznih postopkih ter postopkih tranzita ter pobude za zagotovitev učinkovitih storitev poslovni skupnosti;

en: cooperate on the automation of customs and other trade procedures and collaborate, where appropriate towards the establishment of common standards for the exchange of data;
sl: sodelujeta pri avtomatizaciji carinskih in drugih trgovinskih postopkov ter si po potrebi prizadevata oblikovati skupne standarde za izmenjavo podatkov;

en: establish as far as possible, common positions in international organisations in the field of customs such as the WTO, the World Customs Organization (WCO), the United Nations (UN) and the United Nations Conference on Trade and Development (UNCTAD);
sl: kolikor je to mogoče, vzpostavita skupna stališča v mednarodnih organizacijah na področju carine, kot so STO, Svetovna carinska organizacija (WCO), Organizacija združenih narodov (ZN) in Konferenca združenih narodov o trgovini in razvoju (UNCTAD);

en: cooperate in the planning and delivery of technical assistance, notably to facilitate customs and Trade Facilitation reforms in line with the provisions of this Agreement; and
sl: sodelujeta pri načrtovanju in izvajanju tehnične pomoči, zlasti za olajševanje carinskih reform in reform za olajševanje trgovine v skladu z določbami tega sporazuma, in

en: promote coordination between all related agencies, both internally and across borders.
sl: spodbujajo usklajevanje med vsemi sorodnimi agencijami na interni in čezmejni ravni.

en: Notwithstanding paragraph 1, the administrations of both Parties shall provide mutual administrative assistance in customs matters in accordance with the provisions of Protocol on mutual administrative assistance in customs matters.
sl: Ne glede na odstavek 1 si uprave pogodbenic zagotavljajo medsebojno upravno pomoč v carinskih zadevah v skladu z določbami Protokola o medsebojni upravni pomoči v carinskih zadevah.

en: Article 29
sl: Člen 29

en: Customs legislation and procedures
sl: Zakonodaja in carinski postopki

en: The Parties agree that their respective trade and customs legislation, provisions and procedures shall be based upon the international instruments and standards applicable in the field of customs and trade, including the substantive elements of the revised Kyoto Convention on the simplification and harmonisation of customs procedures, the WCO Framework of Standards to Secure and Facilitate Global Trade, the WCO data set and the Harmonised Commodity Description and Coding System (‘HS’).
sl: Pogodbenici soglašata, da njuna trgovinska in carinska zakonodaja, njune določbe in postopki temeljijo na mednarodnih instrumentih in standardih, ki veljajo na področju carine in trgovine, vključno na temeljnih elementih revidirane Kjotske konvencije o poenostavitvi in uskladitvi carinskih postopkov, Okvira WCO o standardih za zaščito in pospeševanje svetovne trgovine, carinskega podatkovnega modela WCO in Konvencije o usklajenem sistemu poimenovanj in šifrskih oznak proizvodov („HS“).

en: The Parties shall ensure freedom of transit through their territory via the route most convenient for transit.
sl: Pogodbenici si zagotovita prosti tranzit čez njuno ozemlje po poti, najprimernejši za tranzit.

en: Any restrictions, controls or requirements must pursue a legitimate public policy objective, be non-discriminatory, be proportionate and be applied uniformly.
sl: Omejitve, nadzor ali zahteve morajo temeljiti na legitimnem cilju javne politike, biti nediskriminacijske in sorazmerne ter se enotno uporabljati.

en: Without prejudice to legitimate customs control and supervision of goods in transit, the Parties shall accord to traffic in transit to or from the territory of any Party, treatment not less favourable than that accorded to domestic goods, exports and imports, and their movement.
sl: Brez poseganja v izvajanje legitimnega carinskega nadzora pogodbenici proizvodom v tranzitu, namenjenim v drugo pogodbenico ali s poreklom iz druge pogodbenice, odobrita obravnavo, ki ni manj ugodna od obravnave proizvodov domače proizvodnje, pri izvozu in uvozu proizvodov ter njihovem gibanju.

en: The Parties shall operate bonded transport regimes that allow the transit of goods without payment of customs duties or other charges subject to the provision of an appropriate guarantee.
sl: Pogodbenici izvajata postopke prevoza pod carinskim nadzorom, ki omogočajo tranzit proizvodov brez plačila carin ali drugih dajatev, če so zagotovljena ustrezna jamstva.

en: The Parties shall promote and implement regional transit arrangements with a view to reducing trade barriers.
sl: Pogodbenici si prizadevata spodbujati in izvajati ureditve regionalnega tranzita, da bi zmanjšale trgovinske ovire.

en: The Parties shall draw upon and use international standards and instruments relevant to transit.
sl: Pogodbenici črpata iz mednarodnih standardov in instrumentov v zvezi s tranzitom.

en: The Parties shall ensure cooperation and coordination between all concerned authorities and agencies in their territory to facilitate traffic in transit and promote cooperation across borders.
sl: Pogodbenici zagotavljata sodelovanje in usklajevanje vseh zadevnih organov in agencij na svojem ozemlju za olajševanje prevoza v tranzitu in spodbujanje čezmejnega sodelovanja.

en: In order to improve working methods, as well as to ensure non-discrimination, transparency, efficiency, integrity and accountability of operations, the Parties shall:
sl: Za izboljšanje delovnih metod in zagotovitev nediskriminacije, preglednosti, učinkovitosti, neoporečnosti in odgovornosti postopkov se pogodbenici zavezujeta, da bosta:

en: take further steps towards the reduction, simplification and standardisation of data and documentation required by customs and other agencies;
sl: sprejeli nadaljnje korake za zmanjšanje, poenostavitev in standardizacijo podatkov in dokumentacije, ki jih potrebujejo carinske in druge agencije;

en: simplify requirements and formalities wherever possible, in respect of the rapid release and clearance of goods;
sl: poenostavili, kjer je to mogoče, zahteve in formalnosti v zvezi s hitro prepustitvijo in carinjenjem blaga;

en: ensure that the highest standards of integrity be maintained, through the application of measures reflecting the principles of the relevant international conventions and instruments in this field.
sl: zagotovili vzdrževanje najvišjih standardov neoporečnosti z uporabo ukrepov, ki odražajo načela ustreznih mednarodnih konvencij in instrumentov na tem področju.

en: Article 30
sl: Člen 30

en: to ensure that all legislation, procedures and fees and charges are made publicly available, as far as possible through electronic means, together with the justification for them;
sl: zagotovita, da so vsa zakonodaja, postopki, pristojbine in dajatve javno dostopni, po možnosti prek elektronskih medijev, kar velja tudi za njihove utemeljitve;

en: on the need for timely and regular consultation with trade representatives on legislative proposals and procedures related to customs and trade issues.
sl: se je treba s trgovinskimi predstavniki pravočasno in redno posvetovati o oblikovanju zakonodajnih predlogov in postopkov o carinskih vprašanjih in trgovini.

en: To this end, appropriate and regular consultation mechanisms between administrations and the business community, shall be established by each Party;
sl: Zato vsaka pogodbenica vzpostavi ustrezne mehanizme za redno posvetovanje med upravami in poslovno skupnostjo;

en: there should be a reasonable time period between the publication of new or amended legislation, procedures and fees or charges and their entry into force.
sl: mora preteči razumno obdobje med objavo in začetkom veljavnosti nove ali spremenjene zakonodaje, postopkov in pristojbin ali drugih dajatev.

en: The Parties shall make publicly available relevant notices of an administrative nature, including agency requirements and entry procedures, hours of operation and operating procedures for customs offices at ports and border crossing points, and points of contact for information enquiries;
sl: Pogodbenice javno objavijo pomembna upravna obvestila, vključno z zahtevami agencij in vstopnimi postopki, delovnim časom in operativnimi postopki carinskih uradov v pristaniščih in na mejnih prehodih ter kontaktnimi točkami za informacijske poizvedbe;

en: to foster cooperation between operators and competent administrations via the use of non-arbitrary and publicly accessible procedures, such as Memoranda of Understanding, based on those promulgated by the WCO;
sl: podpirata sodelovanje med subjekti in ustreznimi upravami z uporabo nearbitrarnih in javno dostopnih postopkov, kot so memorandumi o soglasju, ki temeljijo na soglasjih, ki jih je objavil WCO;

en: to ensure that their respective customs and related requirements and procedures continue to meet the needs of the trading community, follow best practices, and remain as little trade-restrictive as possible.
sl: si bosta prizadevali, da bodo zahteve glede carinskih in z njimi povezanih zahtev, predpisov in postopkov še naprej izpolnjevale potrebe trgovinske skupnosti, upoštevale najboljše prakse in čim manj omejevale trgovino.

en: Article 31
sl: Člen 31

en: Customs valuation
sl: Carinsko vrednotenje

en: Article VII of the GATT 1994 and the Agreement on the Implementation of Article VII of the GATT 1994 shall govern customs valuation rules applied to reciprocal trade between the Parties.
sl: Člen VII GATT (1994) in Sporazum o izvajanju člena VII GATT (1994) urejata pravila carinskega vrednotenja, ki se uporabljajo v vzajemni trgovini med pogodbenicama.

en: The Parties shall cooperate with a view to reaching a common approach to issues relating to customs valuation.
sl: Pogodbenici sodelujeta, da oblikujeta skupni pristop k vprašanjem v zvezi s carinskim vrednotenjem.

en: Article 32
sl: Člen 32

en: Regional integration in the West Africa region
sl: Regionalno povezovanje v regiji Zahodne Afrike

en: The Parties agree to facilitate progress of custom reforms within the West Africa region.
sl: Pogodbenici soglašata, da bosta spodbujali napredek carinske reforme znotraj regije Zahodne Afrike.

en: Article 33
sl: Člen 33

en: Continuation of negotiations in the field of customs and trade facilitation
sl: Nadaljnja pogajanja o olajševanju trgovine in carinah

en: Within the negotiations of a full EPA, the Parties agree to continue negotiations on this chapter in order to complement it in a regional framework.
sl: V okviru pogajanj za celovit SGP pogodbenici soglašata, da bosta nadaljevali s pogajanji o tem poglavju, da ga končata v regionalnem okviru.

en: Article 34
sl: Člen 34

en: Special committee for customs and trade facilitation
sl: Poseben odbor za olajševanje trgovine in carine

en: Within the EPA Committee, the Parties will set up a Special Committee on customs and trade facilitation, comprising representatives of the Parties.
sl: V okviru Odbora SGP bosta pogodbenici ustanovili poseben odbor za carino in olajševanje trgovine, ki ga sestavljajo predstavniki pogodbenic.

en: This committee will report to the EPA Committee.
sl: Ta odbor bo poročal Odboru SGP.

en: It will discuss all customs issues meant to facilitate trade between the Parties and monitor the implementation and the application of this Chapter as well as the operation of rules of origin.
sl: Odbor bo razpravljal o vseh carinskih vprašanjih, ki bi lahko spodbujala trgovino med pogodbenicama, ter spremljal izvajanje in uporabo določb tega poglavja ter izvajanje predpisov o poreklu.

en: Article 35
sl: Člen 35

en: The Parties recognise the importance of cooperation as regards customs and trade facilitation measures for the implementation of this Agreement.
sl: Pogodbenici priznavata pomen sodelovanja pri ukrepih v zvezi s carinami in olajševanjem trgovine za izvajanje tega sporazuma.

en: The Parties agree to cooperate, in accordance with the provisions of Article 4, including by facilitating support, notably in the following areas:
sl: Pogodbenici soglašata, da bosta sodelovali v skladu z določbami člena 4, vključno z omogočanjem podpore, zlasti na naslednjih področjih:

en: elaboration of appropriate simplified legal and regulatory provisions;
sl: oblikovanje ustreznih poenostavljenih zakonskih določb in predpisov;

en: information and sensitisation of operators, including training of staff concerned;
sl: obveščanje in ozaveščanje subjektov, vključno z usposabljanjem zadevnega osebja;

en: capacity-building, modernisation and interconnection of custom administrations.
sl: krepitev zmogljivosti, posodabljanje in medsebojno povezovanje carinskih uprav.

en: CHAPTER 4
sl: POGLAVJE 4

en: Technical Barriers to Trade and Sanitary and Phytosanitary Measures
sl: Tehnične ovire pri trgovanju ter sanitarni in fitosanitarni ukrepi

en: Article 36
sl: Člen 36

en: Multilateral obligations and general context
sl: Večstranske obveznosti in splošen okvir

en: The Parties reaffirm their rights and obligations under the WTO Agreements and, in particular, the WTO Agreements on Sanitary and Phytosanitary Measures (hereinafter referred to as the ‘WTO SPS Agreement’) and on Technical Barriers to Trade (hereinafter referred to as the ‘WTO TBT Agreement’).
sl: Pogodbenici potrjujeta svojo zavezanost pravicam in obveznostim iz Sporazuma o ustanovitvi STO in zlasti sporazumov STO o uporabi sanitarnih in fitosanitarnih ukrepov (Sporazum STO SPS) ter o tehničnih ovirah pri trgovanju (Sporazum STO TBT).

en: The Parties also reaffirm their rights and obligations under the International Plant Protection Convention (IPPC), CODEX Alimentarius and the World Organisation for Animal Health (OIE).
sl: Prav tako potrjujeta svojo zavezanost pravicam in obveznostim v skladu z Mednarodno konvencijo o varstvu rastlin (IPPC), Kodeksom Alimentarius in Svetovno organizacijo za zdravje živali (OIE).

en: The Parties reaffirm their commitment to enhance public health in Ghana, in particular through the strengthening of capacities to identify non-compliant products.
sl: Pogodbenici potrjujeta svojo zavezanost izboljšanju javnega zdravja v Gani, zlasti s krepitvijo zmožnosti za odkrivanje neustreznih proizvodov.

en: These commitments, rights and obligations shall underline the activities of the Parties under this Chapter.
sl: Te zaveze, pravice in obveznosti krepijo dejavnosti pogodbenic iz tega poglavja.

en: Article 37
sl: Člen 37

en: The objectives of this Chapter are to facilitate trade in goods between the Parties, to increase the capacity of the Parties to identify, prevent and eliminate unnecessary obstacles to trade between the Parties as a result of technical regulations, standards and conformity assessment procedures applied by either Party while not affecting the capacity of the Parties to protect public, plant and animal health.
sl: Cilji tega poglavja so olajševanje trgovine s proizvodi med pogodbenicama ob krepitvi njunih zmožnosti za odkrivanje, preprečevanje in odpravljanje nepotrebnih ovir pri njunem medsebojnem trgovanju zaradi tehničnih predpisov, standardov in postopkov za ugotavljanje skladnosti, ki jih uporablja ena ali druga pogodbenica ob ohranjanju zmožnosti pogodbenic za varovanje rastlin, živali in javnega zdravja.

en: Article 38
sl: Člen 38

en: Scope and definitions
sl: Področje uporabe in opredelitev pojmov

en: The provisions of this Chapter shall apply to technical regulations, standards and conformity assessment procedures as defined in the WTO TBT Agreement and to sanitary and phytosanitary measures (hereinafter referred to as ‘SPS measures’) as defined in the WTO SPS Agreement, in so far as they affect trade between the Parties.
sl: Določbe tega poglavja se uporabljajo za tehnične predpise in standarde ter postopke za ugotavljanje skladnosti, opredeljene v Sporazumu TBT STO, ter sanitarne in fitosanitarne ukrepe (v nadaljnjem besedilu: ukrepi SPS), opredeljene v Sporazumu SPS STO, ker ti vplivajo na trgovino med pogodbenicama.

en: For the purposes of this Chapter, unless specified otherwise, the definitions used by the WTO TBT Agreement and WTO SPS Agreement, the CODEX Alimentarius, the IPPC and the OIE shall apply, including where reference is made to ‘products’ in this Chapter.
sl: Če ni drugače določeno, se v tem poglavju, vključno za vsa sklicevanja na „proizvode“, uporabljajo opredelitve iz Sporazuma TBT STO Sporazuma SPS STO, Kodeksa Alimentarius, IPPC in OIE.

en: Article 39
sl: Člen 39

en: Competent authorities
sl: Pristojni organi

en: The Competent Authorities of the Parties for the implementation of the measures referred to in this Chapter are described in Appendix II.
sl: Organi pogodbenic, pristojni za izvajanje ukrepov iz tega poglavja, so navedeni v Dodatku II.

en: The Parties shall, in accordance with Article 41, inform each other of any significant changes to the competent authorities listed in Appendix II.
sl: V skladu s členom 41 se pogodbenici medsebojno obveščata o pomembnih spremembah pri pristojnih organih iz Dodatka II.

en: In such a case, the EPA Committee will adopt an amendment to Appendix II.
sl: V tem primeru bo Odbor SGP sprejel vse potrebne spremembe Dodatka II.

en: Article 40
sl: Člen 40

en: Sanitary and phytosanitary zoning
sl: Določanje sanitarnih in fitosanitarnih območij

en: In respect of import conditions, the Parties may propose and identify on a case-by-case basis zones of defined sanitary and phytosanitary status, taking into account Article 6 of the WTO SPS Agreement.
sl: Kar zadeva uvozne pogoje, lahko pogodbenici za vsak posamezen primer predlagata in opredelita območja z določenim sanitarnim in fitosanitarnim stanjem ob upoštevanju člena 6 Sporazuma SPS STO.

en: Article 41
sl: Člen 41

en: Transparency of trade conditions and Information Exchange
sl: Preglednost trgovinskih pogojev in izmenjava informacij

en: The Parties shall inform each other of any changes to their technical import requirements for products (including live animals and plants).
sl: Pogodbenici se vzajemno obveščata o vseh spremembah svojih tehničnih zahtev za uvoz proizvodov (vključno z živimi živalmi in rastlinami).

en: The Parties agree to inform each other in writing of measures taken to prohibit the importation of any good to address a problem relating to health (public, animal or plant health), safety and the environment as soon as possible in accordance with SPS recommendations.
sl: Pogodbenici soglašata, da se čim prej medsebojno pisno obvestita o ukrepih, sprejetih za prepoved uvoza blaga kot posega proti kakršnim koli težavam, ki so povezane z zdravjem (ljudi, živali ali rastlin), varnostjo in okoljem v skladu s priporočili iz Sporazuma SPS.

en: The Parties agree to exchange information with a view to collaborating so that their products meet technical regulations and standards required to access their respective markets.
sl: Pogodbenici soglašata, da bosta izmenjali informacije, da bi njuni proizvodi izpolnjevali zahtevane tehnične standarde in predpise ter bi se jim s tem omogočil dostop do njunih trgov.

en: The Parties shall also directly exchange information on other topics agreed by both Parties to be of potential importance for their trade relations, including food safety issues, animal and plant disease outbreaks, scientific opinions and other significant product safety related events.
sl: Pogodbenici si tudi neposredno izmenjata informacije o drugih morebitnih pomembnih vprašanjih za svoje trgovinske odnose, vključno z vprašanji varnosti hrane, nenadnim pojavom živalskih in rastlinskih bolezni, znanstvenimi mnenji in drugimi pomembnimi dogodki, povezanimi z varnostjo proizvodov.

en: In particular, the Parties undertake to inform each other when applying the principle of sanitary and phytosanitary zoning as set out in Article 6 of the WTO SPS Agreement.
sl: Pogodbenici se zlasti zavezujeta, da si bosta izmenjali informacije, kadar uporabljata načelo določanja sanitarnih in fitosanitarnih območij, kot je določeno v členu 6 Sporazuma SPS.

en: The Parties agree to exchange information in epidemiological surveillance on animal disease.
sl: Pogodbenici soglašata, da si bosta izmenjali informacije o epidemiološkem nadzoru živalskih bolezni.

en: Also in the domain of plant health, the Parties will exchange information on the occurrence of pests of known and immediate danger to the other Party.
sl: Kar zadeva zdravje rastlin, si bosta pogodbenici izmenjali tudi informacije o pojavu škodljivcev, ki pomenijo znano in takojšnjo nevarnost za drugo pogodbenico.

en: The Parties agree to cooperate with a view to alerting each other early when new regional rules might impact trade between them.
sl: Pogodbenici soglašata, da bosta sodelovali pri medsebojnem in hitrem opozarjanju, kadar bi lahko nova regionalna pravila vplivala na njuno medsebojno trgovino.

en: Article 42
sl: Člen 42

en: Cooperation in international bodies
sl: Sodelovanje v mednarodnih telesih

en: The Parties agree to cooperate in international standard setting bodies, including by facilitating the participation by representatives of the Ghanaian Party in the meeting of these bodies.
sl: Pogodbenici soglašata, da bosta sodelovali v mednarodnih telesih za določanje standardov, med drugim z omogočanjem udeležbe predstavnikov pogodbenice Gane na srečanjih teh teles.

en: Article 43
sl: Člen 43

en: The Parties recognise the importance of cooperation in the areas of technical regulations, standards and conformity assessment as well as regards sanitary and phytosanitary measures for the implementation of this Agreement.
sl: Pogodbenici priznavata pomen sodelovanja na področjih tehničnih predpisov, standardov in ugotavljanja skladnosti ter sanitarnih in fitosanitarnih ukrepov za izvajanje tega sporazuma.

en: The Parties agree to cooperate, in accordance with the provisions of Article 4, with the aim of improving the quality and the competitiveness of priority products for Ghana and access to the EC market, including by facilitating support, notably financially, in the following areas:
sl: Pogodbenici soglašata, da bosta sodelovali v skladu z določbami iz člena 4 za izboljšanje kakovosti in konkurenčnosti prednostnih proizvodov Gane in dostopa do trga ES, vključno z omogočanjem podpore, zlasti finančne, na naslednjih področjih:

en: Set-up of an appropriate framework for the exchange of information and expertise among the Parties;
sl: vzpostavitev ustreznega okvira za izmenjavo informacij in strokovnega znanja med pogodbenicama;

en: Adoption of technical standards and regulations, conformity assessment procedures, and harmonised sanitary and phytosanitary measures at regional level, based on relevant international standards;
sl: sprejetje tehničnih standardov in predpisov, postopkov za ugotavljanje skladnosti ter sanitarnih in fitosanitarnih ukrepov, usklajenih na regionalni ravni, na podlagi ustreznih mednarodnih standardov;

en: Building the capacity of the public and private actors, including information and training, with the aim of helping exporters to conform to EC rules and standards, and of participating in international organisations;
sl: krepitev zmogljivosti javnih in zasebnih akterjev, vključno z obveščanjem in usposabljanjem, za pomoč izvoznikom, da bi izpolnjevali predpise in standarde ES, ter sodelovanje v mednarodnih organizacijah;

en: Development of national capacities for the assessment of product compliance and access to the EC market.
sl: razvoj nacionalnih zmogljivosti za ugotavljanje skladnosti proizvodov in dostopa do trga ES.

en: TITLE IV
sl: NASLOV IV

en: SERVICES, INVESTMENT AND TRADE RELATED RULES
sl: STORITVE, NALOŽBE IN PRAVILA, POVEZANA S TRGOVINO

en: Article 44
sl: Člen 44

en: Building on the Cotonou Agreement, the Parties will cooperate to facilitate all the necessary measures leading to the conclusion as soon as possible of a global EPA between the whole West Africa region and the EC in the following:
sl: Pogodbenici bosta na podlagi Sporazuma iz Cotonouja sodelovali za sprejetje vseh potrebnih ukrepov za čimprejšnjo sklenitev celovitega SGP med celotno regijo Zahodno Afriko in ES na naslednjih področjih:

en: trade in services and electronic commerce;
sl: trgovina s storitvami in elektronsko poslovanje;

en: investments;
sl: naložbe;

en: competition;
sl: konkurenca;

en: intellectual property.
sl: intelektualna lastnina.

en: The Parties will take all necessary measures to endeavour to conclude a global EPA between the West Africa region and the EC before the end of 2008.
sl: Pogodbenici bosta sprejeli vse ukrepe, potrebne za pospešitev sklenitve celovitega SGP med regijo Zahodno Afriko in ES do konca leta 2008.

en: On these issues, as well as on any other issues the Parties may agree on, the Parties support the negotiations of the global EPA on the basis of the EC-West Africa Road Map and subsequent developments since its adoption.
sl: V zvezi s temi in vsemi drugimi področji, o katerih se bosta dogovorili, pogodbenici podpirata pogajanja za sklenitev celovitega SGP na podlagi časovnega načrta ES–Zahodna Afrika in njegovih poznejših spremembah po njegovem sprejetju.

en: They welcome a two-step approach starting first with formulating and implementing regional policies and building regional capacity, and in a second step, deepening the EC-West Africa trade provisions mutually agreed on concerning these issues.
sl: Pozdravljata dvostopenjski pristop, pri katerem prvi korak predstavljajo oblikovanje in izvajanje regionalnih politik ter krepitev regionalne zmogljivosti, drugi korak pa krepitev medsebojno dogovorjenih trgovinskih določb na teh področjih med ES–Zahodno Afriko.

en: This Article does not prejudge the position of the regional organisations on the above issues.
sl: Ta člen ne vpliva na stališče regionalnih organizacij o zgoraj navednih področjih.

en: TITLE V
sl: NASLOV V

en: DISPUTE AVOIDANCE AND SETTLEMENT
sl: IZOGIBANJE IN REŠEVANJE SPOROV

en: Objective and scope
sl: Cilj in področje uporabe

en: Article 45
sl: Člen 45

en: Objective
sl: Cilj

en: The objective of this Title is to avoid and settle any dispute between the Parties with a view to arriving, where possible, at a mutually agreed solution.
sl: Cilj tega naslova je izogibanje in reševanje morebitnega spora med pogodbenicami, da se, kjer je to mogoče, doseže sporazumna rešitev.

en: Article 46
sl: Člen 46

en: Scope
sl: Področje uporabe

en: This Title shall apply to any dispute concerning the interpretation and application of this Agreement, with the exception of Title II and except where otherwise provided.
sl: Ta naslov se uporablja za vse spore v zvezi z razlago in uporabo tega sporazuma, razen določb iz naslova II tega sporazuma, in če ni izrecno določeno drugače.

en: Notwithstanding paragraph 1, the procedure set out in Article 98 of the Cotonou Agreement, shall be applicable in the event of a dispute concerning development finance cooperation as provided for by the Cotonou Agreement.
sl: Ne glede na odstavek 1 se postopek iz člena 98 Sporazuma iz Cotonouja uporablja v primeru spora v zvezi s sodelovanjem pri financiranju razvoja, kot ga predvideva Sporazum iz Cotonouja.

en: Consultations and mediation
sl: Posvetovanje in posredovanje

en: Article 47
sl: Člen 47

en: Consultations
sl: Posvetovanje

en: The Parties shall endeavour to resolve any dispute referred to in Article 46 by entering into consultations in good faith with the aim of reaching a mutually agreed solution.
sl: Pogodbenici si prizadevata rešiti vse spore iz člena 46 tako, da začneta posvetovanja v dobri veri, da dosežeta sporazumno rešitev.

en: A Party shall seek consultations by means of a written request to the other Party, copied to the EPA Committee, identifying the measure at issue and the provisions of the Agreement which it considers the measure not to be in conformity with.
sl: Pogodbenica zahteva posvetovanje s predložitvijo pisnega zahtevka drugi pogodbenici (in njegove kopije Odboru SGP), v katerem opredeli sporni ukrep in določbe Sporazuma, s katerimi ukrep po njenem mnenju ni skladen.

en: Consultations shall be held within 40 days of the date of the submission of the request.
sl: Posvetovanja se začnejo v 40 dneh po datumu predložitve zahtevka.

en: The consultations shall be deemed to be concluded within 60 days of the date of the submission of the request, unless both Parties agree to continue consultations.
sl: Posvetovanja se štejejo za zaključena v 60 dneh po datumu predložitve zahtevka, razen če se obe pogodbenici ne dogovorita za nadaljevanje posvetovanj.

en: All information disclosed during the consultations shall remain confidential.
sl: Vse informacije, razkrite med posvetovanji, ostanejo zaupne.

en: Consultations on matters of urgency, including those regarding perishable or seasonal goods shall be held within 15 days of the date of the submission of the request, and shall be deemed to be concluded within 30 days of the date of the submission of the request.
sl: Posvetovanja o nujnih zadevah, vključno s tistimi, ki se nanašajo na pokvarljivo ali sezonsko blago, se skličejo v petnajstih 15 dneh po datumu predložitve zahtevka in se štejejo za zaključena v 30 dneh po datumu predložitve zahtevka.

en: If consultations are not held within the time frames laid down in paragraph 3 or in paragraph 4, or if consultations have been concluded and no agreement has been reached on a mutually agreed solution, the complaining Party may request the establishment of an arbitration panel in accordance with Article 49.
sl: Če se posvetovanja ne skličejo v rokih iz odstavka 3 ali odstavka 4 ali če se posvetovanja zaključijo, ne da bi bilo doseženo soglasje o sporazumni rešitvi, lahko pogodbenica pritožnica zahteva ustanovitev arbitražnega senata v skladu s členom 49.

en: Article 48
sl: Člen 48

en: Mediation
sl: Posredovanje

en: If consultations fail to produce a mutually agreed solution, the Parties may, by agreement, seek recourse to a mediator.
sl: Če se posvetovanja ne končajo s sporazumno rešitvijo, se lahko pogodbenici po dogovoru obrneta na posrednika.

en: Unless the Parties agree otherwise, the terms of reference for the mediation shall be the matter referred to in the request for consultations.
sl: Če pogodbenici ne odločita drugače, so formalni pogoji za posredovanje tisti, navedeni v zahtevku za pogajanja.

en: Unless the Parties agree on a mediator within ten days of the date of the agreement to request mediation, the chairperson of the EPA Committee, or his or her delegate, shall select by lot a mediator from the pool of individuals who are on the list referred to in Article 64 and are not nationals of either Party.
sl: Če se pogodbenici v 10 dneh od datuma predložitve zahtevka za posredovanje ne sporazumeta o posredniku, predsednik Odbora SGP ali njegov pooblaščenec z žrebom izbere posrednika iz skupine posameznikov, ki so na seznamu iz člena 20 in niso državljani nobene od pogodbenic.

en: The selection shall be made within 20 days of the date of the submission of the agreement to request mediation and in the presence of a representative of each Party.
sl: Izbor se opravi v 20 dneh od datuma predložitve zahtevka za posredovanje v navzočnosti predstavnika vsake od pogodbenic.

en: The mediator will convene a meeting with the Parties not later than 30 days after being selected.
sl: Posrednik skliče sejo s pogodbenicama najpozneje 30 dni potem, ko je bil izbran.

en: The mediator shall receive the submissions of each Party not later than 15 days before the meeting and notify an opinion not later than 45 days after having been selected.
sl: Posrednik prejme vloge vsake od pogodbenic najpozneje 15 dni pred sejo in svoje mnenje sporoči najpozneje 45 dni potem, ko je bil izbran.

en: The mediator's opinion may include a recommendation on how to resolve the dispute consistent with the provisions referred to in Article 53.
sl: Mnenje posrednika lahko vključuje priporočilo o tem, kako rešiti spor skladno z določbami iz člena 53.

en: The mediator's opinion is non-binding.
sl: Mnenje posrednika ni zavezujoče.

en: The Parties may agree to amend the time-limits referred to in paragraph 2.
sl: Pogodbenici se lahko dogovorita za spremembo rokov iz odstavka 2.

en: The mediator may also decide to amend these time-limits upon request of any of the Parties or on his own initiative, given the particular difficulties experienced by the Party concerned or the complexities of the case.
sl: Posrednik se lahko prav tako odloči za spremembo teh rokov na zahtevo katere koli od pogodbenic ali na lastno pobudo, glede na posebne težave, ki jih ima zadevna pogodbenica, ali zapletenost primera.

en: The proceedings involving mediation, in particular all information disclosed and positions taken by the Parties during these proceedings shall remain confidential.
sl: Postopki, povezani s posredovanjem, zlasti vse razkrite informacije in stališča, ki jih pogodbenici izrazita med temi postopki, so zaupni.

en: Dispute settlement procedures
sl: Postopki reševanja sporov

en: Section I
sl: Oddelek I

en: Arbitration procedure
sl: Arbitražni postopek

en: Article 49
sl: Člen 49

en: Initiation of the arbitration procedure
sl: Sprožitev arbitražnega postopka

en: Where the Parties have failed to resolve the dispute by recourse to consultations as provided for in Article 47, or by recourse to mediation as provided for in Article 48, the complaining Party may request the establishment of an arbitration panel.
sl: Kadar pogodbenicama ne uspe rešiti spora s pomočjo posvetovanj, kakor so opredeljena v členu 47, ali s pomočjo posredovanja, kakor je opredeljeno v členu 48, lahko pogodbenica pritožnica zahteva ustanovitev arbitražnega senata.

en: The request for the establishment of an arbitration panel shall be made in writing to the Party complained against and the EPA Committee.
