sl: Zahteva za ustanovitev arbitražnega senata mora biti podana v pisni obliki pogodbenici, proti kateri je vložena pritožba, in Odboru SGP.

en: The complaining Party shall identify in its request the specific measures at issue, and it shall explain how such measures constitute a breach of the provisions of this Agreement.
sl: Pogodbenica pritožnica v svoji zahtevi opredeli konkretne sporne ukrepe in razloži, kako taki ukrepi predstavljajo kršitev določb tega sporazuma.

en: Article 50
sl: Člen 50

en: Establishment of the arbitration panel
sl: Ustanovitev arbitražnega senata

en: An arbitration panel shall be composed of three arbitrators.
sl: Arbitražni senat sestavljajo trije razsodniki.

en: Within ten days of the date of the submission of the request for the establishment of an arbitration panel to the EPA Committee, the Parties shall consult in order to reach an agreement on the composition of the arbitration panel.
sl: V desetih dneh od datuma predložitve zahteve za ustanovitev arbitražnega senata Odboru SGP se pogodbenici posvetujeta, da bi dosegli dogovor o sestavi arbitražnega senata.

en: In the event that the Parties are unable to agree on its composition within the time frame laid down in paragraph 2, either Party may request the chairperson of the EPA Committee, or her or his delegate, to select all three members by lot from the list established under Article 64, one among the individuals proposed by the complaining Party, one among the individuals proposed by the Party complained against and one among the individuals selected by the Parties to act as chairperson.
sl: Če pogodbenici ne moreta doseči soglasja o sestavi arbitražnega senata v roku, ki je določen v odstavku 2, lahko katera koli pogodbenica zaprosi predsednika Odbora SGP ali njegovega pooblaščenca, da z žrebom izbere tri člane s seznama, sestavljenega na podlagi člena 64, enega izmed oseb, ki jih predlaga pogodbenica pritožnica, enega izmed oseb, ki jih predlaga tožena pogodbenica, ter enega izmed oseb, ki sta jih pogodbenici imenovali za predsednika.

en: Where the Parties agree on one or more of the members of the arbitration panel, any remaining members shall be selected by the same procedure.
sl: Kadar se pogodbenici sporazumeta o enem ali več članih arbitražnega senata, se vsi preostali člani izberejo po enakem postopku.

en: The chairperson of the EPA Committee, or her or his delegate, shall select the arbitrators within five days of the request referred to in paragraph 3 by either Party and in the presence of a representative of each Party.
sl: Predsednik Odbora SGP ali njegov pooblaščenec izbere razsodnike v petih dneh od zahteve iz odstavka 3 s strani katere koli od pogodbenic, in sicer v navzočnosti predstavnika vsake od pogodbenic.

en: The date of establishment of the arbitration panel shall be the date on which the three arbitrators are selected.
sl: Datum ustanovitve arbitražnega senata je datum, ko so izbrani vsi trije razsodniki.

en: Article 51
sl: Člen 51

en: Interim panel report
sl: Vmesno poročilo senata

en: The arbitration panel shall notify to the Parties an interim report containing both the descriptive section and its findings and conclusions, as a general rule not later than 120 days from the date of establishment of the arbitration panel.
sl: Arbitražni senat pogodbenici uradno obvesti o vmesnem poročilu, ki vključuje opisni del in njegove ugotovitve ter sklepe, praviloma najpozneje 120 dni po datumu ustanovitve arbitražnega senata.

en: Any Party may submit written comments to the arbitration panel on precise aspects of its interim report within 15 days of the notification of the report.
sl: Katera koli od pogodbenic lahko arbitražnemu senatu predloži pisne pripombe glede določenih vidikov njegovega vmesnega poročila v petnajstih dneh od uradnega obvestila o poročilu.

en: Article 52
sl: Člen 52

en: Arbitration panel ruling
sl: Odločitev arbitražnega senata

en: The arbitration panel shall notify its ruling to the Parties and to the EPA Committee within 150 days from the date of the establishment of the arbitration panel.
sl: Arbitražni senat o svoji odločitvi uradno obvesti pogodbenici in Odbor SGP v 150 dneh od datuma ustanovitve arbitražnega senata.

en: Where it considers that this deadline cannot be met, the chairperson of the arbitration panel must notify the Parties and the EPA Committee in writing, stating the reasons for the delay and the date on which the panel plans to conclude its work.
sl: Če meni, da tega roka ni mogoče upoštevati, mora predsednik arbitražnega senata o tem pisno obvestiti pogodbenici ter Odbor SGP, pri čemer navede razloge za odlog in datum, ko naj bi senat predvidoma končal svoje delo.

en: Under no circumstances should the ruling be notified later than 180 days from the date of the establishment of the arbitration panel.
sl: Uradno obvestilo o odločitvi pod nobenim pogojem ne sme biti predloženo pozneje kot 180 dni od datuma ustanovitve arbitražnega senata.

en: In cases of urgency, including those involving perishable and seasonal goods, the arbitration panel shall make every effort to notify its ruling within 75 days from the date its establishment.
sl: V nujnih primerih, vključno s tistimi, ki so povezani s pokvarljivim in sezonskim blagom, si arbitražni senat vsestransko prizadeva, da svojo odločitev sporoči v 75 dneh od datuma svoje ustanovitve.

en: Under no circumstance should it take longer than 90 days from its establishment.
sl: Pod nobenim pogojem to ne sme trajati več kot 90 dni po njegovi ustanovitvi.

en: The arbitration panel may give a preliminary ruling within ten days of its establishment on whether it deems the case to be urgent.
sl: Arbitražni senat lahko o tem, ali je primer po njegovem mnenju nujen, predhodno odloči v desetih dneh od svoje ustanovitve.

en: Either Party may request the arbitration panel to provide a recommendation as to how the Party complained against could bring itself into compliance.
sl: Katera koli od pogodbenic lahko zahteva, da arbitražni senat priporoči, kako bi lahko tožena pogodbenica odpravila neskladnost.

en: Section II
sl: Oddelek II

en: Compliance
sl: Izpolnitev odločitve

en: Article 53
sl: Člen 53

en: Compliance with the arbitration panel ruling
sl: Izpolnitev odločitve arbitražnega senata

en: Each Party shall take any measure necessary to comply with the arbitration panel ruling, and the Parties will endeavour to agree on the period of time to comply with the ruling.
sl: Vsaka od pogodbenic sprejme vse potrebne ukrepe za izpolnitev odločitve arbitražnega senata, pogodbenici pa si bosta prizadevali za soglasje glede obdobja za izpolnitev odločitve.

en: Article 54
sl: Člen 54

en: The reasonable period of time for compliance
sl: Razumno obdobje za izpolnitev odločitve

en: Not later than 30 days after the notification of the arbitration panel ruling to the Parties, the Party complained against shall notify the complaining Party and the EPA Committee of the time it will require for compliance (reasonable period of time).
sl: Najpozneje v 30 dneh po uradnem obvestilu pogodbenic o odločitvi arbitražnega senata tožena pogodbenica uradno obvesti pogodbenico pritožnico ter Odbor SGP o obdobju, ki ga bo potrebovala za izpolnitev odločitve („razumno obdobje“).

en: If there is disagreement between the Parties on the reasonable period of time to comply with the arbitration panel ruling, the complaining Party shall, within 20 days of the notification made by the Party complained against, request in writing the arbitration panel to determine the length of the reasonable period of time.
sl: Če med pogodbenicama pride do razhajanja glede razumnega obdobja za izpolnitev odločitve arbitražnega senata, pogodbenica pritožnica v 20 dneh od uradnega obvestila tožene pogodbenice pisno zahteva od arbitražnega senata, da določi dolžino razumnega obdobja.

en: Such request shall be notified simultaneously to the other Party and to the EPA Committee.
sl: O zahtevku se hkrati obvesti drugo pogodbenico in Odbor SGP.

en: The arbitration panel shall notify its ruling to the Parties and to the EPA Committee within 30 days from the date of the submission of the request.
sl: Arbitražni senat o svoji odločitvi uradno obvesti pogodbenici in Odbor SGP v 30 dneh od datuma predložitve zahtevka.

en: The arbitration panel will, in determining the length of the reasonable period of time, take into consideration the length of time that it will normally take the Party complained against to adopt comparable legislative or administrative measures to those identified by the Party complained against as being necessary to ensure compliance.
sl: Arbitražni senat pri določanju dolžine razumnega obdobja upošteva obdobje, ki ga tožena pogodbenica običajno potrebuje za sprejetje zakonskih ali upravnih ukrepov, primerljivih s tistimi, za katere pogodbenica pritožnica ugotovi, da so potrebni za zagotovitev skladnosti.

en: The arbitration panel may also take into consideration constraints which may affect the adoption by the Party complained against of the necessary measures.
sl: Arbitražni senat lahko poleg tega upošteva omejitve, ki lahko vplivajo na sprejetje potrebnih ukrepov tožene pogodbenice.

en: In the event of the original arbitration panel, or some of its members, being unable to reconvene, the procedures set out in Article 50 shall apply.
sl: Če se prvotni arbitražni senat ali nekateri njegovi člani ne morejo ponovno sestati, se uporabijo postopki iz člena 50.

en: The time-limit for notifying the ruling shall be 45 days from the date of the submission of the request referred to in paragraph 2.
sl: Rok za sporočilo odločitve je 45 dni po datumu predložitve zahtevka iz odstavka 2.

en: The reasonable period of time may be extended by agreement of the Parties.
sl: Razumno obdobje se lahko po dogovoru pogodbenic podaljša.

en: Article 55
sl: Člen 55

en: Review of any measure taken to comply with the arbitration panel ruling
sl: Proučitev ukrepov, sprejetih za izpolnitev odločitve arbitražnega senata

en: The Party complained against shall notify the other Party and the EPA Committee before the end of the reasonable period of time of any measure that it has taken to comply with the arbitration panel ruling.
sl: Tožena pogodbenica pred koncem razumnega obdobja uradno obvesti drugo pogodbenico ter Odbor SGP o vseh ukrepih, ki jih je sprejela za izpolnitev odločitve arbitražnega senata.

en: In the event that there is disagreement between the Parties concerning the compatibility of any measure notified under paragraph 1, with the provisions of this Agreement, the complaining Party may request in writing the arbitration panel to rule on the matter.
sl: Če med pogodbenicama pride do razhajanja glede skladnosti katerega koli ukrepa, priglašenega na podlagi odstavka 1, z določbami tega sporazuma, lahko pogodbenica pritožnica pisno zahteva od arbitražnega senata, da odloča o zadevi.

en: Such request shall identify the specific measure at issue and it shall explain how such measure is incompatible with the provisions of this Agreement.
sl: V zahtevku morajo biti opredeljeni konkretni sporni ukrepi in biti mora razloženo, v čem so ti ukrepi neskladni z določbami tega sporazuma.

en: The arbitration panel shall notify its ruling within 90 days of the date of the submission of the request.
sl: Arbitražni senat svojo odločitev sporoči v 90 dneh od datuma predložitve zahtevka.

en: In cases of urgency, including those involving perishable and seasonal goods, the arbitration panel shall notify its ruling within 45 days of the date of the submission of the request.
sl: V nujnih primerih, vključno s tistimi, ki so povezani s pokvarljivim in sezonskim blagom, arbitražni senat svojo odločitev sporoči v 45 dneh od datuma predložitve zahtevka.

en: The time-limit for notifying the ruling shall be 105 days from the date of the submission of the request referred to in paragraph 2.
sl: Rok za sporočilo odločitve je 105 dni po datumu predložitve zahtevka iz odstavka 2.

en: Article 56
sl: Člen 56

en: Temporary remedies in case of non-compliance
sl: Začasna pravna sredstva v primeru neizpolnitve odločitve

en: If the Party complained against fails to notify any measure taken to comply with the arbitration panel ruling before the expiry of the reasonable period of time, or if the arbitration panel rules that the measure notified under Article 55(1) is not compatible with that Party's obligations under the provisions referred to in Article 53, the Party complained against shall, if so requested by the complaining Party, present an offer for temporary compensation.
sl: Če tožena pogodbenica ukrepov, sprejetih za izpolnitev odločitve arbitražnega senata, ne priglasi pred iztekom razumnega obdobja ali če arbitražni senat odloči, da ukrepi, priglašeni po členu 55(1), niso skladni z obveznostmi te pogodbenice na podlagi določb iz člena 53, mora tožena pogodbenica na zahtevo pogodbenice pritožnice predložiti ponudbo za začasno nadomestilo.

en: If no agreement on compensation is reached within 30 days of the end of the reasonable period of time or of the arbitration panel's ruling under Article 55 that a measure taken to comply is not compatible with the provisions referred to in Article 53, the complaining Party shall be entitled, upon notification to the other Party, to adopt appropriate measures.
sl: Če v 30 dneh po koncu razumnega obdobja ali odločitvi arbitražnega senata po členu 55, da sprejeti ukrepi za izpolnitev odločitve niso skladni z določbami iz člena 53, ni dosežen dogovor o nadomestilu, je pogodbenica pritožnica upravičena, da po uradnem obvestilu drugi pogodbenici sprejme ustrezne ukrepe.

en: In adopting such measures the complaining Party shall endeavour to select measures that least affect the attainment of the objectives of this Agreement and shall take into consideration their impact on the economy of the Party complained against.
sl: Pri sprejemanju takih ukrepov si pogodbenica pritožnica prizadeva izbrati ukrepe, ki najmanj vplivajo na doseganje ciljev tega sporazuma, ter upošteva njihov vpliv na gospodarstvo tožene pogodbenice.

en: Under no circumstance will the appropriate measures referred to in the present paragraph affect development assistance to Ghana.
sl: Ustrezni ukrepi iz tega odstavka pod nobenim pogojem ne bodo vplivali na razvojno pomoč Gani.

en: The EC Party shall exercise due restraint in asking for compensation or adopting appropriate measures pursuant to paragraphs 1 or 2 and will take account of the situation of developing country of the Ghanaian Party.
sl: Pogodbenica ES je pri zahtevanju nadomestila ali sprejemanju ustreznih ukrepov v skladu z odstavkom 1 ali 2 tega člena ustrezno zadržana in bo upoštevala položaj države v razvoju, pogodbenice Gane.

en: The appropriate measures or compensation shall be temporary and shall be applied only until any measure found to violate the provisions referred to in Article 53 has been withdrawn or amended so as to bring it into conformity with those provisions or until the Parties have agreed to settle the dispute.
sl: Ustrezni ukrepi ali nadomestilo so začasni in se uporabljajo samo, dokler se ukrep, za katerega je ugotovljeno, da krši določbe iz člena 53, ne odpravi ali spremeni tako, da je v skladu s temi določbami, ali dokler se pogodbenici ne dogovorita za rešitev spora.

en: Article 57
sl: Člen 57

en: Review of any measure taken to comply after the adoption of appropriate measures
sl: Proučitev ukrepov, sprejetih za izpolnitev odločitve, po sprejetju ustreznih ukrepov

en: The Party complained against shall notify the other Party and the EPA Committee of any measure it has taken to comply with the ruling of the arbitration panel and of its request for an end to the application of appropriate measures by the complaining Party.
sl: Tožena pogodbenica obvesti drugo pogodbenico in Odbor SGP o ukrepih, ki jih je sprejela za izpolnitev odločitve arbitražnega senata, in v obvestilu zahteva, da pogodbenica pritožnica opusti izvajanje ustreznih ukrepov.

en: If the Parties do not reach an agreement on the compatibility of the notified measure with the provisions of this Agreement within 30 days of the date of the submission of the notification, the complaining Party shall request in writing the arbitration panel to rule on the matter.
sl: Če pogodbenici v 30 dneh od datuma predložitve uradnega obvestila ne dosežeta dogovora o skladnosti priglašenih ukrepov z določbami tega sporazuma, lahko pogodbenica pritožnica od arbitražnega senata pisno zahteva, da odloča o zadevi.

en: Such request shall be notified to the other Party and to the EPA Committee.
sl: O takem zahtevku se obvesti drugo pogodbenico in Odbor SGP.

en: The arbitration panel ruling shall be notified to the Parties and to the EPA Committee within 45 days of the date of the submission of the request.
sl: Arbitražni senat o svoji odločitvi uradno obvesti pogodbenici in Odbor SGP v 45 dneh od datuma predložitve zahtevka.

en: If the arbitration panel rules that any measure taken to comply is not in conformity with the provisions of this Agreement, the arbitration panel will determine whether the complaining Party can continue to apply appropriate measures.
sl: Če arbitražni senat odloči, da kateri koli sprejeti ukrepi za uskladitev niso v skladu z določbami tega sporazuma, odloči tudi, ali lahko pogodbenica pritožnica nadaljuje z izvajanjem ustreznih ukrepov.

en: If the arbitration panel rules that any measure taken to comply is in conformity with the provisions of this Agreement, the appropriate measures shall be terminated.
sl: Če arbitražni senat odloči, da so kateri koli ukrepi, sprejeti za uskladitev, skladni z določbami tega sporazuma, se ustrezni ukrepi opustijo.

en: In the event of the original arbitration panel, or some of its members, being unable to reconvene, the procedures laid down in Article 50 shall apply.
sl: Če se prvotni arbitražni senat ali nekateri njegovi člani ne morejo ponovno sestati, se uporabijo postopki iz člena 50.

en: The period for notifying the ruling shall be 60 days from the date of the submission of the request referred to in paragraph 2.
sl: Rok za sporočilo odločitve je 60 dni od datuma predložitve zahtevka iz odstavka 2.

en: Section III
sl: Oddelek III

en: Common Provisions
sl: Skupne določbe

en: Article 58
sl: Člen 58

en: Mutually agreed solution
sl: Sporazumna rešitev

en: Within the present Title, the Parties may reach a mutually agreed solution to a dispute under this Title at any time.
sl: Pogodbenici lahko kadar koli dosežeta sporazumno rešitev spora v okviru tega naslova.

en: They shall notify the EPA Committee of any such solution.
sl: O svojem sporazumu glede take rešitve obvestita Odbor SGP.

en: Upon adoption of the mutually agreed solution, the procedure shall be terminated.
sl: Po sprejetju sporazumne rešitve se postopek zaključi.

en: Article 59
sl: Člen 59

en: Rules of procedure
sl: Poslovnik

en: Dispute settlement procedures under Chapter 3 of this Title shall be governed by the Rules of Procedure which shall be adopted by the EPA Committee within three month after its establishment.
sl: Postopke reševanja sporov iz poglavja 3 tega naslova ureja poslovnik, ki ga sprejme Odbor SGP v treh mesecih po svoji ustanovitvi.

en: Any meeting of the arbitration panel shall be open to the public in accordance with the Rules of Procedure, unless otherwise decided by the arbitration panel on its own initiative or further to the request of the Parties.
sl: Seje arbitražnega senata so odprte za javnost v skladu s poslovnikom, razen če arbitražni senat na svojo pobudo ali na zahtevo pogodbenic ne določi drugače.

en: Article 60
sl: Člen 60

en: Information and technical advice
sl: Informacije in tehnični nasveti

en: At the request of a Party, or upon its own initiative, the arbitration panel may obtain information from any source, including the Parties involved in the dispute, it deems appropriate for the arbitration panel proceeding.
sl: Na zahtevo pogodbenice ali na lastno pobudo lahko arbitražni senat pridobi informacije iz katerega koli vira, tudi od pogodbenic, vpletenih v spor, za katerega meni, da je primeren za postopek arbitražnega senata.

en: The arbitration panel shall also have the right to seek the relevant opinion of experts as it deems appropriate.
sl: Arbitražni senat ima prav tako pravico pridobiti ustrezno mnenje strokovnjakov, kadar meni, da je to primerno.

en: Interested parties are authorised to submit amicus curiae briefs to the arbitration panel in accordance with the Rules of Procedure.
sl: Zainteresirane stranke so pooblaščene, da arbitražnemu senatu predložijo dopise prijateljev sodišča (amicus curiae) v skladu s poslovnikom.

en: Any information obtained in this manner must be disclosed to each of the Parties and submitted for their comments.
sl: Tako pridobljene informacije je treba razkriti vsaki od pogodbenic in jima jih predložiti, da izrazita pripombe.

en: Article 61
sl: Člen 61

en: Languages of the submissions
sl: Jeziki sporočil

en: The written and oral submissions shall be made in any official language of the Parties.
sl: Pisna in ustna sporočila pogodbenice se predložijo v katerem koli uradnem jeziku pogodbenic.

en: The Parties will however endeavour to the extent possible to adopt an official language common to both Parties as a working language and will notably take into account the situation of developing country of the Ghanaian Party, particularly as regards translation difficulties.
sl: Vendar pa si pogodbenici prizadevata, kolikor je to mogoče, da bi kot skupen delovni jezik sprejeli uradni jezik, skupen obema pogodbenicama, in bosta zlasti upoštevali položaj države v razvoju, pogodbenice Gane, predvsem z vidika težav pri prevajanju.

en: Article 62
sl: Člen 62

en: Rules of interpretation
sl: Pravila razlage

en: Any arbitration panel shall interpret the provisions of this Agreement in accordance with customary rules of interpretation of public international law, including the Vienna Convention on the Law of Treaties.
sl: Arbitražni senat se zavezuje, da bo razlagal določbe tega sporazuma v skladu z običajnimi pravili razlage mednarodnega javnega prava, vključno z Dunajsko konvencijo o pogodbenem pravu.

en: The rulings of the arbitration panel cannot add to or diminish the rights and obligations provided in the provisions of this Agreement.
sl: Odločitve arbitražnega senata ne morejo povečati ali zmanjšati pravic in obveznosti, določenih v določbah tega sporazuma.

en: Article 63
sl: Člen 63

en: Arbitration panel rulings
sl: Odločitve arbitražnega senata

en: The arbitration panel shall make every effort to take any decision by consensus.
sl: Arbitražni senat si vsestransko prizadeva za sprejemanje odločitev s soglasjem.

en: Where, nevertheless, a decision cannot be arrived at by consensus, the matter at issue shall be decided by majority vote.
sl: Če odločitve kljub temu ni mogoče doseči s soglasjem, se o sporni zadevi odloča z večino glasov.

en: However, in no case shall dissenting opinions of arbitrators be published.
sl: V nobenem primeru pa se ločena odklonilna mnenja razsodnikov ne objavijo.

en: The ruling shall set out the findings of fact, the applicability of the relevant provisions of this Agreement and the reasoning behind any findings and conclusions that it makes.
sl: Odločitev zajema ugotovitve o dejstvih, relevantnost ustreznih določb tega sporazuma in argumente za sprejete ugotovitve in sklepe.

en: The EPA Committee shall make the arbitration panel rulings publicly available unless it decides not to do so.
sl: Odbor SGP javno objavi odločitve arbitražnega senata, razen če se odloči, da tega ne bo storil.

en: General provisions
sl: Splošne določbe

en: Article 64
sl: Člen 64

en: List of arbitrators
sl: Seznam razsodnikov

en: The EPA Committee shall, not later than three months after the provisional application of this Agreement, establish a list of 15 individuals who are willing and able to serve as arbitrators.
sl: Najpozneje tri mesece po začetku začasne uporabe tega sporazuma Odbor SGP izdela seznam 15 posameznikov, ki so pripravljeni in sposobni opravljati funkcijo razsodnika.

en: Each of the Parties shall select five individuals to serve as arbitrators.
sl: Vsaka od pogodbenic izbere pet posameznikov, ki so sposobni opravljati funkcijo razsodnika.

en: The two Parties shall also agree on five individuals who are not nationals of either Party and who shall act as chairperson to the arbitration panel.
sl: Pogodbenici se prav tako dogovorita o petih posameznikih, ki niso državljani nobene od pogodbenic in ki bi lahko opravljali funkcijo predsednika arbitražnega senata.

en: The EPA Committee will ensure that the list is always maintained at this level.
sl: Odbor SGP bo skrbel, da bo ta seznam vedno na tej ravni.

en: Arbitrators shall have specialised knowledge or experience of law and international trade.
sl: Razsodniki morajo imeti strokovno znanje ali izkušnje iz prava in mednarodne trgovine.

en: They shall be independent, serve in their individual capacities and not take instructions from any organisation or government, or be affiliated with the government of any of the Parties, and shall comply with the Code of Conduct annexed to the Rules of Procedures.
sl: Biti morajo samostojni, delovati morajo v svoji individualni pristojnosti, ne smejo sprejemati navodil od nobene organizacije ali vlade ali biti povezani z vlado katere koli od pogodbenic in ravnati morajo v skladu s kodeksom, ki je priložen poslovniku.

en: The EPA Committee may establish an additional list of 15 individuals having a sectoral expertise in specific matters covered by the stepping stone EPA.
sl: Odbor SGP lahko izdela dodaten seznam 15 posameznikov, ki imajo področno strokovno znanje iz posebnih zadev, ki jih zajema vmesni SGP.

en: When recourse is made to the selection procedure of Article 50(2), the chairperson of the EPA Committee may use such a sectoral list upon agreement of both Parties.
sl: Če se uporabi postopek izbire iz člena 50(2), lahko predsednik Odbora SGP takšen področni seznam uporabi ob soglasju obeh pogodbenic.

en: Article 65
sl: Člen 65

en: Relation with WTO obligations
sl: Razmerje do obveznosti STO

en: Arbitration bodies set up under this Agreement shall not adjudicate disputes concerning each Party's rights and obligations under the Agreement establishing the WTO.
sl: Arbitražni organi, ustanovljeni na podlagi tega sporazuma, ne rešujejo sporov o pravicah in obveznostih vsake od pogodbenic v skladu s Sporazumom o ustanovitvi STO.

en: Recourse to the dispute settlement provisions of this Agreement shall be without prejudice to any action in the WTO framework, including dispute settlement action.
sl: Uporaba določb o reševanju sporov iz tega sporazuma ne posega v nobeno dejanje v okviru STO in ne v postopek reševanja sporov.

en: However, where a Party has, with regard to a particular measure, instituted a dispute settlement proceeding, either under Article 49(1) or under the Agreement establishing the WTO, it may not institute a dispute settlement proceeding regarding the same measure in the other forum until the first proceeding has ended.
sl: Toda kadar pogodbenica v zvezi z določenim ukrepom sproži postopek reševanja sporov, v skladu s členom 49(1) tega naslova ali v skladu s Sporazumom o ustanovitvi STO, ta ne more sprožiti postopka reševanja sporov glede istega ukrepa pri drugem sodišču, dokler se prvi postopek ne konča.

en: For purposes of this paragraph, dispute settlement proceedings under the Agreement establishing the WTO are deemed to be initiated by a Party request for the establishment of a panel under Article 6 of the Understanding on Rules and Procedures Governing the Settlement of Disputes of the WTO.
sl: Za namene tega odstavka velja, da se postopki reševanja sporov v skladu s Sporazumom o ustanovitvi STO sprožijo na zahtevo pogodbenice za ustanovitev senata iz člena 6 Dogovora STO o pravilih in postopkih za reševanje sporov.

en: Nothing in this Agreement shall preclude a Party from implementing the suspension of obligations authorised by the Dispute Settlement Body of the WTO.
sl: Nobena določba tega sporazuma pogodbenici ne preprečuje opustitve obveznosti, ki jo odobri Organ STO za poravnavo sporov.

en: Article 66
sl: Člen 66

en: Time-limits
sl: Časovni okvir

en: All time-limits laid down in this Title, including the limits for the arbitration panels to notify their rulings, shall be counted in calendar days from the day following the act or fact to which they refer.
sl: Vsi roki iz tega naslova, vključno z roki arbitražnih senatov za sporočanje njihovih odločitev, se štejejo v koledarskih dneh od dneva po aktu ali dejstvu, na katerega se nanašajo.

en: Any time-limit referred to in this Title may be extended by mutual agreement of the Parties.
sl: Kateri koli rok iz tega naslova se lahko podaljša z medsebojnim soglasjem pogodbenic.

en: Article 67
sl: Člen 67

en: Modification of Title V
sl: Sprememba naslova V

en: The EPA Committee and each Party may both take the initiative to request an amendment of this Title.
sl: Pobudo za vlogo za spremembo tega naslova lahko da Odbor SGP ali vsaka od pogodbenic.

en: The amendment requests will be examined by the EPA Committee.
sl: Vloge za spremembo bo proučil Odbor SGP.

en: The amendment will enter into force only after approval by both Parties.
sl: Sprememba bo začela veljati potem, ko jo bosta potrdili pogodbenici.

en: TITLE VI
sl: NASLOV VI

en: GENERAL EXCEPTIONS
sl: SPLOŠNE IZJEME

en: Article 68
sl: Člen 68

en: General exception clause
sl: Klavzula o splošnih izjemah

en: Subject to the requirement that such measures are not applied in a manner which would constitute a means of arbitrary or unjustifiable discrimination between the Parties where like conditions prevail, or a disguised restriction on trade in goods, services or establishment, nothing in this Agreement shall be construed to prevent the adoption or enforcement by the Parties of measures which:
sl: Pod pogojem, da se takšni ukrepi ne uporabljajo na način, ki bi pomenil sredstvo za samovoljno ali neupravičeno diskriminacijo med pogodbenicama, medtem ko morajo prevladovati enaki pogoji, ali prikrito omejevanje trgovine s proizvodi in storitvami ter ustanavljanja, se nobena določba tega sporazuma ne razlaga tako, da pogodbenicama preprečuje, da sprejmeta ali uporabljata ukrepe, ki:

en: are necessary to protect public security, public morals or to maintain public order;
sl: so potrebni za zaščito javne varnosti in javne morale ali za ohranjanje javnega reda in miru;

en: are necessary to protect human, animal or plant life or health;
sl: so potrebni za zaščito življenja ali zdravja ljudi, živali ali rastlin;

en: are necessary to secure compliance with laws or regulations which are not inconsistent with the provisions of this Agreement including those relating to:
sl: so potrebni za zagotovitev skladnosti z zakoni ali predpisi, ki niso v neskladju z določbami tega sporazuma, vključno s tistimi, ki se nanašajo na:

en: the prevention of deceptive and fraudulent practices or to deal with the effects of a default on contracts;
sl: preprečevanje varljivega in goljufivega ravnanja ali obravnavanje posledic neizpolnjevanja obveznosti iz pogodb;

en: the protection of the privacy of individuals in relation to the processing and dissemination of personal data and the protection of confidentiality of individual records and accounts;
sl: varovanje zasebnosti posameznikov v zvezi z obdelavo in razširjanjem osebnih podatkov ter varovanje zaupnosti dokumentacije in računov posameznikov;

en: safety;
sl: varnost;

en: customs enforcement; or
sl: carino ali

en: protection of intellectual property rights;
sl: varstvo pravic intelektualne lastnine;

en: relate to the importation or exportation of gold or silver;
sl: so povezani z uvozom ali izvozom zlata ali srebra;

en: are necessary to the protection of national treasures of artistic, historic or archaeological value;
sl: so potrebni za varstvo narodnega bogastva umetniške, zgodovinske ali arheološke vrednosti;

en: relate to the conservation of exhaustible natural resources if such measures are made effective in conjunction with restrictions on domestic production or consumption of goods, domestic supply or consumption of services and on domestic investors;
sl: so povezani z ohranjanjem neobnovljivih naravnih virov, če se takšni ukrepi uveljavijo v povezavi z omejevanjem domače proizvodnje ali porabe blaga, domače ponudbe ali uporabe storitev ter domačih vlagateljev;

en: relate to the products of prison labour; or
sl: so povezani s proizvodi, ki jih izdelujejo zaporniki, ali

en: are inconsistent with Article 19, provided that the difference in treatment is aimed at ensuring the effective or equitable imposition or collection of direct taxes in respect of economic activities, investors or service suppliers of the other Party.
sl: so v neskladju s členom 19, če je razlika v obravnavi namenjena zagotavljanju učinkovite ali pravične obdavčitve ali pobiranja neposrednih davkov od gospodarskih dejavnosti vlagateljev oziroma ponudnikov storitev druge pogodbenice.

en: Article 69
sl: Člen 69

en: Security exceptions
sl: Varnostne izjeme

en: Nothing in this Agreement shall be construed:
sl: Nobena določba tega sporazuma se ne razlaga tako, da:

en: to require the Parties to furnish any information the disclosure of which they consider contrary to their essential security interests;
sl: od pogodbenic zahteva, da razkrijeta informacije, za katere menita, da je njihovo razkritje v nasprotju z njunimi bistvenimi varnostnimi interesi;

en: to prevent the Parties from taking any action which they consider necessary for the protection of their essential security interests:
sl: pogodbenicama preprečuje, da ukrepata tako, kot menita, da je potrebno za zaščito njunih bistvenih varnostnih interesov:

en: relating to fissionable and fusionable materials or the materials from which they are derived;
sl: v zvezi s cepljivimi in fuzijskimi materiali ali z materiali, iz katerih so pridobljeni;

en: relating to economic activities carried out directly or indirectly for the purpose of supplying or provisioning a military establishment;
sl: v zvezi z gospodarskimi dejavnostmi, ki se izvajajo neposredno ali posredno z namenom preskrbe oziroma oskrbe vojaških sil;

en: connected with the production of or trade in arms, munitions and war materials;
sl: v zvezi s proizvodnjo ali trgovino z orožjem, strelivom in vojaškimi sredstvi;

en: relating to government procurement indispensable for national security or for national defence purposes; or
sl: v zvezi z vladnimi naročili, ki so nepogrešljiva za nacionalno varnost ali za namene obrambe države; ali

en: taken in time of war or other emergency in international relations; or
sl: med vojno ali v drugih izrednih razmerah v mednarodnih odnosih; ali

en: to prevent the Parties from taking any action in order to carry out obligations they have accepted for the purpose of maintaining international peace and security.
sl: pogodbenicama preprečuje ukrepanje z namenom izpolnjevanja obveznosti, ki sta jih sprejeli za ohranjanje mednarodnega miru in varnosti.

en: The Parties shall inform each other to the fullest extent possible of measures taken under paragraphs 1(b) and (c) and of their termination.
sl: Pogodbenici se medsebojno kar najpopolneje obveščata o ukrepih, sprejetih na podlagi odstavkov 1(b) in (c) tega člena, ter o njihovi opustitvi.

en: Article 70
sl: Člen 70

en: Taxation
sl: Obdavčenje

en: Nothing in this Agreement or in any arrangement adopted under this Agreement shall be construed to prevent the Parties from distinguishing, in the application of the relevant provisions of their fiscal legislation, between taxpayers who are not in the same situation, in particular with regard to their place of residence or with regard to the place where their capital is invested.
sl: Nobena določba tega sporazuma ali katerega koli dogovora, sklenjenega na podlagi tega sporazuma, se ne razlaga kot ovira za pogodbenici, da bi pri uporabi ustreznih določb svoje fiskalne zakonodaje razlikovali med davkoplačevalci, ki niso v enakem položaju, zlasti glede na njihov kraj stalnega bivališča ali glede na kraj, kjer je vložen njihov kapital.

en: Nothing in this Agreement or in any arrangement adopted under this Agreement shall be construed to prevent the adoption or enforcement of any measure aimed at preventing the avoidance or evasion of taxes pursuant to the tax provisions of agreements to avoid double taxation or other tax arrangements or domestic fiscal legislation.
sl: Nobena določba tega sporazuma ali katerega koli dogovora, sklenjenega na podlagi tega sporazuma, se ne razlaga tako, da preprečuje sprejetje ali uporabo ukrepov, namenjenih preprečevanju izogibanja ali utaje davkov v skladu z davčnimi določbami iz sporazumov o izogibanju dvojnega obdavčevanja ali z drugo davčno ureditvijo ali domačo fiskalno zakonodajo.

en: Nothing in this Agreement shall affect the rights and obligations of the Parties under any tax convention.
sl: Nobena določba tega sporazuma ne vpliva na pravice in obveznosti pogodbenic po kateri koli davčni konvenciji.

en: In the event of any inconsistency between this Agreement and any such convention, that convention shall prevail to the extent of the inconsistency.
sl: V primeru morebitne neskladnosti med tem sporazumom in katero koli takšno konvencijo v okviru te neskladnosti prevlada konvencija.

en: TITLE VII
sl: NASLOV VII

en: INSTITUTIONAL, GENERAL AND FINAL PROVISIONS
sl: INSTITUCIONALNE, SPLOŠNE IN KONČNE DOLOČBE

en: Article 71
sl: Člen 71

en: Modalities for the continuation of negotiations
sl: Načini za nadaljevanje pogajanj

en: The Parties will continue negotiations according to the provisions of the present Agreement.
sl: Pogodbenici nadaljujeta s pogajanji v skladu z določbami tega sporazuma.

en: When negotiations are complete, the resulting draft amendments shall be submitted for approval to the relevant domestic authorities.
sl: Po končanih pogajanjih se osnutki sprememb, ki so na njih doseženi, predložijo v odobritev pristojnim domačim organom.

en: Article 72
sl: Člen 72

en: Definition of the Parties and fulfilment of obligations
sl: Opredelitev pogodbenic in izpolnjevanje obveznosti

en: The Contracting Parties of this Agreement shall be the Republic of Ghana, referred to as the ‘Ghanaian Party’ or ‘Ghana’, of the one part, and the European Community or its Member States or the European Community and its Member States, within their respective areas of competence as derived from the Treaty establishing the European Community, referred to as the ‘EC Party’ or the European Community, of the other part.
sl: Pogodbenici tega sporazuma sta Republika Gana, v nadaljnjem besedilu: pogodbenica Gana ali Gana, na eni strani in Evropska skupnost ali njene države članice ali Evropska skupnost in njene države članice na svojih področjih pristojnosti iz Pogodbe o ustanovitvi Evropske skupnosti, v nadaljnjem besedilu: pogodbenica ES ali Evropska skupnost, na drugi strani.

en: For the purposes of this Agreement, the term ‘Party’ shall refer to the Ghanaian Party or to the EC Party as the case may be.
sl: V tem sporazumu se izraz „pogodbenica“ nanaša bodisi na pogodbenico Gano ali na pogodbenico ES.

en: The term ‘Parties’ shall refer to the Ghanaian Party and the EC Party.
sl: Izraz „pogodbenici“ se nanaša na pogodbenico Gano in pogodbenico ES.

en: The Parties shall adopt any general or specific measures required for them to fulfil their obligations under this Agreement and shall ensure that they comply with the objectives laid down in this Agreement.
sl: Pogodbenici sprejmeta vse splošne ali posebne ukrepe, potrebne za izpolnjevanje njunih obveznosti iz tega sporazuma, in skrbita za doseganje njegovih ciljev.

en: Article 73
sl: Člen 73

en: EPA Committee
sl: Odbor SGP

en: For the purposes of implementing this Agreement, an EPA Committee will be established within three months from the date of signature of this Agreement.
sl: Za izvajanje tega sporazuma se ustanovi Odbor SGP v treh mesecih po podpisu tega sporazuma.

en: The Parties agree that the composition, organisation and operation of this EPA Committee will respect the principle of equality.
sl: Pogodbenici se dogovorita, da pri sestavi, organizaciji in delovanju Odbora SGP upoštevata načelo enakosti.

en: The Committee will determine its organisation and functioning rules.
sl: Odbor določi svoja pravila organizacije in delovanja.

en: The EPA Committee is responsible for the administration in all fields covered by this Agreement and the achievement of all tasks mentioned in this Agreement.
sl: Odbor SGP je odgovoren za upravljanje vseh področij, zajetih v tem sporazumu, in izvajanje vseh nalog, navedenih v tem sporazumu.

en: In order to ease communication and ensure an effective implementation of the present Agreement, each Party will designate a focal point within the Committee.
sl: Za lažjo komunikacijo in zagotavljanje učinkovitega izvajanja tega sporazuma vsaka pogodbenica določi svojo kontaktno točko v Odboru.

en: The EPA Committee meetings may be open to third parties.
sl: Seje Odbora SGP so lahko odprte za tretje osebe.

en: The ECOWAS Commission may be invited to the EPA Committee meetings, according to its internal procedures.
sl: Komisija ECOWAS je lahko povabljena na seje Odbora SGP glede na njene notranje postopke.

en: Article 74
sl: Člen 74

en: Outermost regions of the European Community
sl: Najbolj obrobne regije Evropske skupnosti

en: Taking account of the geographical proximity of the outermost regions of the European Community and Ghana and in order to reinforce economic and social links between these regions and Ghana, the Parties shall endeavour to facilitate cooperation in all areas covered by this Agreement as well as to facilitate trade in goods and services, promote investments and encourage transport and communication links between the outermost regions and Ghana.
sl: Ob upoštevanju geografske bližine najbolj obrobnih regij Evropske skupnosti in Gane ter z namenom krepitve gospodarskih in socialnih povezav med temi regijami in Gano si pogodbenici prizadevata pospeševati sodelovanje na vseh področjih, ki jih zajema ta sporazum, olajševati trgovino z blagom in storitvami, pa tudi spodbujati naložbe ter prometne in komunikacijske povezave med najbolj obrobnimi regijami in Gano.

en: The objectives enunciated in paragraph 1 shall also be pursued, wherever possible, through fostering the joint participation of Ghana and the outermost regions in framework and specific programmes of the European Community in areas covered by this Agreement.
sl: Cilji, izraženi v odstavku 1, se prav tako uresničujejo, kadar koli je to mogoče, s spodbujanjem skupnega nastopa Gane in najbolj obrobnih regij v okvirnih in posebnih programih Evropske skupnosti na področjih, ki jih zajema ta sporazum.

en: The EC Party shall endeavour to ensure coordination between the different financial instruments of the European Community's cohesion and development policies in order to foster cooperation between Ghana and the outermost regions of the European Community in the areas covered by this Agreement.
sl: Pogodbenica ES si prizadeva zagotoviti usklajenost različnih finančnih instrumentov kohezijske in razvojne politike Evropske skupnosti ter tako pospešiti sodelovanje med Gano in najbolj obrobnimi regijami Evropske skupnosti na področjih, ki jih zajema ta sporazum.

en: Nothing in this Agreement shall prevent the EC Party from applying existing measures aimed at addressing the structural social and economic situation of the outermost region pursuant to Article 299(2) of the Treaty establishing the European Community.
sl: Nobena določba tega sporazuma pogodbenici ES ne preprečuje izvajanja obstoječih ukrepov, katerih cilj je reševanje strukturno pogojenih socialnih in gospodarskih razmer najbolj obrobnih regij skladno s členom 299(2) Pogodbe o ustanovitvi Evropske skupnosti.

en: Article 75
sl: Člen 75

en: Entry into force and duration
sl: Začetek veljavnosti in trajanje

en: This Agreement shall be signed, ratified or approved according to applicable constitutional rules specific to each Party or, as far as the EC Party is concerned, to internal rules and procedures.
sl: Ta sporazum se podpiše, ratificira ali odobri v skladu z veljavnimi posebnimi ustavnimi pravili vsake pogodbenice, kar zadeva pogodbenico ES pa v skladu z notranjimi pravili in postopki.

en: This Agreement shall enter into force the first day of the month following that in which the Ghanaian Party and the EC Party have notified each other of the completion of the procedures necessary for this purpose.
sl: Ta sporazum začne veljati prvi dan v mesecu, ki sledi mesecu, v katerem sta se pogodbenica Gana in pogodbenica ES uradno obvestili o končanju postopkov, ki so potrebni v ta namen.

en: Notifications shall be sent to the Secretary-General of the Council of the European Union, who shall be the depository of this Agreement.
sl: Uradna obvestila se pošljejo generalnemu sekretarju Sveta Evropske unije, ki je depozitar tega sporazuma.

en: Pending entry into force of the Agreement, the Parties shall agree to apply it provisionally in accordance with their respective laws or by ratification of the Agreement.
sl: Do začetka veljavnosti tega sporazuma pogodbenici soglašata, da ga začasno uporabljata skladno s svojimi zakoni ali z ratifikacijo sporazuma.

en: Provisional application shall be notified to the depositary.
sl: O začasni uporabi je treba uradno obvestiti depozitarja.

en: The Agreement shall be applied provisionally ten days after the latter of the receipt of notification of provisional application by the European Community or the Ghanaian Party.
sl: Sporazum se začne začasno uporabljati 10 dni po tem, ko pogodbenica Evropska skupnost ali pogodbenica Gana prejme uradno obvestilo o začetku začasne uporabe.

en: Notwithstanding paragraph 4, the EC Party and Ghana may apply the Agreement, in whole or in part, before provisional application, to the extent that this is possible under their domestic law.
sl: Ne glede na odstavek 4 lahko pogodbenica ES in Gana sporazum uporabljata delno ali v celoti pred njegovo začasno uporabo, če to omogoča njuno notranje pravo.

en: Either Party may give written notice to the other of its intention to denounce this Agreement.
sl: Katera koli pogodbenica lahko drugo pogodbenico pisno obvesti, da namerava odpovedati ta sporazum.

en: Denunciation takes effect six months after notification by the other Party.
sl: Odpoved začne veljati šest mesecev po uradnem obvestilu druge pogodbenice.

en: This Agreement will be superseded by a global EPA concluded at regional level with the EC Party at its date of its entry into force.
sl: Ta sporazum bo zamenjan s celovitim SGP, sklenjenim na regionalni ravni s pogodbenico ES, z datumom začetka veljavnosti Sporazuma.

en: In this case, the Parties will endeavour to ensure that the EPA at regional level preserves most of the benefits obtained by Ghana through this Agreement.
sl: V tem primeru si pogodbenici prizadevata zagotoviti, da SGP na regionalni ravni ohrani bistvene pravice, ki jih je Gana pridobila s tem sporazumom.

en: Article 76
sl: Člen 76

en: Territorial application
sl: Teritorialna uporaba

en: This Agreement shall apply, on the one hand, to the territories in which the Treaty establishing the European Community is applied and under the conditions laid down in that Treaty, and, on the other hand, to Ghana.
sl: Ta sporazum se na eni strani uporablja za ozemlja, na katerih se uporablja Pogodba o ustanovitvi Evropske skupnosti in pod pogoji, določenimi v navedeni pogodbi, ter na drugi strani v Gani.

en: Article 77
sl: Člen 77

en: Accession of new EU Member States
sl: Pristop novih držav članic EU

en: The EPA Committee shall be advised of any request made by a third State to become a member of the European Union (EU).
sl: Odbor SGP se obvesti o vseh prošnjah tretjih držav za članstvo v Evropski uniji (EU).

en: During the negotiations between the Union and the applicant State, the EC Party shall provide Ghana with any relevant information and it in turn shall convey its concerns to the EC Party so that it can take them fully into account.
sl: V času pogajanj med Unijo in državo prosilko pogodbenica ES posreduje Gani vse ustrezne informacije, ta pa pogodbenici ES posreduje svoje interese, tako da jih ta lahko v celoti upošteva.

en: Ghana shall be notified by the EC Party of any accession to the EU.
sl: Pogodbenica ES obvesti Gano o vsakem morebitnem pristopu k EU.

en: Any new Member State of the EU shall accede to this Agreement from the date of its accession to the EU by means of a clause to that effect in the act of accession.
sl: Vsaka nova država članica EU pristopi k temu sporazumu z dnem pristopa k EU z ustrezno klavzulo v aktu o pristopu.

en: If the act of accession to the Union does not provide for such automatic accession of the EU Member State to this Agreement, the EU Member State concerned shall accede by depositing an act of accession with the General Secretariat of the Council of the European Union, which shall send certified copies to the Ghanaian Party.
sl: Če akt o pristopu k Uniji ne določa takega avtomatičnega pristopa države članice EU k temu sporazumu, zadevna država članica EU pristopi tako, da akt o pristopu deponira pri Generalnem sekretariatu Sveta Evropske unije, ta pa pošlje overjene kopije pogodbenici Gani.

en: The Parties shall review the effects of the accession of new EU Member States on this Agreement.
sl: Pogodbenici proučita učinke pristopa novih držav članic EU na ta sporazum.

en: The EPA Committee may decide on any transitional or amending measures that might be necessary.
sl: Odbor SGP lahko odloči o prehodnih ukrepih ali potrebnih spremembah.

en: Article 78
sl: Člen 78

en: Dialogue on finance issues
sl: Dialog o finančnih vprašanjih

en: The Parties agree to foster dialogue, transparency and to share best practices in the area of tax policy and administration.
sl: Pogodbenici soglašata, da bosta spodbujali dialog, preglednost in izmenjavo najboljših praks na področju davčne politike in uprave.

en: Article 79
sl: Člen 79

en: Collaboration in the fight against illegal financial activities
sl: Sodelovanje v boju proti ilegalnim finančnim dejavnostim

en: The EC Party and Ghana are committed to prevent and fight against illegal, fraudulent and corrupt activities, money laundering and terrorist financing and shall take the necessary legislative and administrative measures to comply with international standards, including those laid down in the United Nations Convention against Corruption, the United Nations Convention against Transnational Organised Crime and its Protocols, the United Nations Convention for the Suppression of Terrorist Financing and the Financial Action Task Force recommendations.
sl: Pogodbenica ES in Gana sta zavezani preprečevanju in boju proti ilegalnim, goljufivim in nepoštenim dejavnostim, pranju denarja in financiranju terorizma ter sprejmeta potrebne zakonodajne in upravne ukrepe za izpolnitev mednarodnih standardov, vključno s tistimi iz Konvencije Združenih narodov proti korupciji, Konvencije Združenih narodov proti mednarodnemu organiziranemu kriminalu in njenimi protokoli, Konvencije Združenih narodov o zatiranju financiranja terorizma ter priporočili delovne skupine za finančno ukrepanje.

en: The EC Party and Ghana agree to exchange information and cooperate in these areas.
sl: Pogodbenica ES in Gana se dogovorita za izmenjavo informacij in sodelovanje na teh področjih.

en: Article 80
sl: Člen 80

en: Relations with other agreements
sl: Razmerje do drugih sporazumov

en: With the exception of development cooperation provided for in Title II of Part 3 of the Cotonou Agreement, in case of any inconsistency between the provisions of this Agreement and the provisions of Title II of Part 3 of the Cotonou Agreement the provisions of this Agreement shall prevail.
sl: Z izjemo razvojnega sodelovanja iz naslova II dela III Sporazuma iz Cotonouja, v primeru morebitne neskladnosti med določbami tega sporazuma in določbami iz naslova II dela III Sporazuma iz Cotonouja prevladajo določbe tega sporazuma.

en: Nothing in this Agreement shall be construed so as to prevent the adoption by the European Community or by Ghana of any measures, including trade and trade-related measures, deemed appropriate as provided for under Articles 11b, 96 and 97 of the Cotonou Agreement.
sl: Nobena določba iz tega sporazuma se ne razlaga tako, da Evropski skupnosti ali Gani preprečuje sprejetje potrebnih ukrepov, vključno s trgovinskimi ukrepi in ukrepi v zvezi s trgovino, ki so določeni v členih 11b, 96 in 97 Sporazuma iz Cotonouja.

en: The Parties agree that nothing in this Agreement requires them to act in a manner inconsistent with their WTO obligations.
sl: Pogodbenici se strinjata, da nobena določba tega sporazuma od njiju ne zahteva, da ravnata na način, ki bi bil v neskladju z njunimi obveznostmi v okviru STO.

en: Article 81
sl: Člen 81

en: Authentic texts
sl: Verodostojna besedila

en: This Agreement is drawn up in duplicate in the Bulgarian, Czech, Danish, Dutch, English, Estonian, Finnish, French, German, Greek, Hungarian, Italian, Latvian, Lithuanian, Maltese, Polish, Portuguese, Romanian, Slovak, Slovenian, Spanish and Swedish languages, each of these texts being equally authentic.
sl: Ta sporazum je sestavljen v dveh izvodih v angleškem, bolgarskem, češkem, danskem, estonskem, finskem, francoskem, grškem, italijanskem, latvijskem, litovskem, madžarskem, malteškem, nemškem, nizozemskem, poljskem, portugalskem, romunskem, slovaškem, slovenskem, španskem in švedskem jeziku, pri čemer je vsako od teh besedil enako verodostojno.

en: Article 82
sl: Člen 82

en: Annexes
sl: Priloge

en: The Annexes and Protocol to this Agreement shall form an integral part thereof.
sl: Priloge in Protokol k Sporazumu sta njegov sestavni del.

en: In witness whereof, the undersigned Plenipotentiaries have affixed their signatures below this Agreement.
sl: V potrditev tega so spodaj podpisani pooblaščenci podpisali ta sporazum.

en: For this calculation official data by the WTO on leading exporters in world merchandise trade (excluding intra-EU trade) shall be used.
sl: Za ta izračun se uporabljajo uradni podatki STO o vodilnih izvoznikih v svetovnem trgovanju z blagom (brez trgovine znotraj EU).

en: For the purpose of this Article agricultural products are those covered by Annex I of the WTO Agreement on Agriculture.
sl: Za namene tega člena so kmetijski proizvodi, ki jih zajema Priloga I Sporazuma STO o kmetijstvu.

en: Appendix I
sl: Dodatek I

en: PRIORITY PRODUCTS FOR EXPORT FROM GHANA TO THE EC
sl: PREDNOSTNI PROIZVODI ZA IZVOZ IZ GANE V ES

en: These products will be identified by Ghana and notified to the EPA Committee not later than three months from the date of signature of the present Agreement.
sl: Te proizvode bo opredelila Gana in o njih najpozneje v treh mesecih od datuma podpisa tega sporazuma uradno obvestila Odbor SGP.

en: The EPA Committee will adopt the list of products.
sl: Odbor SGP bo sprejel seznam proizvodov.

en: Appendix II
sl: Dodatek II

en: COMPETENT AUTHORITIES
sl: PRISTOJNI ORGANI

en: A. Competent authorities of the European Community
sl: A. Pristojni organi Evropske skupnosti

en: Control is shared between the national services of the Member States and the European Commission.
sl: Dejavnosti nadzora si delijo nacionalne službe v posameznih državah članicah in Evropska komisija.

en: In this respect the following applies:
sl: V tem smislu velja naslednje:

en: As regards exports to Ghana, the EC Member States are responsible for control of the production circumstances and requirements, including statutory inspections and issuing health (or animal welfare) certifications attesting to the agreed standards and requirements;
sl: Kar zadeva izvoz v Gano, so države članice ES odgovorne za nadzor proizvodnih pogojev in zahtev, zlasti izvajanje obveznih inšpekcijskih pregledov ter izdajo sanitarnih potrdil (ali o dobrem počutju živali), ki dokazujejo upoštevanje dogovorjenih standardov in zahtev.

en: As regards imports from Ghana, the Member States are responsible for control of the compliance of the imports with the Community's import conditions;
sl: Kar zadeva uvoz iz Gane, so države članice odgovorne za nadzor skladnosti tega uvoza z uvoznimi pogoji Skupnosti.

en: The European Commission is responsible for overall coordination, inspection/audits of inspection systems and the necessary legislative action to ensure uniform application of standards and requirements within the internal EC market.
sl: Evropska komisija je odgovorna za splošno usklajevanje, nadzor/revizijo kontrolnih sistemov ter sprejetje potrebnih zakonskih ukrepov, potrebnih za zagotavljanje enotne uporabe standardov in zahtev na notranjem trgu ES.

en: B. Competent authorities of Ghana
sl: B. Pristojni organi Gane

en: These authorities will be designated by Ghana and notified to the EPA Committee not later than three months from the date of signature of the present Agreement.
sl: Te organe bo določila Gana in o njih najpozneje v treh mesecih od datuma podpisa tega sporazuma uradno obvestila Odbor SGP.

en: The EPA Committee will adopt an amended appendix.
sl: Odbor SGP bo sprejel potrebne spremembe Dodatka.

en: ANNEX 1
sl: PRILOGA 1

en: CUSTOMS DUTIES ON PRODUCTS ORIGINATING IN GHANA
sl: CARINE NA PROIZVODE S POREKLOM IZ GANE

en: Without prejudice to paragraphs 2, 4, 5, 6 and 7 customs duties of the EC Party (hereinafter referred to as ‘EC customs duties’) shall be entirely eliminated on all products of Chapters 1 to 97 of the Harmonised System, except those of Chapter 93 thereof, originating in Ghana upon the entry into force of this Agreement.
sl: Brez poseganja v odstavke 2, 4, 5, 6 in 7 se carine pogodbenice ES (v nadaljnjem besedilu: carine ES) v celoti odpravijo z datumom začetka veljavnosti tega sporazuma za vse proizvode s poreklom iz Gane iz poglavij 1 do 97 harmoniziranega sistema, razen proizvodov iz poglavja 93.

en: For products of Chapter 93 the EC Party shall continue to impose the applied Most Favoured Nation (MFN) duties.
sl: Za proizvode iz poglavja 93 pogodbenica ES še naprej uporablja dajatve za države z največjimi ugodnostmi (MFN).

en: EC customs duties on the products of tariff heading 1006 originating in Ghana shall be eliminated as from 1 January 2010, with the exception of EC customs duties on the products of subheading 10061010 which shall be eliminated as from the entry into force of this Agreement.
sl: Carine ES na proizvode iz tarifne številke 1006 s poreklom iz Gane se odpravijo s 1. januarjem 2010, razen carin ES na proizvode iz tarifne podštevilke 10061010, ki se odpravijo z dnem začetka veljavnosti tega sporazuma.

en: The EC Party may, during the period between 1 October 2009 and 30 September 2015 impose the applied MFN duty on the products originating in Ghana of tariff heading 1701 [sugar] imported in excess of the following levels expressed in white sugar equivalent, which are deemed to cause a disturbance in the EC Party sugar market:
sl: Pogodbenica ES lahko v obdobju med 1. oktobrom 2009 in 30. septembrom 2015 uvede dajatev MFN za proizvode s poreklom iz Gane iz tarifne številke 1701 za uvoženi [sladkor], ki presega naslednje količine, izražene v protivrednosti belega sladkorja, za katere se šteje, da bodo na trgu sladkorja pogodbenice ES povzročile motnje:

en: 3,5 million tonnes in a marketing year of such products originating in States members of the African, Caribbean and Pacific Group of States (ACP States) signatory to the Cotonou Agreement; and
sl: 3,5 milijona ton v tržnem letu takih proizvodov s poreklom iz držav članic afriške, karibske in pacifiške skupine držav (države AKP), ki so podpisnice sporazuma iz Cotonouja, in

en: 1,38 million tonnes in marketing year 2009/2010 of such products originating in ACP States that are not recognised by the UN as least developed countries.
sl: 1,38 milijona ton v tržnem letu 2009/2010 takih proizvodov s poreklom iz držav AKP, ki jih ZN ne priznavajo kot najmanj razvite države.

en: The figure of 1,38 million tonnes shall increase to 1,45 million tonnes in marketing year 2010/2011, and 1,6 million tonnes in the following four marketing years;
sl: Količina 1,3 milijona ton se bo povečala na 1,45 milijona ton v tržnem letu 2010/2011 in na 1,6 milijona ton v naslednjih štirih tržnih letih.

en: The importation of products of tariff heading 1701 originating in any signatory West African State that is recognised by the UN as a least developed country shall not be subject to the provisions of subparagraph 5(a).
sl: Za uvoz izdelkov iz tarifne številke 1701 s poreklom iz katere koli zahodnoafriške države podpisnice, ki jo ZN priznavajo kot najmanj razvito državo, ne veljajo določbe pododstavka 5(a).

en: However, such imports shall remain subject to the provisions of Article 25 [1];
sl: Vendar za tak uvoz veljajo določbe člena 25 [1].

en: The imposition of the applied MFN duty shall cease at the end of the marketing year during which it was introduced;
sl: Naložitev veljavne dajatve MFN preneha ob koncu tržnega leta, med katerim je bila uvedena.

en: Any measure taken pursuant to this paragraph shall be notified immediately to the EPA Committee and shall be the subject of periodic consultations within that body.
sl: Vse ukrepe, ki se sprejmejo v skladu s tem odstavkom, je treba takoj sporočiti Odboru SGP, v katerem o njih redno potekajo posvetovanja.

en: As of 1 October 2015, for the purpose of the application of the provisions of Article 25 disturbances in the markets of products of tariff heading 1701 may be deemed to arise in situations where the European Community market price of white sugar falls during two consecutive months below 80 percent of the European Community market price for white sugar prevailing during the previous marketing year.
sl: Od 1. oktobra 2015 se lahko za namen uporabe določb člena 25 šteje, da bodo na trgih proizvodov s tarifno številko 1701 nastale motnje v razmerah, če tržna cena Evropske skupnosti za beli sladkor v dveh zaporednih mesecih pade pod 80 odstotkov tržne cene Evropske skupnosti za beli sladkor iz prejšnjega tržnega leta.

en: From 1 January 2008 until 30 September 2015 products of tariff heading 17049099, 18061030, 18061090, 21069059 and 21069098 shall be subject to a special surveillance mechanism in order to ensure the arrangements provided for in paragraphs 4 and 5 are not circumvented.
sl: Od 1. januarja 2008 do 30. septembra 2015 se za proizvode iz tarifnih številk 17049099, 18061030, 18061090, 21069059 in 21069098 uporabi poseben nadzorni mehanizem, da se prepreči izogibanje določbam v odstavkih 4 in 5.

en: In the event of a cumulative increase of imports of such products originating in Ghana by more than 20 percent in volume during a period of 12 consecutive months compared to the average of the yearly imports over the three previous 12-month periods, the EC Party shall analyse the pattern of trade, the economic justification and the sugar content of such imports and, if it considers that such imports are used to circumvent the arrangements provided for in paragraphs 4 and 5, it may suspend the preferential treatment and introduce the specific MFN duty applied to imports pursuant to the European Community Common Customs Tariff for products of tariff heading 17049099, 18061030, 18061090, 21069059 and 21069098 originating in Ghana.
sl: Če se obseg uvoza teh proizvodov s poreklom iz Gane v obdobju 12 zaporednih mesecev skupno poveča za več kot 20 odstotkov v primerjavi s povprečjem letnega uvoza v prejšnjih treh 12-mesečnih obdobjih, pogodbenica ES prouči strukturo trgovanja, gospodarsko upravičenost in količino sladkorja v okviru takega uvoza, in če ugotovi, da se tak uvoz uporablja za izogibanje ureditvam iz odstavkov 4 in 5, lahko začasno prekine preferencialno obravnavo in uvede posebno dajatev MFN, ki se v skladu s Skupno carinsko tarifo Evropske skupnosti uporablja za uvoz proizvodov iz tarifnih številk 17049099, 18061030, 18061090, 21069059 in 21069098 s poreklom iz Gane.

en: Subparagraph 5(b), (c) and (d) shall apply mutatis mutandis to action under this paragraph.
sl: Za ukrepe po tem odstavku se smiselno uporabljajo pododstavki 5(b), (c) in (d).

en: Between 1 October 2009 and 30 September 2012 with regard to the products of tariff heading 1701, no preferential import license shall be granted unless the importer undertakes to purchase such products at a price not lower than 90 percent of the reference price set by the EC Party for the relevant marketing year.
sl: Od 1. oktobra 2009 do 30. septembra 2012 se v zvezi s proizvodi iz tarifne številke 1701 ne podeli nobeno uvozno dovoljenje, razen če se uvoznik obveže, da bo te proizvode kupil po ceni, ki ni nižja od 90 odstotkov referenčne cene, ki jo pogodbenica ES določi za zadevno tržno leto.

en: Paragraph 1 shall not apply to products of tariff heading 08030019 originating in Ghana and released for free circulation in the outermost regions of the EC.
sl: Odstavek 1 ne velja za proizvode iz tarifne številke 08030019 s poreklom iz Gane, ki so sproščeni v prosti promet v najbolj obrobne regije ES.

en: Paragraphs 1, 3 and 4 shall not apply to the products of tariff heading 1701 originating in Ghana and released for free circulation in the French Overseas Departments.
sl: Odstavki 1, 3 in 4 ne veljajo za proizvode iz tarifne številke 1701 s poreklom iz Gane, ki so v prostem prometu v francoskih čezmorskih departmajih.

en: This provision shall be applicable for a period of ten years.
sl: Ta določba velja 10 let.

en: This period shall be extended for a further period of ten years unless the Parties agree otherwise.
sl: Navedeno obdobje se podaljša za nadaljnjih 10 let, če se pogodbenici ne dogovorita drugače.

en: For this purpose and by derogation to Article 25, any individual West African State recognised by the United Nations as a least developed country may be subject to safeguard measures.
sl: Za ta namen in ne glede na člen 25 so lahko posamezne zahodnoafriške države, ki jih Združeni narodi priznavajo kot najmanj razvite države, predmet zaščitnih ukrepov.

en: ANNEX 2
sl: PRILOGA 2

en: CUSTOMS DUTIES ON PRODUCTS ORIGINATING IN THE EC PARTY
sl: CARINE NA PROIZVODE S POREKLOM IZ POGODBENICE ES

en: Ghana establishes a liberalisation schedule for products originating in the EC imported in Ghana territory which comprises four groups of products:
sl: Gana določi za proizvode s poreklom iz ES, ki se uvažajo na ozemlje Gane, časovni razpored liberalizacije, ki zajema 4 skupine proizvodov:

en: for the Group A, the liberalisation will be completed by 1 January 2013,
sl: za skupino A se bo liberalizacija zaključila 1. januarja 2013;

en: for the Group B, which includes mainly raw material and equipment for existing and infant industries, the liberalisation will start on 1 January 2013 to be completed by 31 December 2017,
sl: za skupino B, ki vključuje predvsem surovine ter opremo za obstoječo industrijo in mlade gospodarske panoge, se bo liberalizacija začela 1. januarja 2013 in zaključila 31. decembra 2017;

en: for the Group C, which includes goods with a high fiscal revenue value, the liberalisation will start on 1 January 2018 to be completed by 31 December 2022,
sl: za skupino C, ki vključuje blago z visokim davčnim prihodkom, se bo liberalizacija začela 1. januarja 2018 in zaključila 31. decembra 2022;

en: the products of Group D will be excluded from the scope of liberalisation.
sl: obravnava proizvodov iz skupine D se ne liberalizira.

en: Any further liberalisation will be implemented in line with Ghana's development objectives after a period of not less than 25 years.
sl: Vsaka nadaljnja liberalizacija bo potekala v skladu z razvojnimi cilji Gane po obdobju najmanj 25 let.

en: Sensitive products in this category relate to livelihoods, food security, rural development particularly in agriculture and agro-processing as well as infant industries products, high-revenue goods to mitigate the potential net fiscal impact and luxury goods.
sl: Občutljivi proizvodi v tej kategoriji so proizvodi, ki so povezani s preživljanjem, varno preskrbo s hrano, razvojem podeželja zlasti na področju kmetijstva in predelave kmetijskih proizvodov, proizvodi mladih gospodarskih panog, blago z visokim davčnim prihodkom za ublažitev možnih neto fiskalnih posledic in luksuzno blago.

en: The Export Development and Investment Fund (EDIF) Levy is backed by the Export Development and Investment Fund Act 582 of 2000.
sl: Dajatev za Export Development and Investment Fund (EDIF) temelji na zakonu št. 582 iz leta 2000 o izvoznem razvojnem in investicijskem skladu (Export Development and Investment Fund Act).

en: It is imposed on all imports at the rate of 0,5 % CIF with the objective of generating funds to stimulate the export sector and support trade in general.
sl: Naloži se za vse uvoze v višini 0,5 % cene CIF z namenom zbiranja sredstev za spodbujanje izvoznega sektorja in podporo trgovini na splošno.

en: This levy is not included in the base duties listed in the liberalisation schedule hereafter.
sl: Ta dajatev ni vključena med osnovne dajatve, ki so naštete v časovnem razporedu liberalizacije v nadaljevanju.

en: The Ghanaian Party may maintain this levy until 31 December 2017 and shall therefore eliminate it on 1 January 2018 at the latest Cooperation in respect to financial adjustment in Article 8 of this Agreement shall also apply to the elimination of this levy.
sl: Pogodbenica Gana lahko to dajatev ohrani do 31. decembra 2017 in jo mora torej odpraviti najkasneje 1. januarja 2018. Sodelovanje v zvezi s finančnim prilagajanjem iz člena 8 tega sporazuma se uporablja tudi po odpravi te dajatve.

en: PROTOCOL
sl: PROTOKOL

en: on mutual administrative assistance in customs matters
sl: o medsebojni upravni pomoči v carinskih zadevah

en: Definitions
sl: Opredelitev pojmov

en: For the purposes of this Protocol:
sl: V tem protokolu:

en: ‘customs legislation’ means any legal or regulatory provisions applicable in the territories of Ghana or the EC Party, governing the import, export and transit of goods and their placing under any other customs regime or procedure, including measures of prohibition, restriction and control;
sl: „carinska zakonodaja“ pomeni vse zakonske ali druge določbe, ki se uporabljajo na ozemlju Gane ali ES in urejajo uvoz, izvoz in tranzit blaga ter dajanje blaga v kateri koli carinski postopek, vključno z ukrepi o prepovedi, omejevanju in nadzoru;

en: ‘applicant authority’ means a competent administrative authority which has been designated by Ghana or the EC Party for this purpose and which makes a request for assistance on the basis of this Protocol;
sl: „organ prosilec“ je pristojni upravni organ, ki ga Gana ali ES imenujeta v ta namen in zaprosi za pomoč na podlagi tega protokola;

en: ‘requested authority’ means a competent administrative authority which has been designated by Ghana or the EC Party for this purpose and which receives a request for assistance on the basis of this Protocol;
sl: „zaprošeni organ“ je pristojni upravni organ, ki ga Gana ali ES imenujeta v ta namen in prejme zaprosilo za pomoč na podlagi tega protokola;

en: ‘personal data’ means all information relating to an identified or identifiable individual;
sl: „osebni podatki“ pomenijo vse podatke, ki se nanašajo na določenega ali določljivega posameznika;

en: ‘operation in breach of customs legislation’ means any violation or attempted violation of customs legislation.
sl: „dejanje, ki krši carinsko zakonodajo“ pomeni vsako kršitev ali vsak poskus kršitve carinske zakonodaje.

en: The Parties shall assist each other, in the areas within their competence, in the manner and under the conditions laid down in this Protocol, to ensure the correct application of the customs legislation, in particular by preventing, investigating and combating operations in breach of that legislation.
sl: Pogodbenici si v okviru svojih pristojnosti medsebojno pomagata na način in pod pogoji, določenimi s tem protokolom, da zagotovita pravilno uporabo carinske zakonodaje, zlasti s preprečevanjem in preiskavo dejanj, s katerimi se krši carinska zakonodaja, ter z bojem proti takšnim dejanjem.

en: Assistance in customs matters, as provided for in this Protocol, shall apply to any administrative authority of the Parties which is competent for the application of this Protocol.
sl: Pomoč v carinskih zadevah, predvidena s tem protokolom, velja za kateri koli upravni organ pogodbenic, ki je pristojen za uporabo tega protokola.

en: It shall not prejudice the rules governing mutual assistance in criminal matters.
sl: Ne posega v predpise, ki urejajo medsebojno pomoč v kazenskih zadevah.

en: Nor shall it cover information obtained under powers exercised at the request of a judicial authority, except where communication of such information is authorised by that authority.
sl: Prav tako ne zajema informacij, pridobljenih po pooblastilih, ki se izvajajo na zahtevo pravosodnega organa, razen če navedeni organ to dovoli.

en: Assistance to recover duties, taxes or fines is not covered by this Protocol.
sl: Ta protokol ne zajema pomoči pri pobiranju carin, davkov ali denarnih kazni.

en: Assistance on request
sl: Pomoč na podlagi zaprosila

en: At the request of the applicant authority, the requested authority shall provide it with all relevant information which may enable it to ensure that customs legislation is correctly applied, including information regarding activities noted or planned which are or could be operations in breach of customs legislation.
sl: Na prošnjo organa prosilca mu zaprošeni organ priskrbi vse ustrezne informacije, ki prvemu lahko omogočijo, da zagotovi pravilno uporabo carinske zakonodaje, vključno z informacijami o ugotovljenih ali načrtovanih dejavnostih, s katerimi se krši ali bi se lahko kršila carinska zakonodaja.

en: At the request of the applicant authority, the requested authority shall inform it:
sl: Na prošnjo organa prosilca ga zaprošeni organ obvesti:

en: whether goods exported from the territory of one of the Parties have been properly imported into the territory of the other Party, specifying, where appropriate, the customs procedure applied to the goods;
sl: če je blago, ki se je izvozilo iz območja ene od pogodbenic, bilo pravilno uvoženo na območje druge pogodbenice, z navedbo, kjer je to primerno, carinskega postopka, uporabljenega za blago;

en: whether goods imported into the territory of the Party have been properly exported from the territory of the other Party, specifying, where appropriate, the customs procedure applied to the goods.
sl: ali je bilo blago, uvoženo na ozemlje pogodbenice, pravilno izvoženo z ozemlja druge pogodbenice ter, če je to primerno, navede, kateri carinski postopek je bil uporabljen za blago.

en: At the request of the applicant authority, the requested authority shall, within the framework of its legal or regulatory provisions, take the necessary steps to ensure special surveillance of:
sl: Na zahtevo organa prosilca zaprošeni organ v skladu s svojimi zakoni ali drugimi predpisi sprejme vse potrebne ukrepe za zagotovitev posebnega nadzora nad:

en: natural or legal persons in respect of whom there are reasonable grounds for believing that they are or have been involved in operations in breach of customs legislation;
sl: fizičnimi ali pravnimi osebami, za katere obstaja utemeljen sum, da so ali so bile vpletene v dejanja, ki kršijo carinsko zakonodajo;

en: places where stocks of goods have been or may be assembled in such a way that there are reasonable grounds for believing that these goods are intended to be used in operations in breach of customs legislation;
sl: kraji, kjer se zaloge blaga zbirajo ali bi se lahko zbirale tako, da obstaja utemeljen sum, da je to blago namenjeno za uporabo v dejanjih, ki kršijo carinsko zakonodajo;

en: goods that are or may be transported in such a way that there are reasonable grounds for believing that they are intended to be used in operations in breach of customs legislation; and
sl: blagom, ki se ali bi se lahko prevažalo na tak način, da obstaja utemeljen sum, da je namenjeno za uporabo v dejanjih, ki kršijo carinsko zakonodajo; in

en: means of transport that are or may be used in such a way that there are reasonable grounds for believing that they are intended to be used in operations in breach of customs legislation.
sl: prevoznimi sredstvi, ki se ali bi se lahko uporabljala na tak način, da obstaja utemeljen sum, da so namenjena za uporabo v dejanjih, ki kršijo carinsko zakonodajo.

en: Spontaneous assistance
sl: Pomoč brez zaprosila

en: The Parties shall assist each other, at their own initiative and in accordance with their legal or regulatory provisions, if they consider that to be necessary for the correct application of customs legislation, particularly by providing information obtained pertaining to:
sl: Pogodbenici si medsebojno na lastno pobudo in v skladu s svojimi zakoni in drugimi predpisi zagotavljata pomoč, če menita, da je to potrebno za pravilno uporabo carinske zakonodaje, še posebej z zagotavljanjem informacij o:

en: activities which are or appear to be operations in breach of customs legislation and which may be of interest to the other Party,
sl: dejavnostih, s katerimi se krši ali bi se lahko kršila carinska zakonodaja in ki bi zanimale drugo pogodbenico;

en: new means or methods employed in carrying out operations in breach of customs legislation,
sl: novih načinih ali metodah, uporabljenih za izvrševanje dejanj kršitve carinske zakonodaje;

en: goods known to be subject to operations in breach of customs legislation,
sl: blagu, za katero je znano, da je v zvezi z njim prišlo do kršenja carinske zakonodaje;

en: natural or legal persons in respect of whom there are reasonable grounds for believing that they are or have been involved in operations in breach of customs legislation, and
sl: fizičnih ali pravnih osebah, za katere obstaja utemeljen sum, da so ali so bile vpletene v dejanja, ki kršijo carinsko zakonodajo; in

en: means of transport in respect of which there are reasonable grounds for believing that they have been, are, or may be used in operations in breach of customs legislation.
sl: prevoznih sredstvih, za katera obstaja razlog za utemeljen sum, da so bila, so ali bi lahko bila uporabljena pri dejanjih, ki kršijo carinsko zakonodajo.

en: Delivery and notification
sl: Pošiljanje in obveščanje

en: At the request of the applicant authority, the requested authority shall, in accordance with legal or regulatory provisions applicable to the latter, take all necessary measures in order:
sl: Na zahtevo organa prosilca mora zaprošeni organ v skladu z zakoni ali drugimi predpisi, ki se zanj uporabljajo, sprejeti vse potrebne ukrepe z namenom, da:

en: to deliver any documents, or
sl: dostavi katere koli dokumente ali

en: to notify any decisions,
sl: sporoči vse odločitve

en: emanating from the applicant authority and falling within the scope of this Protocol, to an addressee residing or established in the territory of the requested authority.
sl: organa prosilca, ki spadajo v obseg uporabe tega protokola, naslovniku, ki prebiva ali ima sedež na ozemlju zaprošenega organa.

en: Requests for delivery of documents or notification of decisions shall be made in writing in an official language of the requested authority or in a language acceptable to that authority.
