en: ANNEX 29-A
sl: PRILOGA 29-A

en: RULES OF PROCEDURE FOR ARBITRATION
sl: ARBITRAŽNA PRAVILA

en: Definitions and general provisions
sl: Opredelitev pojmov in splošne določbe

en: For this Chapter and under these Rules:
sl: Za to poglavje in v skladu s tem pravilnikom:

en: adviser means a natural person retained by a Party to advise or assist that Party in connection with the arbitration proceeding;
sl: svetovalec pomeni fizično osebo, ki jo pogodbenica pooblasti za svetovanje ali pomoč v zvezi z arbitražnim postopkom;

en: arbitration panel means a panel established under Article 29.7;
sl: arbitražni svet pomeni svet, ustanovljen v skladu s členom 29.7;

en: arbitrator means a member of an arbitration panel established under Article 29.7;
sl: arbiter pomeni člana arbitražnega sveta, ustanovljenega v skladu s členom 29.7;

en: assistant means a natural person who, under the terms of appointment of an arbitrator conducts research for or provides assistance to the arbitrator;
sl: pomočnik pomeni fizično osebo, ki v okviru mandata arbitra opravlja raziskave za arbitra ali mu zagotavlja pomoč;

en: day means a calendar day, unless otherwise specified;
sl: dan pomeni koledarski dan, razen če je drugače določeno;

en: legal holiday means every Saturday and Sunday and any other day designated by a Party as a holiday for the purposes of these Rules;
sl: državni praznik pomeni vsako soboto in nedeljo ter kateri koli drug dan, ki ga pogodbenica določi kot praznik za namene tega pravilnika;

en: representative of a Party means an employee or any natural person appointed by a government department or agency or any other public entity of a Party who represents the Party for the purposes of a dispute under this Agreement;
sl: zastopnik pogodbenice pomeni zaposlenega ali katero koli fizično osebo, ki jo imenuje vladni organ ali vladna agencija ali kateri koli drugi vladni subjekt pogodbenice, ki zastopa pogodbenico v sporih v skladu s tem sporazumom;

en: responding Party means the Party that is alleged to be in violation of the provisions referred to in Article 29.2; and
sl: pogodbenica naslovnica pomeni pogodbenico, ki domnevno krši določbe iz člena 29.2; ter

en: requesting Party means any Party that requests the establishment of an arbitration panel under Article 29.6;
sl: pogodbenica predlagateljica pomeni pogodbenico, ki zahteva ustanovitev arbitražnega sveta v skladu s členom 29.6;

en: The responding Party shall be in charge of the logistical administration of the arbitration proceedings, in particular the organisation of hearings, unless otherwise agreed.
sl: pogodbenica naslovnica je zadolžena za logistično upravljanje arbitražnega postopka, zlasti za organizacijo obravnav, razen kadar je dogovorjeno drugače.

en: However, the Parties shall bear equally the administrative expenses of the arbitration proceedings as well as the remuneration and all travel, lodging and general expenses of the arbitrators and their assistants.
sl: Vendar pa si pogodbenici enakopravno razdelita administrativne stroške arbitražnega postopka ter plačilo in vse potne, nastanitvene in splošne stroške arbitrov in njihovih pomočnikov.

en: Notifications
sl: Uradna obvestila

en: Unless agreed otherwise, the Parties and the arbitration panel shall transmit a request, notice, written submission or other document by email, with a copy submitted on the same day by facsimile transmission, registered post, courier, delivery against receipt or any other means of telecommunication that provides a record of its sending.
sl: Razen če ni drugače dogovorjeno, pogodbenici in arbitražni svet zahtevo, uradno obvestilo, pisno stališče ali drug dokument pošljejo po elektronski pošti, isti dan pa en izvod pošljejo po telefaksu, priporočeni pošti, kurirju, po pošti s povratnico ali katerem koli drugem telekomunikacijskem sredstvu, s katerim je mogoče dokazati, da je bila pošta poslana.

en: Unless proven otherwise, an email message shall be deemed to be received on the same date of its sending.
sl: Če ni dokazano nasprotno, se šteje, da je bilo elektronsko sporočilo prejeto na dan pošiljanja.

en: When communicating in writing, a Party shall provide an electronic copy of its communications to the other Party and to each of the arbitrators.
sl: Pri pisnem sporazumevanju pogodbenica predloži elektronski izvod svoji pisanj drugi pogodbenici in vsakemu izmed arbitrov.

en: Minor errors of a clerical nature in a request, notice, written submission or other document related to the arbitration proceeding may be corrected by delivery of a new document clearly indicating the changes.
sl: Manjše pisne napake v zahtevi, uradnem obvestilu, pisnem stališču ali drugem dokumentu, povezanem z arbitražnim postopkom, se lahko popravijo s predložitvijo novega dokumenta, ki jasno navaja spremembe.

en: If the last day for delivery of a document falls on an official holiday or rest day in Canada or in the European Union, the document may be delivered on the next business day.
sl: Če je zadnji dan za predložitev dokumenta ravno uradni državni praznik ali dela prosti dan v Kanadi ali Evropski uniji, se dokument lahko predloži prvi delovni dan zatem.

en: No documents, notifications or requests of any kind shall be deemed to be received on a legal holiday.
sl: Za dokumente, uradna obvestila ali kakršne koli zahteve se ne šteje, da so bili prejeti na državni praznik.

en: Depending on the provisions under dispute, all requests and notifications addressed to the CETA Joint Committee in accordance with this Chapter shall also be copied to the other relevant institutional bodies.
sl: Odvisno od spornih določb se en izvod vseh zahtev in uradnih obvestil, ki so bili naslovljeni na Skupni odbor CETA v skladu s tem poglavjem, predloži tudi drugim ustreznim institucionalnim organom.

en: Commencing the arbitration
sl: Začetek arbitraže

en: Unless the Parties agree otherwise, they shall meet the arbitration panel within seven working days of its establishment in order to determine such matters that the Parties or the arbitration panel deem appropriate, including the remuneration and expenses to be paid to the arbitrators, which shall be in accordance with WTO standards.
sl: Če se pogodbenici ne dogovorita drugače, se sestaneta z arbitražnim svetom v sedmih delovnih dneh po datumu njegove ustanovitve, da se določijo zadeve, ki se zdijo pogodbenicama ali arbitražnemu svetu primerne, vključno z nagrado in stroški za arbitre, ki so običajno v skladu s standardi STO.

en: Remuneration for each arbitrator's assistant shall not exceed 50 per cent of the total remuneration of that arbitrator.
sl: Nagrada pomočnika posameznega arbitra ne sme preseči 50 odstotkov celotnega honorarja tega arbitra.

en: Arbitrators and representatives of the Parties may take part in this meeting via telephone or video conference.
sl: Arbitri in zastopniki pogodbenic se lahko tega srečanja udeležijo prek telefona ali video konference.

en: Unless the Parties agree otherwise, within five working days of the date of the establishment of the arbitration panel, the terms of reference of the arbitration panel shall be:
sl: Če se pogodbenici v petih delovnih dneh od datuma ustanovitve arbitražnega sveta ne dogovorita drugače, je obseg pooblastil arbitražnega sveta naslednji:

en: ‘to examine, in the light of the relevant provisions of the Agreement, the matter referred to in the request for establishment of the arbitration panel, to rule on the compatibility of the measure in question with the provisions referred to in Article 29.2 and to make a ruling in accordance with Articles 29.10, 29.17 and 29.18.’.
sl: „ob upoštevanju zadevnih določb tega sporazuma preučiti zadevo, na katero se nanaša zahteva za ustanovitev arbitražnega sveta, odločiti o združljivosti zadevnega ukrepa z določbami iz člena 29.2 in sprejeti odločitev v skladu s členi 29.10, 29.17 in 29.18.“

en: The Parties shall notify the agreed terms of reference to the arbitration panel within three working days of their agreement.
sl: Pogodbenici dogovorjeni obseg pooblastil uradno sporočita arbitražnemu svetu v treh delovnih dneh po svojem dogovoru.

en: The arbitration panel may rule on its own jurisdiction.
sl: Arbitražni svet lahko odloča o svoji pristojnosti.

en: Initial submissions
sl: Začetna stališča

en: The requesting Party shall deliver its initial written submission no later than 10 days after the date of establishment of the arbitration panel.
sl: Pogodbenica predlagateljica predloži svoja začetna pisna stališča najpozneje 10 dni po datumu ustanovitve arbitražnega sveta.

en: The responding Party shall deliver its written counter-submission no later than 21 days after the date of delivery of the initial written submission.
sl: Pogodbenica naslovnica predloži svoj odgovor v pisni obliki najpozneje 21 dni po datumu prejetja začetnega pisnega stališča.

en: Working of arbitration panels
sl: Delovanje arbitražnih svetov

en: The chairperson of the arbitration panel shall preside over all meetings.
sl: Predsednik arbitražnega sveta predseduje vsem srečanjem.

en: An arbitration panel may delegate to the chairperson authority to make administrative and procedural decisions.
sl: Arbitražni svet lahko pooblasti predsednika za odločanje o upravnih in postopkovnih zadevah.

en: Hearings shall take place in person.
sl: Na obravnavah je osebna udeležba.

en: Unless otherwise provided in this Chapter and without prejudice to paragraph 30, the arbitration panel may conduct its other activities by any means, including telephone, facsimile transmissions or computer links.
sl: Razen če je v tem poglavju določeno drugače in brez poseganja v odstavek 30, lahko arbitražni svet opravlja svoje druge dejavnosti z uporabo katerih koli sredstev, vključno s telefonom, telefaksom ali računalniškimi povezavami.

en: Only arbitrators may take part in the deliberations of the arbitration panel, but the arbitration panel may permit its assistants to be present at its deliberations.
sl: Posvetovanj arbitražnega sveta se lahko udeležijo le arbitri, arbitražni svet pa lahko dovoli, da se posvetovanj udeležijo tudi njihovi pomočniki.

en: The drafting of any ruling shall remain the exclusive responsibility of the arbitration panel and must not be delegated.
sl: Priprava odločitev je v izključni pristojnosti arbitražnega senata in prenos pristojnosti ni dovoljen.

en: Findings, determinations and recommendations of the arbitration panel under Articles 29.9 and 29.10 should be made by consensus, but if consensus is not possible then by a majority of its members.
sl: Ugotovitve, določitve in priporočila arbitražnega sveta v skladu s členom 29.9 in 29.10 bi bilo treba sprejeti s soglasjem, če to ni mogoče, pa z večino glasov njegovih članov.

en: Arbitrators may not issue separate opinions on matters not unanimously agreed.
sl: Arbitri ne smejo izdati ločenih mnenj o zadevah, o katerih se niso soglasno dogovorili.

en: Where a procedural question arises that is not covered by the provisions of Chapter Twenty-Nine (Dispute Settlement), the arbitration panel, after consulting with the Parties, may adopt an appropriate procedure that is compatible with those provisions and that ensures equal treatment between the Parties.
sl: Kadar se pojavi postopkovno vprašanje, ki ga določbe poglavja 29 (Reševanje sporov) ne zajemajo, lahko arbitražni svet po posvetovanju s pogodbenicama sprejme ustrezen postopek, ki je združljiv s temi določbami in zagotavlja enako obravnavo obeh pogodbenic.

en: If the arbitration panel considers that there is a need to modify any time limit applicable in the proceedings or to make any other procedural or administrative adjustment as may be required for the fairness or efficiency of the proceedings, it shall inform the Parties in writing of the reasons for the modification or adjustment and of the period or adjustment needed.
sl: Če arbitražni svet meni, da bi bilo treba spremeniti kateri koli rok v postopku, ali da bi bila potrebna kakršna koli postopkovna ali upravna prilagoditev zaradi poštenosti in učinkovitosti postopka, pisno obvesti pogodbenici o razlogih za spremembo ali prilagoditev in o obdobju ali prilagoditvi, ki sta potrebna.

en: The arbitration panel may adopt such modification or adjustment after having consulted the Parties.
sl: Arbitražni svet tako spremembo ali prilagoditev lahko sprejme po posvetovanju s pogodbenicama.

en: Any time limit referred to in this Chapter and in this Annex may be modified by mutual consent of the Parties.
sl: Kakršen koli rok iz tega poglavja in te priloge se lahko spremeni z vzajemnim soglasjem pogodbenic.

en: Upon request of a Party, the arbitration panel may modify the time limits applicable in the proceedings.
sl: Na zahtevo pogodbenice lahko arbitražni svet spremeni roke, ki se uporabljajo v postopku.

en: The arbitration panel shall suspend its work:
sl: Arbitražni svet prekine svoje delovanje:

en: at the request of the requesting Party for a period specified in the request but not to exceed 12 consecutive months, and shall resume its work at the request of the requesting Party; or
sl: na zahtevo pogodbenice predlagateljice za obdobje, ki je podrobneje določeno v zahtevi, vendar ne sme preseči 12 zaporednih mesecev, ter nadaljuje svoje delo na zahtevo pogodbenice predlagateljice; ali

en: after it has issued its interim report or in the case of a proceeding on a disagreement on equivalence under Article 29.14 or a proceeding under Article 29.15, only upon the request of both Parties for a period specified in the request, and shall resume its work at the request of either Party.
sl: potem ko je izdal vmesno poročilo ali v primeru postopka v zvezi s sporom o enakovrednosti v skladu s členom 29.14 ali postopka v skladu s členom 29.15, in sicer samo na zahtevo obeh pogodbenic za obdobje, ki je podrobneje določeno v zahtevi, ter nadaljuje svoje delo na zahtevo katere koli od pogodbenic.

en: If there is no request for the resumption of the arbitration panel's work by the end of the period specified in the request for suspension, the proceeding shall be terminated.
sl: Če ni zahteve za nadaljevanje dela arbitražnega sveta do konca obdobja, ki je podrobneje določeno v zahtevi za prekinitev, se postopek ustavi.

en: The termination of the arbitration panel's work is without prejudice to the rights of the Parties in another proceeding on the same matter under Chapter Twenty-Nine (Dispute Settlement).
sl: Ustavitev dela arbitražnega sveta ne posega v pravice pogodbenic v drugem postopku v zvezi z isto zadevo v skladu s poglavjem 29 (Reševanje sporov).

en: Replacement
sl: Zamenjava

en: If an arbitrator is unable to participate in the proceeding, withdraws, or must be replaced, a replacement shall be selected in accordance with Article 29.7.3.
sl: Če se arbiter ne more udeležiti postopka, odstopi ali mora biti zamenjan, se v skladu s členom 29.7.3. izbere nadomestni arbiter.

en: Where a Party considers that an arbitrator does not comply with the requirements of the code of conduct of Annex 29-B (‘Code of Conduct’) and for this reason must be replaced, that Party shall notify the other Party within 15 days from the time it came to know of the circumstances underlying the arbitrator's non-compliance with the Code of Conduct.
sl: Kadar pogodbenica meni, da arbiter ne izpolnjuje zahtev kodeksa ravnanja iz Priloge 29-B (v nadaljnjem besedilu: kodeks ravnanja) in mora biti zaradi tega zamenjan, o tem obvesti drugo pogodbenico v 15 dnevih od dneva, ko je izvedela za okoliščine, ki kažejo na arbitrovo neskladno ravnanje v zvezi s kodeksom ravnanja.

en: Where a Party considers that an arbitrator other than the chairperson does not comply with the requirements of the Code of Conduct, the Parties shall consult and, if they so agree, replace the arbitrator and select a replacement following the procedure set out in Article 29.7.3.
sl: Kadar katera od pogodbenic meni, da arbiter, ki ni predsednik, ne izpolnjuje zahtev kodeksa ravnanja, se pogodbenici posvetujeta in, če se o tem sporazumeta, arbitra zamenjata z novim po postopku iz člena 29.7.3.

en: If the Parties fail to agree on the need to replace an arbitrator, any Party may request that such matter be referred to the chairperson of the arbitration panel, whose decision shall be final.
sl: Kadar se pogodbenici ne strinjata glede potrebe po zamenjavi arbitra, lahko katera koli od njiju zahteva, da se zadeva predloži predsedniku arbitražnega sveta, ki sprejme končno odločitev.

en: If, pursuant to such a request, the chairperson finds that an arbitrator does not comply with the requirements of the Code of Conduct, she or he shall draw a new arbitrator by lot from the names on the list referred to in Article 29.8.1 and on which the original arbitrator was included.
sl: Če v skladu s tako zahtevo predsednik meni, da arbiter ne izpolnjuje zahtev kodeksa ravnanja, z žrebom izbere novega arbitra izmed imen s seznama iz člena 29.8.1, ki je vseboval prvotnega arbitra.

en: If the original arbitrator was chosen by the Parties pursuant to Article 29.7, the replacement shall be drawn by lot from the individuals proposed by the requesting Party and by the responding Party under Article 29.8.1.
sl: Če sta pogodbenici prvotnega arbitra izbrali v skladu s členom 29.7, je nadomestni arbiter izbran z žrebom iz skupine posameznikov, ki sta jih v skladu s členom 29.8.1 predlagali pogodbenica predlagateljica in pogodbenica naslovnica.

en: The selection of the new arbitrator shall be made within five working days of the date of the submission of the request to the chairperson of the arbitration panel.
sl: Novi arbiter je izbran v petih delovnih dneh od datuma predložitve zahteve predsedniku arbitražnega sveta.

en: Where a Party considers that the chairperson of the arbitration panel does not comply with the requirements of the Code of Conduct, the Parties shall consult and, if they so agree, shall dismiss the chairperson and select a replacement following the procedure set out in 29.7.3.
sl: Kadar katera od pogodbenic meni, da predsednik arbitražnega sveta ne izpolnjuje zahtev kodeksa ravnanja, se pogodbenici posvetujeta in, če se o tem sporazumeta, predsednika zamenjata in izbereta nadomestnega po postopku iz člena 29.7.3.

en: If the Parties fail to agree on the need to replace the chairperson, any Party may request that such matter be referred to the two remaining arbitrators.
sl: Kadar se pogodbenici ne strinjata glede potrebe po zamenjavi predsednika, lahko katera koli od njiju zahteva, da se zadeva predloži obema preostalima arbitroma.

en: The decision by the arbitrators on the need to replace the chairperson shall be final.
sl: Odločitev arbitrov o potrebi za zamenjavo predsednika je dokončna.

en: If the arbitrators decide that the chairperson does not comply with the requirements of the Code of Conduct, they shall draw a new chairperson by lot among the remaining names on the list referred to in Article 29.8.1.
sl: Če se arbitra odločita, da predsednik ne izpolnjuje zahtev kodeksa ravnanja, z žrebom izbereta novega predsednika izmed preostalih imen s seznama iz člena 29.8.1.

en: The selection of the new chairperson shall be made within five working days of the date of the submission of the request referred to in this paragraph.
sl: Novi predsednik je izbran v petih delovnih dneh od datuma predložitve zahteve iz tega odstavka.

en: If the arbitrators cannot reach a decision within 10 days of the matter being referred to them, the procedure set out in Article 29.7 shall apply.
sl: Če arbitra ne moreta sprejeti odločitve v 10 dneh od datuma, ko jima je bila zadeva predložena, se uporabi postopek iz člena 29.7.

en: The arbitration proceedings shall be suspended for the period taken to carry out the procedure provided for in paragraphs 21 through 24.
sl: Arbitražni postopek se prekine za obdobje, ki je potrebno za izvedbo postopka iz odstavkov od 21 do 24.

en: Hearings
sl: Obravnave

en: The chairperson shall fix the date and time of the hearing in consultation with the Parties and the other arbitrators, and confirm this in writing to the Parties.
sl: Predsednik določi datum in uro obravnave po posvetovanju s pogodbenicama in drugima arbitroma ter pogodbenicama pošlje to pisno potrdilo.

en: This information shall also be made publicly available by the Party in charge of the logistical administration of the proceeding, subject to paragraph 39.
sl: Pogodbenica, ki je zadolžena za logistično upravljanje postopka, te podatke tudi javno objavi, ob upoštevanju odstavka 39.

en: Unless the Parties agree otherwise, the hearing shall be held in Brussels if the requesting Party is Canada and in Ottawa if the requesting Party is the European Union.
sl: Razen če se pogodbenici dogovorita drugače, poteka obravnava v Bruslju, kadar je pogodbenica predlagateljica Kanada, in v Ottawi, kadar je pogodbenica predlagateljicaložila, Evropska unija.

en: As a general rule there should be only one hearing.
sl: Praviloma se izvede samo ena obravnava.

en: The arbitration panel may on its own initiative or on the request of a Party convene one additional hearing when the dispute involves issues of exceptional complexity.
sl: Arbitražni svet lahko na lastno pobudo ali na zahtevo stranke skliče dodatno obravnavo, kadar se spor nanaša na vprašanja izjemne kompleksnosti.

en: No additional hearing shall be convened for the procedures established under Articles 29.14 and 29.15, except in the case of a disagreement on compliance and equivalence.
sl: Za postopke v skladu s členoma 29.14 in 29.15 se dodatne obravnave ne skliče, razen v primeru spora o skladnosti in enakovrednosti.

en: All arbitrators shall be present during the entirety of the hearing.
sl: Vsi arbitri so navzoči med celotno obravnavo.

en: The following persons may attend the hearing, irrespective of whether the proceeding is open to the public or not:
sl: Ne glede na to, ali je postopek javen ali ne, se obravnave lahko udeležijo naslednje osebe:

en: representatives of the Parties;
sl: zastopniki pogodbenic;

en: advisers to the Parties;
sl: svetovalci pogodbenic;

en: administrative staff, interpreters, translators and court reporters; and
sl: upravno osebje, tolmači, prevajalci in sodni zapisnikarji; in

en: arbitrators' assistants.
sl: pomočniki arbitrov.

en: Only the representatives of and advisers to the Parties may address the arbitration panel.
sl: Pred arbitražnim svetom se lahko izrekajo le zastopniki in svetovalci pogodbenic.

en: No later than five working days before the date of a hearing, each Party shall deliver to the arbitration panel and to the other Party a list of the names of natural persons who will make oral arguments or presentations at the hearing on behalf of that Party and of other representatives or advisers who will be attending the hearing.
sl: Vsaka od pogodbenic najpozneje pet delovnih dni pred datumom obravnave arbitražnemu svetu in drugi pogodbenici predloži seznam imen fizičnih oseb, ki bodo na obravnavi v imenu te pogodbenice ustno predstavile argumente, ter drugih zastopnikov ali svetovalcev, ki bodo navzoči na obravnavi.

en: The arbitration panel shall conduct the hearing in the following manner, ensuring that the requesting Party and the responding Party are afforded equal time:
sl: Arbitražni svet vodi obravnavo, kot je navedeno v nadaljevanju, in zagotovi, da imata pogodbenica predlagateljica in pogodbenica naslovnica na razpolago enako količino časa:

en: argument of the requesting Party
sl: argument pogodbenice predlagateljice;

en: argument of the responding Party
sl: argument pogodbenice naslovnice;

en: Rebuttal Argument
sl: Protiargument

en: reply of the requesting Party
sl: odgovor pogodbenice predlagateljice;

en: counter-reply of the responding Party
sl: replika pogodbenice naslovnice.

en: The arbitration panel may direct questions to either Party at any time during the hearing.
sl: Arbitražni svet lahko kadar koli med obravnavo naslovi vprašanja neposredno na katero koli pogodbenico.

en: The arbitration panel, after having received the comments of the Parties, shall issue to the Parties a final transcript of each hearing.
sl: Arbitražni svet pogodbenicama po prejetju njunih pripomb pošlje končni zapisnik vsake obravnave.

en: Each Party may deliver to the arbitrators and to the other Party a supplementary written submission concerning any matter that arose during the hearing within 10 working days of the date of the hearing.
sl: Vsaka pogodbenica lahko v 10 delovnih dneh po datumu obravnave arbitrom in drugi pogodbenici predloži dopolnilno pisno stališče glede katerega koli vprašanja, ki se je pojavilo med obravnavo.

en: Questions in writing
sl: Pisna vprašanja

en: The arbitration panel may at any time during the proceeding address questions in writing to one or both Parties.
sl: Arbitražni svet lahko kadar koli med postopkom naslovi pisna vprašanja na eno ali obe pogodbenici.

en: Each of the Parties shall receive a copy of any questions put by the arbitration panel.
sl: Vsaka od pogodbenic prejme izvod vseh vprašanj arbitražnega sveta.

en: Each Party shall also provide the other Party with a copy of its written response to the questions of the arbitration panel.
sl: Vsaka pogodbenica izvod svojih pisnih odgovorov na vprašanja arbitražnega sveta predloži tudi drugi pogodbenici.

en: Each Party shall be given the opportunity to provide written comments on the other Party's reply within five working days of the date of receipt.
sl: Vsaka pogodbenica ima možnost, da pisno izrazi svoje pripombe na odgovor druge pogodbenice v petih delovnih dneh od datuma prejetja.

en: Transparency and confidentiality
sl: Preglednost in zaupnost

en: Subject to paragraph 39, each Party shall make its submissions publicly available and, unless the Parties decide otherwise, the hearings of the arbitration panel shall be open to the public.
sl: Ob upoštevanju odstavka 39 vsaka pogodbenica objavi svoja stališča, obravnave arbitražnega sveta pa so javne, razen če se pogodbenici drugače odločita.

en: The arbitration panel shall meet in closed session when the submission and arguments of a Party contain confidential business information.
sl: Arbitražni svet se sestane za zaprtimi vrati, kadar stališče in trditve pogodbenice vsebujejo zaupne poslovne informacije.

en: The Parties shall maintain the confidentiality of the arbitration panel hearings when they are held in closed session.
sl: Pogodbenici ohranjata zaupnost obravnav arbitražnega sveta, kadar obravnave potekajo za zaprtimi vrati.

en: Each Party and its advisers shall treat as confidential any information submitted by the other Party to the arbitration panel which that Party has designated as confidential.
sl: Vsaka pogodbenica in njeni svetovalci vsakršno informacijo, ki jo druga pogodbenica predloži arbitražnemu svetu, obravnavajo kot zaupno, če jo navedena pogodbenica označi kot zaupno.

en: Where a Party's submission to the arbitration panel contains confidential information, that Party shall also provide, within 15 days, a non-confidential version of the submission that could be disclosed to the public.
sl: Kadar stališče, ki ga pogodbenica predloži arbitražnemu svetu, vsebuje zaupne informacije, ta pogodbenica v 15 dneh prav tako predloži nezaupno različico stališča, ki bi se lahko razkrila javnosti.

en: Ex parte contacts
sl: Enostranski stiki

en: The arbitration panel shall not meet or contact a Party in the absence of the other Party.
sl: Arbitražni svet se ne sestaja oziroma ne vzpostavi stika s pogodbenico v odsotnosti druge pogodbenice.

en: No arbitrator may discuss any aspect of the subject-matter of the proceeding with a Party or the Parties in the absence of the other arbitrators.
sl: Noben arbiter ne sme razpravljati o katerem koli vidiku zadev, ki so predmet postopka, s pogodbenico oziroma pogodbenicama v odsotnosti drugih arbitrov.

en: Information and technical advice
sl: Informacije in tehnični nasveti

en: Upon the request of a disputing Party, or on its own initiative, the arbitration panel may seek information and technical advice from any person or body that it deems appropriate, subject to any terms and conditions agreed by the Parties.
sl: Na zahtevo pogodbenice v sporu ali na lastno pobudo lahko arbitražni svet pridobi informacije in tehnične nasvete od katere koli osebe ali organa, ki se mu zdi primeren, ob upoštevanju pogojev, za katere sta se dogovorili pogodbenici.

en: Any information obtained in this manner must be disclosed to each Party and submitted for their comments.
sl: Kakršne koli tako pridobljene informacije je treba razkriti vsaki od pogodbenic in jima jih predložiti, da izrazita pripombe.

en: Amicus curiae submissions
sl: Stališča amicus curiae

en: Non-governmental persons established in a Party may submit amicus curiae briefs to the arbitration panel in accordance with the following paragraphs.
sl: Nevladne osebe, ki so bile ustanovljene v pogodbenici, lahko v skladu z naslednjimi odstavki arbitražnemu svetu predložijo dopise amicus curiae.

en: Unless the Parties agree otherwise within five days of the date of the establishment of the arbitration panel, the arbitration panel may receive unsolicited written submissions, provided that they are made within 10 days of the date of the establishment of the arbitration panel, and in no case longer than 15 typed pages, including any annexes, and that they are directly relevant to the issue under consideration by the arbitration panel.
sl: Razen če se pogodbenici v petih dneh po datumu ustanovitve arbitražnega sveta ne dogovorita drugače, arbitražni svet lahko sprejema nezahtevana pisna stališča, če se predložijo v 10 dneh od datuma ustanovitve arbitražnega sveta, če v nobenem primeru niso daljša od 15 tipkanih strani, vključno s prilogami, in če so neposredno pomembna za vprašanje, ki ga preučuje arbitražni svet.

en: The submission shall contain a description of the person making the submission, whether natural or legal, including the nature of that person's activities and the source of that person's financing, and specify the nature of the interest that that person has in the arbitration proceeding.
sl: Stališče vsebuje opis osebe, ki stališče predloži, bodisi fizične ali pravne, vključno z vrsto njenih dejavnosti in virom financiranja, ter opredelitev interesa te osebe v arbitražnem postopku.

en: It shall be drafted in the languages chosen by the Parties in accordance with paragraphs 48 and 49.
sl: Napisano je v jezikih, ki jih izbereta pogodbenici v skladu z odstavkoma 48 in 49.

en: The arbitration panel shall list in its ruling all the submissions it has received that conform to these Rules.
sl: Arbitražni svet v svoji odločitvi našteje vsa stališča, ki jih je prejel in ki so v skladu s tem pravilnikom.

en: The arbitration panel shall not be obliged to address in its ruling the arguments made in such submissions.
sl: Arbitražni svet v svoji odločitvi ni dolžan obravnavati trditev iz takšnih predloženih stališč.

en: The arbitration panel shall submit to the Parties for their comments any submission it obtains.
sl: Arbitražni svet kakršno koli stališče, ki ga prejme, predloži pogodbenicama, da izrazita pripombe v zvezi z njim.

en: Urgent cases
sl: Nujni primeri

en: In cases of urgency referred to in Article 29.11, the arbitration panel, after consulting the Parties, shall adjust the time limits referred to in these Rules as appropriate and shall notify the Parties of such adjustments.
sl: V nujnih primerih iz člena 29.11 arbitražni svet po posvetovanju s pogodbenicama ustrezno prilagodi roke iz tega pravilnika in o teh prilagoditvah uradno obvesti pogodbenici.

en: Working language for the proceeding, translation and interpretation
sl: Delovni jezik za postopek, prevajanje in tolmačenje

en: During the consultations referred to in Article 29.7.2, and no later than the meeting referred to in paragraph 8, the Parties shall endeavour to agree on a common working language for the proceeding before the arbitration panel.
sl: Na posvetovanjih iz člena 29.7.2 in najpozneje na srečanju iz odstavka 8 si pogodbenici prizadevata za dogovor o skupnem delovnem jeziku za postopek pred arbitražnim svetom.

en: Arbitration panel rulings shall be issued in the language or languages chosen by the Parties.
sl: Odločitve arbitražnega sveta se objavijo v jeziku oziroma jezikih, ki jih izbereta pogodbenici.

en: Any costs incurred for translation of an arbitration panel ruling into the language or languages chosen by the Parties shall be borne equally by the Parties.
sl: Kakršne koli stroške prevajanja odločitve arbitražnega sveta v jezik ali jezike, ki sta jih pogodbenici izbrali, krijeta obe pogodbenici v enakem deležu.

en: A Party may provide comments on the accuracy of any translated version of a document drawn up in accordance with these Rules.
sl: Katera koli pogodbenica lahko izrazi pripombe o točnosti katere koli prevedene različice dokumenta, ki je napisan v skladu s tem pravilnikom.

en: Calculation of time limits
sl: Izračunavanje rokov

en: All time limits set out in this Chapter and in this Annex including the limits for the arbitration pa nels to notify their rulings, shall be counted in calendar days from the day following the act or fact to which they refer, unless otherwise specified.
sl: Vsi roki iz tega poglavja in te priloge, vključno z roki, v katerih morajo arbitražni sveti uradno sporočiti svoje odločitve, se štejejo v koledarskih dnevih od datuma, ki sledi dejanju oziroma dejstvu, na katerega se nanašajo, razen če je določeno drugače.

en: Where, by reason of the application of paragraph 6, a Party receives a document on a date other than the date on which this document is received by the other Party, any period of time that is calculated on the basis of the date of receipt of that document shall be calculated from the last date of receipt of that document.
sl: Kadar pogodbenica zaradi uporabe odstavka 6 prejme dokument na datum, ki se razlikuje od datuma, ko ta dokument prejme druga pogodbenica, se rok, katerega izračun je odvisen od prejetja navedenega dokumenta, izračuna od zadnjega datuma prejetja navedenega dokumenta.

en: Other procedures
sl: Drugi postopki

en: The time limits set out in these Rules shall be adjusted in line with the special time limits provided for the adoption of a ruling by the arbitration panel in the proceedings under Articles 29.14 and 29.15.
sl: Roki iz tega pravilnika se prilagodijo v skladu s posebnimi roki, ki so arbitražnemu svetu na voljo za sprejetje odločitve v postopku v skladu s členoma 29.14 in 29.15.

en: In the event that the original arbitration panel, or some of its arbitrators, are unable to reconvene for the proceedings established under Article 29.14 and 29.15, the procedure set out in Article 29.7 shall apply.
sl: Če se prvotni arbitražni svet ali nekateri njegovi arbitri ne morejo ponovno sestati za izvedbo postopka, določenih v skladu s členoma 29.14 in 29.15, se uporabi postopek iz člena 29.7.

en: The time limit for the notification of the ruling shall be extended by 20 days.
sl: Rok za uradno obvestilo o odločitvi se podaljša za 20 dni.

en: ANNEX 29-B
sl: PRILOGA 29-B

en: CODE OF CONDUCT FOR ARBITRATORS AND MEDIATORS
sl: KODEKS RAVNANJA ZA ARBITRE IN MEDIATORJE

en: For this Chapter and under this Code of Conduct:
sl: Za to poglavje in v skladu s tem kodeksom ravnanja:

en: arbitrator means a member of an arbitration panel established under Article 29.7;
sl: arbiter pomeni člana arbitražnega sveta, ustanovljenega v skladu s členom 29.7;

en: assistant means a natural person who, under the terms of appointment of an arbitrator, conducts research or provides assistance to the arbitrator;
sl: pomočnik pomeni fizično osebo, ki v okviru mandata arbitra opravlja raziskave ali zagotavlja pomoč arbitru;

en: candidate means an individual whose name is on the list of arbitrators referred to in Article 29.8 and who is under consideration for selection as an arbitrator under Article 29.7;
sl: kandidat pomeni posameznika, katerega ime je na seznamu arbitrov iz člena 29.8 in ki se upošteva pri izbiri za arbitra v skladu s členom 29.7;

en: mediator means a natural person who conducts a mediation in accordance with Article 29.5;
sl: mediator pomeni fizično osebo, ki izvaja mediacijo v skladu s členom 29.5;

en: proceeding, unless otherwise specified, means an arbitration proceeding;
sl: postopek, razen če ni drugače določeno, pomeni arbitražni postopek;

en: staff, in respect of an arbitrator, means natural persons under the direction and control of the arbitrator, other than assistants.
sl: osebje nekega arbitra pomeni fizične osebe, ki delujejo pod vodstvom in nadzorom navedenega arbitra, razen pomočnikov.

en: Responsibilities of candidates and arbitrators
sl: Odgovornost kandidatov in arbitrov

en: Every candidate and arbitrator shall avoid impropriety and the appearance of impropriety, shall be independent and impartial, shall avoid direct and indirect conflicts of interests and shall observe high standards of conduct so that the integrity and impartiality of the dispute settlement mechanism is preserved.
sl: Vsak kandidat in arbiter se izogiba neprimernemu ravnanju in dajanju vtisa neprimernega ravnanja, je neodvisen in nepristranski, izogiba se neposrednim in posrednim navzkrižjem interesov ter upošteva visoke standarde ravnanja, da se ohrani neoporečnost in nepristranskost mehanizma za reševanje sporov.

en: Former arbitrators must comply with the obligations established in paragraphs 16 through 19.
sl: Nekdanji arbitri morajo izpolnjevati obveznosti iz odstavkov od 16 do 19.

en: Disclosure obligations
sl: Obveznost razkritja informacij

en: Prior to confirmation of her or his selection as an arbitrator under this Chapter, a candidate shall disclose any interest, relationship or matter that is likely to affect her or his independence or impartiality or that might reasonably create an appearance of impropriety or bias in the proceeding.
sl: Preden se potrdi izbor arbitra v skladu s tem poglavjem, mora kandidat razkriti vse svoje interese, razmerja ali zadeve, ki bi lahko vplivali na njegovo neodvisnost ali nepristranskost ali ki bi lahko utemeljeno ustvarjali vtis neprimernega ravnanja ali pristranskosti v postopku.

en: To this end, a candidate shall make all reasonable efforts to become aware of such interests, relationships and matters.
sl: V ta namen si kandidat čim bolj prizadeva razjasniti obstoj tovrstnih interesov, razmerij in zadev.

en: Without limiting the generality of the foregoing, candidates shall disclose the following interests, relationships and matters:
sl: Brez omejevanja splošnega pomena zgoraj navedenega kandidati razkrijejo naslednje interese, razmerja in zadeve:

en: any financial interest of the candidate:
sl: kakršni koli finančni interes kandidata:

en: in the proceeding or in its outcome, and
sl: v postopku ali njegovem izidu ter

en: in an administrative proceeding, a domestic court proceeding or another panel or committee proceeding that involves issues that may be decided in the proceeding for which the candidate is under consideration;
sl: v upravnem postopku, postopku pred nacionalnim sodiščem ali postopku pred drugim odborom, ki vključuje vprašanja, o katerih se lahko odloča v okviru postopka, za katerega je kandidat obravnavan;

en: any financial interest of the candidate's employer, partner, business associate or family member:
sl: kakršni koli finančni interes kandidatovega delodajalca, partnerja, poslovnega partnerja ali družinskega člana:

en: any past or existing financial, business, professional, family or social relationship with the interested parties in the proceeding, or their counsel, or such relationship involving a candidate's employer, partner, business associate or family member; and
sl: kakršno koli preteklo ali obstoječe finančno, poslovno, poklicno, družinsko ali družbeno razmerje z zainteresiranimi stranmi v postopku ali njihovimi svetovalci ali tako razmerje, ki vključuje kandidatovega delodajalca, partnerja, poslovnega partnerja ali družinskega člana; in

en: public advocacy or legal or other representation concerning an issue in dispute in the proceeding or involving the same matters.
sl: zastopanje javnih interesov, pravno ali drugo zastopstvo, če se to nanaša na vprašanje v postopku, povezano s sporom, ali vključuje iste zadeve.

en: A candidate or arbitrator shall communicate matters concerning actual or potential violations of this Code of Conduct to the CETA Joint Committee for consideration by the Parties.
sl: Kandidat ali arbiter o zadevah v zvezi z dejanskimi ali morebitnimi kršitvami tega kodeksa ravnanja obvesti Skupni odbor CETA, ki zadevo nato predloži pogodbenicama v preučitev.

en: Once selected, an arbitrator shall continue to make all reasonable efforts to become aware of interests, relationships or matters referred to in paragraph 3 and shall disclose them.
sl: Ko je arbiter izbran, si še naprej čim bolj prizadeva razjasniti interese, razmerja ali zadeve iz odstavka 3, ki jih tudi razkrije.

en: The disclosure obligation is a continuing duty which requires an arbitrator to disclose such interests, relationships or matters that may arise during all stages of the proceeding.
sl: Obveznost razkritja velja neprekinjeno, zato mora arbiter razkriti tovrstne interese, razmerja in zadeve, ki bi se lahko pojavili v vseh fazah postopka.

en: The arbitrator shall disclose such interests, relationships or matters by informing the CETA Joint Committee promptly, in writing, for consideration by the Parties.
sl: Arbiter razkrije take interese, razmerja ali zadeve, tako da o njih nemudoma pisno obvesti Skupni odbor CETA, pogodbenici pa jih nato preučita.

en: Duties of arbitrators
sl: Dolžnosti arbitrov

en: Upon selection an arbitrator shall be available to perform and shall perform her or his duties thoroughly and expeditiously throughout the course of the proceeding, and with fairness and diligence.
sl: Izbrani arbiter je ves čas trajanja postopka na voljo in svoje dolžnosti izpolnjuje temeljito in učinkovito ter pošteno in vestno.

en: An arbitrator shall consider only those issues raised in the proceeding and necessary for a ruling and shall not delegate this duty to any other person.
sl: Arbiter upošteva zgolj tista vprašanja, ki se sprožijo v postopku in so potrebna za odločitev, in te svoje dolžnosti ne prenaša na druge osebe.

en: An arbitrator shall take all appropriate steps to ensure that her or his assistant and staff are aware of, and comply with, paragraphs 2 through 6, and 17 through 19.
sl: Arbiter izvede vse potrebne ukrepe za zagotovitev, da njegov pomočnik in osebje poznajo odstavke od 2 do 6 in od 17 do 19 ter ravnajo v skladu z njimi.

en: An arbitrator shall not engage in ex parte contacts concerning the proceeding.
sl: Arbiter ne vzpostavlja enostranskih stikov v zvezi s postopkom.

en: Independence and impartiality of arbitrators
sl: Neodvisnost in nepristranskost arbitrov

en: An arbitrator shall avoid creating an appearance of bias and shall not be influenced by self-interest, outside pressure, political considerations, public clamour, loyalty to a Party, or fear of criticism.
sl: Arbiter se izogiba ustvarjanju vtisa pristranskosti in ne dopusti, da bi nanj vplivali lastni interesi, zunanji pritiski, politični pomisleki, zahteve javnosti, zvestoba pogodbenici ali strah pred kritiko.

en: An arbitrator shall not, directly or indirectly, incur any obligation or accept any benefit that would in any way interfere, or appear to interfere, with the proper performance of her or his duties.
sl: Arbiter ne prevzema, ne neposredno ne posredno, nobenih obveznosti oziroma ne sprejema ugodnosti, ki bi na kakršen koli način vplivale ali dajale vtis, da vplivajo, na ustrezno izpolnjevanje njegovih dolžnosti.

en: An arbitrator may not use her or his position on the arbitration panel to advance any personal or private interests and shall avoid actions that may create the impression that others are in a special position to influence her or him.
sl: Arbiter ne sme izrabiti svojega položaja v arbitražnem svetu, da bi ugodil lastnim ali zasebnim interesom ter se izogiba vsem dejanjem, ki bi lahko ustvarjala vtis, da so drugi v posebnem položaju, s katerega lahko vplivajo nanj.

en: An arbitrator may not allow financial, business, professional, family or social relationships or responsibilities to influence her or his conduct or judgement.
sl: Arbiter ne sme dovoliti, da bi finančni, poslovni, poklicni, družinski, zasebni ali družbeni odnosi ali odgovornosti vplivali na njegovo ravnanje ali odločanje.

en: An arbitrator must avoid entering into any relationship or acquiring any financial interest that is likely to affect her or his impartiality or that might reasonably create an appearance of impropriety or bias.
sl: Arbiter se mora izogibati vzpostavljanju razmerij ali pridobivanju finančnih interesov, ki lahko vplivajo na njegovo nepristranskost ali ki bi lahko ustvarjali vtis neprimernosti ali pristranskosti.

en: Obligations of former arbitrators
sl: Obveznosti nekdanjih arbitrov

en: All former arbitrators must avoid actions that may create the appearance that they were biased in carrying out their duties or derived advantage from the decision or ruling of the arbitration panel.
sl: Vsi nekdanji arbitri se morajo izogibati dejavnostim, ki lahko ustvarjajo vtis, da je bil arbiter pri opravljanju svojih dolžnosti pristranski ali da se je okoriščal z odločitvijo arbitražnega sveta.

en: No arbitrator or former arbitrator shall at any time disclose or use any non-public information concerning a proceeding or acquired during a proceeding except for the purposes of that proceeding and shall not, in any case, disclose or use any such information to gain personal advantage or advantage for others or to adversely affect the interest of others.
sl: Arbiter ali nekdanji arbiter nikdar ne razkrije ali uporabi informacij, ki niso javne in so povezane s postopkom ali pridobljene med postopkom, razen za namene tega postopka, in v nobenem primeru ne razkrije ali uporabi nobene takšne informacije za pridobitev osebnih koristi ali koristi za druge ali za škodovanje interesom drugih oseb.

en: An arbitrator shall not disclose an arbitration panel ruling or parts thereof prior to its publication in accordance with this Chapter.
sl: Arbiter ne razkrije odločitve arbitražnega sveta ali njenih delov pred objavo v skladu s tem poglavjem.

en: An arbitrator or former arbitrator shall not at any time disclose the deliberations of an arbitration panel, or any member's view.
sl: Arbiter ali nekdanji arbiter nikdar ne razkrije posvetovanj arbitražnega sveta ali stališča katerega koli člana.

en: Expenses
sl: Stroški

en: Each arbitrator shall keep a record and render a final account of the time devoted to the procedure and of her or his expenses as well as the time and expenses of her or his assistant.
sl: Vsak arbiter vodi evidenco in predloži končni obračun v zvezi s časom, ki ga je namenil postopku, in stroški, pa tudi v zvezi s časom in stroški svojega pomočnika.

en: Mediators
sl: Mediatorji

en: This Code of Conduct applies, mutatis mutandis, to mediators.
sl: Ta kodeks ravnanja se uporablja, mutatis mutandis, za mediatorje.

en: ANNEX 29-C
sl: PRILOGA 29-C

en: RULES OF PROCEDURE FOR MEDIATION
sl: PRAVILA O MEDIACIJI

en: Article 1
sl: Člen 1

en: Further to Article 29.5, the objective of this Annex is to facilitate the finding of a mutually agreed solution through a comprehensive and expeditious procedure with the assistance of a mediator.
sl: V skladu s členom 29.5. je cilj te priloge omogočiti iskanje sporazumnih rešitev z uporabo celovitega in hitrega postopka s pomočjo mediatorja.

en: Mediation proceeding
sl: Postopek mediacije

en: Article 2
sl: Člen 2

en: Initiation of the proceeding
sl: Začetek postopka

en: A Party may request, at any time, that the Parties enter into a mediation proceeding.
sl: Vsaka od pogodbenic lahko kadar koli zahteva, da pogodbenici začneta postopek mediacije.

en: Such request shall be addressed to the other Party in writing.
sl: Taka zahteva se v pisni obliki naslovi na drugo pogodbenico.

en: The request shall be sufficiently detailed to present clearly the concerns of the requesting Party and shall:
sl: Zahteva je dovolj podrobna, da jasno predstavlja pomisleke pogodbenice predlagateljice in navaja:

en: identify the specific measure at issue;
sl: zadevne sporne ukrepe;

en: provide a statement of the alleged adverse effects that the requesting Party believes the measure has, or will have, on trade or investment between the Parties; and
sl: domnevne negativne vplive, ki jih po mnenju pogodbenice predlagateljice ukrep ima ali bo imel na trgovino ali naložbe med pogodbenicama; in

en: explain how the requesting Party considers that those effects are linked to the measure.
sl: razlago, kakšna je po mnenju pogodbenice predlagateljice povezava med temi vplivi in ukrepom.

en: The mediation proceeding may only be initiated by mutual consent of the Parties.
sl: Postopek mediacije se lahko začne le na podlagi vzajemnega soglasja pogodbenic.

en: When a Party requests mediation pursuant to paragraph 1, the other Party shall give good faith consideration to the request and reply in writing within 10 days of receiving it.
sl: Kadar pogodbenica zahteva mediacijo v skladu z odstavkom 1, druga pogodbenica zahtevo preuči v dobri veri in v roku 10 dni od njenega prejetja odgovori nanjo v pisni obliki.

en: Article 3
sl: Člen 3

en: Selection of the mediator
sl: Izbor mediatorja

en: Upon the start of the mediation proceeding, the Parties shall agree on a mediator, if possible, no later than 15 days after the receipt of the reply to the request for mediation.
sl: Pogodbenici se ob začetku postopka mediacije najpozneje v 15 dneh po prejetju odgovora na zahtevo po mediaciji dogovorita o mediatorju.

en: A mediator shall not be a citizen of either Party, unless the Parties agree otherwise.
sl: Mediator ni državljan nobene od pogodbenic, razen če se pogodbenici dogovorita drugače.

en: The mediator shall assist, in an impartial and transparent manner, the Parties in bringing clarity to the measure and its possible trade effects, and in reaching a mutually agreed solution.
sl: Mediator nepristransko in pregledno pomaga pogodbenicama, da razjasnita ukrep in njegov morebitni vpliv na trgovino ter dosežeta sporazumno rešitev.

en: Further to paragraph 21 of Annex 29-B, the Code of Conduct of Arbitrators and Mediators applies to mediators.
sl: V skladu z odstavkom 21 Priloge 29-B se kodeks ravnanja arbitrov in mediatorjev uporablja za mediatorje.

en: Paragraphs 3 through 7 and 48 through 54 of the Rules of Procedure for Arbitration in Annex 29-A shall also apply, mutatis mutandis.
sl: Prav tako se uporabljajo, mutatis mutandis, odstavki od 3 do 7 in od 48 do 54 pravil o arbitraži iz Priloge 29-A.

en: Article 4
sl: Člen 4

en: Rules of procedure for mediation
sl: Pravila o mediaciji

en: Within 10 days after the appointment of the mediator, the Party requesting the mediation procedure shall present, in writing, a detailed description of the problem to the mediator and to the other Party, in particular of the operation of the measure at issue and its trade effects.
sl: V desetih dneh od imenovanja mediatorja pogodbenica, ki je zahtevala postopek mediacije, pisno predstavi podroben opis problema mediatorju in drugi pogodbenici, zlasti posledice spornega ukrepa in njegov vpliv na trgovino.

en: Within 20 days after the date of delivery of this submission, the other Party may provide, in writing, its comments to the description of the problem.
sl: V 20 dneh od datuma prejetja tega opisa lahko druga pogodbenica predloži pisne pripombe na opis problema.

en: Either Party may include in its description or comments any information that it deems relevant.
sl: Katera koli od pogodbenic lahko v svoj opis ali pripombe vključi katere koli informacije, ki se ji zdijo relevantne.

en: The mediator may decide on the most appropriate way of bringing clarity to the measure concerned and its possible trade-related impact.
sl: Mediator lahko določi najprimernejši način za razjasnitev zadevnega ukrepa in njegovega morebitnega vpliva na trgovino.

en: In particular, the mediator may organise meetings between the Parties, consult the Parties jointly or individually, seek the assistance of or consult with relevant experts [1] and stakeholders and provide any additional support requested by the Parties.
sl: Zlasti lahko mediator organizira srečanja med pogodbenicama, se z njima skupaj ali posamično posvetuje, za pomoč ali za nasvet zaprosi ustrezne strokovnjake [1] in zainteresirane strani ter zagotovi kakršno koli dodatno podporo, ki jo zahtevata pogodbenici.

en: However, before seeking the assistance of or consulting with relevant experts and stakeholders, the mediator shall consult with the Parties.
sl: Vendar se mediator pred naslovitvijo prošnje za pomoč ali nasvet na ustrezne strokovnjake in zainteresirane strani posvetuje s pogodbenicama.

en: The mediator may offer advice and propose a solution for the consideration of the Parties which may accept or reject the proposed solution or may agree on a different solution.
sl: Mediator lahko daje nasvete in predlaga rešitev glede pomislekov pogodbenic, ki lahko predlagano rešitev sprejmeta ali zavrneta ali pa se dogovorita o drugačni rešitvi.

en: However, the mediator may not advise or comment on the consistency of the measure at issue with this Agreement.
sl: Vendar mediator ne daje nasvetov ali pripomb glede skladnosti spornega ukrepa s tem sporazumom.

en: The procedure shall take place in the territory of the Party to which the request was addressed, or, by mutual consent of the Parties, in any other location or by any other means.
sl: Postopek se izvaja na ozemlju pogodbenice, na katero je bila zahteva naslovljena, ali na podlagi vzajemnega soglasja pogodbenic na kateri koli drugi lokaciji ali na kateri koli drug način.

en: The Parties shall endeavour to reach a mutually agreed solution within 60 days from the appointment of the mediator.
sl: Pogodbenici si prizadevata doseči sporazumno rešitev v 60 dneh od imenovanja mediatorja.

en: Pending a final agreement, the Parties may consider possible interim solutions, especially if the measure relates to perishable goods.
sl: Do sprejetja dokončnega dogovora lahko pogodbenici proučita morebitne vmesne rešitve, zlasti če se ukrep nanaša na pokvarljivo blago.

en: The solution may be adopted by means of a decision of the CETA Joint Committee.
sl: Rešitev se lahko sprejme s sklepom Skupnega odbora CETA.

en: Mutually agreed solutions shall be made publicly available.
sl: Sporazumne rešitve se javno objavijo.

en: However, the version disclosed to the public may not contain any information that a Party has designated as confidential.
sl: Vendar se morajo iz različice, ki se razkrije javnosti, odstraniti katere koli informacije, ki jih je posamezna pogodbenica označila kot zaupne.

en: On request of the Parties, the mediator shall issue to the Parties, in writing, a draft factual report, providing a brief summary of the measure at issue in the proceeding, the procedure followed and any mutually agreed solution reached as the final outcome of the proceeding, including possible interim solutions.
sl: Na zahtevo pogodbenic jima mediator predloži pisni osnutek poročila o dejanskem stanju, v katerega vključi kratek povzetek spornega ukrepa v tem postopku, postopka, ki se uporablja, ter kakršnih koli sporazumnih rešitev, ki so bile dosežene kot končni izid tega postopka, vključno z morebitnimi vmesnimi rešitvami.

en: The mediator shall provide the Parties 15 days to comment on the draft report.
sl: Mediator pogodbenicama omogoči, da v 15 dneh predložita pripombe na osnutek poročila.

en: After considering the comments of the Parties submitted within the period, the mediator shall submit, in writing, a final factual report to the Parties within 15 days.
sl: Po proučitvi pripomb, ki sta jih pogodbenici predložili v določenem roku, mediator pogodbenicama v 15 dneh predloži pisno končno poročilo o dejanskem stanju.

en: The factual report shall not include any interpretation of this Agreement.
sl: Poročilo o dejanskem stanju ne vsebuje nobene razlage tega sporazuma.

en: The proceeding shall be terminated:
sl: Postopek se konča:

en: by the adoption of a mutually agreed solution by the Parties, on the date of adoption.
sl: s sprejetjem sporazumne rešitve, dosežene med pogodbenicama na datum sprejetja;

en: by a written declaration of the mediator, after consulting with the Parties, that further efforts at mediation would be to no avail;
sl: s pisno izjavo mediatorja po posvetovanju s pogodbenicama, da nadaljnja prizadevanja v okviru mediacije ne bi bila koristna;

en: by a written declaration of a Party after exploring mutually agreed solutions under the mediation proceeding and after having considered any advice and proposed solutions by the mediator.
sl: s pisno izjavo ene pogodbenice po proučitvi sporazumnih rešitev v okviru postopka mediacije in po upoštevanju kakršnih koli nasvetov in predlogov mediatorja za rešitev.

en: Such declaration may not be issued before the period set out in Article 4.5 has expired; or
sl: Taka izjava ne sme biti objavljena pred iztekom obdobja, določenega v členu 4.5; ali

en: at any stage of the procedure by mutual agreement of the Parties.
sl: v kateri koli fazi postopka ob soglasju pogodbenic.

en: Implementation
sl: Izvajanje

en: Article 5
sl: Člen 5

en: Implementation of a mutually agreed solution
sl: Izvajanje sporazumne rešitve

en: Where the Parties have agreed to a solution, each Party shall take the measures necessary to implement the mutually agreed solution within the agreed timeframe.
sl: Če sta se pogodbenici dogovorili o rešitvi, vsaka pogodbenica sprejme potrebne ukrepe za izvedbo sporazumne rešitve v dogovorjenem roku.

en: The implementing Party shall inform the other Party in writing of any steps or measures taken to implement the mutually agreed solution.
sl: Pogodbenica, ki izvaja rešitev, pisno obvesti drugo pogodbenico o kakršnih koli postopkih ali ukrepih, ki jih je sprejela za izvedbo sporazumne rešitve.

en: SECTION C
sl: ODDELEK C

en: Article 6
sl: Člen 6

en: Confidentiality and relationship to dispute settlement
sl: Zaupnost in razmerje do reševanja sporov

en: Unless the Parties agree otherwise, and without prejudice to Article 4.6, all stages of the proceeding, including any advice or proposed solution, are confidential.
sl: Razen če se pogodbenici dogovorita drugače in brez poseganja v člen 4.6, so vse faze postopka, vključno s kakršnimi koli nasveti ali predlaganimi rešitvami, zaupne.

en: However, any Party may disclose to the public that mediation is taking place.
sl: Vendar lahko katera koli od pogodbenic javnosti razkrije, da se izvaja mediacija.

en: The obligation of confidentiality does not extend to factual information already existing in the public domain.
sl: Obveznost glede zaupnosti se ne širi na stvarne informacije, ki so že javno dostopne.

en: The mediation proceeding is without prejudice to the Parties' rights and obligations under the provisions on Dispute Settlement in this Agreement or any other agreement.
sl: Postopek mediacije ne posega v pravice in obveznosti, ki jih imata pogodbenici na podlagi določb o reševanju sporov v tem sporazumu ali katerem koli drugem sporazumu.

en: Consultations are not required before initiating the mediation proceeding.
sl: Pred začetkom postopka mediacije ni treba izvesti posvetovanj.

en: However, a Party should normally avail itself of the other relevant cooperation or consultation provisions in this Agreement before initiating the mediation proceeding.
sl: Vendar pa bi morala posamezna pogodbenica pred začetkom postopka mediacije upoštevati druge zadevne določbe o sodelovanju in posvetovanju iz tega sporazuma.

en: A Party shall not rely on or introduce as evidence in other dispute settlement proceedings under this Agreement or any other agreement, nor shall an arbitration panel take into consideration:
sl: Pogodbenica se ne zanaša na v nadaljevanju navedeno niti tega ne predlaga kot dokaz v drugih postopkih reševanja sporov iz tega sporazuma ali katerega koli sporazuma, prav tako arbitražni svet o navedenem ne presoja:

en: positions taken by the other Party in the course of the mediation proceeding or information gathered under Article 4.2;
sl: stališča, ki jih je zavzela druga pogodbenica v postopku mediacije ali informacije, ki so bile zbrane v skladu s členom 4,2;

en: the fact that the other Party has indicated its willingness to accept a solution to the measure subject to mediation; or
sl: dejstvo, da je druga pogodbenica pokazala pripravljenost, da sprejme rešitev za ukrep, ki je predmet mediacije; ali

en: advice given or proposals made by the mediator.
sl: nasvet ali predlogi mediatorja.

en: A mediator may not serve as a panellist in a dispute settlement proceeding under this Agreement or under the WTO Agreement involving the same matter for which she or he has been a mediator.
sl: Mediator ne sme biti član sveta v postopku reševanja sporov v okviru tega sporazuma ali Sporazuma STO, če je imel v isti zadevi vlogo mediatorja.

en: Article 7
sl: Člen 7

en: Time limits
sl: Roki

en: Any time limit referred to in this Annex may be modified by mutual consent between the Parties.
sl: Kakršen koli rok iz te priloge se lahko spremeni z vzajemnim soglasjem pogodbenic.

en: Article 8
sl: Člen 8

en: Costs
sl: Stroški

en: Each Party shall bear its costs of participation in the mediation proceeding.
sl: Vsaka pogodbenica nosi svoje stroške udeležbe v postopku mediacije.

en: The Parties shall share jointly and equally the costs of organisational matters, including the remuneration and expenses of the mediator.
sl: Organizacijske stroške, vključno s honorarjem in stroški za mediatorja, si pogodbenici enakopravno delita med sabo.

en: Remuneration of the mediator shall be in accordance with that of the chairperson of an arbitration panel in paragraph 8 of Annex 29-A.
sl: Honorar mediatorja se določi skladno s honorarjem, določenim za predsednika arbitražnega sveta v skladu z odstavkom 8 Priloge 29-A.

en: Article 9
sl: Člen 9

en: Review
sl: Pregled

en: Five years after the date of entry into force of this Agreement, the Parties shall consult each other on the need to modify the mediation mechanism in light of the experience gained and the development of any corresponding mechanism in the WTO.
sl: Pet let po začetku veljavnosti tega sporazuma se pogodbenici posvetujeta o potrebi po spremembi mehanizma mediacije glede na pridobljene izkušnje in razvoj kakršnega koli ustreznega mehanizma v okviru STO.

en: A Party may not object to an expert being consulted in a dispute settlement proceeding under this Chapter or under the WTO Agreement solely on the ground that the expert has been consulted under this paragraph.
sl: Pogodbenica ne sme nasprotovati posvetovanju s strokovnjakom v okviru postopka reševanja sporov v skladu s tem poglavjem ali Sporazumom STO zgolj na podlagi dejstva, da se je posvetovanje s strokovnjakom opravilo na podlagi tega odstavka.

en: ANNEX 30-A
sl: PRILOGA 30-A

en: LIST OF BILATERAL INVESTMENT TREATIES BETWEEN CANADA AND MEMBER STATES OF THE EUROPEAN UNION
sl: SEZNAM BILATERALNIH INVESTICIJSKIH SPORAZUMOV MED KANADO IN DRŽAVAMI ČLANICAMI EVROPSKE UNIJE

sl: Sporazum med vlado Republike Hrvaške in vlado Kanade o spodbujanju in zaščiti naložb, sklenjen 3. februarja 1997 v Ottawi.

sl: Sporazum med Češko republiko in Kanado o spodbujanju in zaščiti naložb, sklenjen 6. maja 2009 v Pragi.

sl: Sporazum med vlado Republike Madžarske in vlado Kanade o spodbujanju in medsebojni zaščiti naložb, sklenjen 3. oktobra 1991 v Ottawi.

en: Agreement between the Government of the Republic of Latvia and the Government of Canada for the Promotion and Protection of Investments, done at Riga on 5 May 2009.

sl: Izmenjava not med vlado Kanade in vlado Republike Malte, ki predstavlja sporazum v zvezi z zavarovanjem tujih naložb, sklenjen 24. maja 1982 v Valletti.

en: Agreement between the Government of the Republic of Poland and the Government of Canada for the Promotion and Reciprocal Protection of Investments, done at Warsaw on 6 April 1990.

en: Agreement between the Government of Romania and the Government of Canada for the Promotion and Reciprocal Protection of Investments, done at Bucharest on 8 May 2009.
sl: Sporazum med vlado Romunije in vlado Kanade o spodbujanju in medsebojni zaščiti naložb, sklenjen 8. maja 2009 v Bukarešti.

en: Agreement between the Slovak Republic and Canada for the Promotion and Protection of Investments, done at Bratislava on 20 July 2010.
sl: Sporazum med Slovaško republiko in Kanado o spodbujanju in zaščiti naložb, sklenjen 20. julija 2010 v Bratislavi.

en: ANNEX 30-B
sl: PRILOGA 30-B

en: AMENDMENTS TO THE 1989 ALCOHOLIC BEVERAGES AGREEMENT AND THE 2003 WINES AND SPIRIT DRINKS AGREEMENT
sl: SPREMEMBE SPORAZUMA O ALKOHOLNIH PIJAČAH IZ LETA 1989 IN SPORAZUMA O VINIH IN ŽGANIH PIJAČAH IZ LETA 2003

en: Article 1 of the 1989 Alcoholic Beverages Agreement, as amended by Annex VIII to the 2003 Wines and Spirit Drinks Agreement, shall have the following definition added:
sl: V členu 1 Sporazuma o alkoholnih pijačah iz leta 1989, kakor je bil spremenjen s Prilogo VIII k Sporazumu o vinih in žganih pijačah iz leta 2003 se doda naslednja opredelitev:

en: ‘“competent authority” means a government or commission, board or other governmental agency of a Party that is authorised by law to control the sale of wines and distilled spirits.’.
sl: „‚pristojni organ‘ pomeni vlado ali komisijo, odbor ali drugo vladno agencijo pogodbenice, ki je z zakonom pooblaščena za nadzor nad prodajo vin in destiliranih alkoholnih pijač.“

en: Article 2.2(b) of the 1989 Alcoholic Beverages Agreement, as amended by Annex VIII to the 2003 Wines and Spirit Drinks Agreement, is replaced with:
sl: Člen 2.2(b) Sporazuma o alkoholnih pijačah iz leta 1989, kakor je bil spremenjen s Prilogo VIII k Sporazumu o vinih in žganih pijačah iz leta 2003, se nadomesti z naslednjim:

en: requiring off site private wine store outlets in Ontario and British Columbia to sell only wines produced by Canadian wineries.
sl: zahtevajo, da dislocirane zasebne prodajalne vin v Ontariu in Britanski Kolumbiji prodajajo samo vina, ki jih pridelajo kanadske vinske kleti.

en: The number of these off site private wine store outlets authorised to sell only wines produced by Canadian wineries in these provinces shall not exceed 292 in Ontario and 60 in British Columbia.’.
sl: Število teh dislociranih zasebnih prodajaln vin, ki so pooblaščene, da prodajajo samo vina, ki jih pridelajo kanadske vinske kleti v navedenih provincah, ne sme preseči 292 v Ontariu in 60 v Britanski Kolumbiji.“

en: Article 4 of the 1989 Alcoholic Beverages Agreement, as amended by Annex VIII to the 2003 Wines and Spirit Drinks Agreement, is replaced with:
sl: Člen 4 Sporazuma o alkoholnih pijačah iz leta 1989, kakor je bil spremenjen s Prilogo VIII k Sporazumu o vinih in žganih pijačah iz leta 2003, se nadomesti z naslednjim:

en: ‘Article 4
sl: „Člen 4

en: Commercial Treatment
sl: Trgovinska obravnava

en: Competent authorities shall, in exercising their responsibilities for the purchase, distribution and retail sale of products of the other Party, adhere to the provisions of GATT Article XVII concerning State trading enterprises, in particular to make any such decisions solely in accordance with commercial considerations and shall afford the enterprises of the other Party adequate opportunity, in accordance with customary business practice, to compete for participation in such purchases.
sl: Pristojni organi pri izvajanju svojih dolžnosti glede nabave, razdeljevanja in prodaje na drobno s proizvodi druge pogodbenice upoštevajo določbe iz člena XVII sporazuma GATT, ki zadevajo državna trgovska podjetja, in zlasti da pri sprejemanju takšnih odločitev upoštevajo izključno trgovinski vidik, in priznajo podjetjem druge pogodbenice ustrezno možnost za sodelovanje pri takšni nabavi v skladu z običajno poslovno prakso.

en: Each Party shall take all possible measures to ensure that an enterprise that has been granted a monopoly in the trade and sale of wines and spirit drinks within its territory does not use its monopoly position to engage, either directly or indirectly, including through its dealings with its parent, subsidiaries or other enterprises with common ownership, in the sale of wine and spirit drinks in a market outside the territory where the enterprise has a monopoly position that causes an anti-competitive effect causing an appreciable restriction of competition in that market.’.
sl: Vsaka pogodbenica sprejme vse možne ukrepe za zagotovitev, da družba, ki ji je bil odobren monopol na področju trgovanja z vini in žganimi pijačami ter njihove prodaje na njenem ozemlju, svojega monopolnega položaja vključno prek poslovanja z matičnimi družbami, hčerinskimi družbami ali drugimi podjetji s skupnim lastništvom ne uporablja za neposredno ali posredno prodajo vin in žganih pijač na trgu zunaj ozemlja, kjer ima družba monopolni položaj, ki povzroča protikonkurenčni učinek in posledično znatno omejevanje konkurence na zadevnem trgu.“

en: SECTION D
sl: ODDELEK D

en: Article 4a of the 1989 Alcoholic Beverages Agreement, as amended by Annex VIII to the 2003 Wines and Spirit Drinks Agreement, is replaced with:
sl: Člen 4a Sporazuma o alkoholnih pijačah iz leta 1989, kakor je bil spremenjen s Prilogo VIII k Sporazumu o vinih in žganih pijačah iz leta 2003, se nadomesti z naslednjim:

en: Pricing
sl: Oblikovanje cen

en: Competent authorities of the Parties shall ensure that any mark-up, cost of service or other pricing measure is non-discriminatory, applies to all retail sales and is in conformity with Article 2.
sl: Pristojni organi pogodbenic zagotovijo, da so vsi pribitki, stroški za storitev ali drugi ukrepi za oblikovanje cen nepristranski, da veljajo za vso prodajo na drobno in so v skladu s členom 2.

en: A cost of service differential may be applied to products of the other Party only in so far as it is no greater than the additional costs necessarily associated with the marketing of products of the other Party, taking into account additional costs resulting from, inter alia, delivery methods and frequency.
sl: Razlika v stroških za storitev lahko velja za proizvode druge pogodbenice samo, če razlika ni večja od dodatnih stroškov, ki so nujno povezani s trženjem proizvodov druge pogodbenice, upoštevajoč dodatne stroške, ki so med drugim posledica načina in pogostosti dobave.

en: Each Party shall ensure that a cost of service is not applied to a product of the other Party on the basis of the value of the product.
sl: Vsaka pogodbenica zagotovi, da se strošek za storitev ne uporabi za proizvod druge pogodbenice na podlagi vrednosti proizvoda.

en: The cost of service differential shall be justified in line with standard accounting procedures by independent auditors on the basis of an audit completed on the request of the other Party within one year of the entry into force of the 2003 Wines and Spirit Drinks Agreement and thereafter on request of that Party at intervals of not less than four years.
sl: Razliko v stroških za storitev je treba utemeljiti skladno s standardnimi obračunskimi postopki, ki jih neodvisni revizorji uporabljajo pri reviziji, ki jo opravijo na zahtevo druge pogodbenice v enem letu po začetku veljavnosti Sporazuma o vinih in žganih pijačah iz leta 2003 in nato na zahtevo te pogodbenice v časovnih presledkih, ki niso krajši od štirih let.

en: The audits shall be made available to either Party within one year of a request being made.
sl: Te revizije bodo kateri koli pogodbenici na voljo v letu po oddani zahtevi.

en: Competent authorities shall update cost of service differential charges, as required, to reflect the commitment made in subparagraph 4a(2).
sl: Pristojni organi po potrebi posodobijo dajatve za razliko v stroških za storitev, da odražajo zavezo iz pododstavka 4a(2).

en: Competent authorities shall make available applicable cost of service differential charges through publicly accessible means, such as their official website.
sl: Pristojni organi s sredstvi, ki so javnosti dostopna, kot je na primer njihova uradna spletna stran, objavijo veljavne dajatve za razliko v stroških za storitev.

en: Competent authorities shall establish a contact point for questions and concerns originating from the other Party with respect to cost of service differential charges.
sl: Pristojni organi ustanovijo kontaktno točko za vprašanja in pomisleke, ki jih ima druga pogodbenica v zvezi z dajatvami za razliko v stroških za storitev.

en: A Party will respond to a request from the other Party in writing within 60 days of the receipt of the request.’.
sl: Pogodbenica se na zahtevo druge pogodbenice v pisni obliki odzove v 60 dneh od prejetja zahteve.“

en: SECTION E
sl: ODDELEK E

en: The 1989 Alcoholic Beverages Agreement, as amended by Annex VIII to the 2003 Wines and Spirit Drinks Agreement, is modified by adding Article 4b:
sl: Sporazum o alkoholnih pijačah iz leta 1989, kakor je bil spremenjen s Prilogo VIII k Sporazumu o vinih in žganih pijačah iz leta 2003 se spremeni, tako da se doda člen 4b:

en: ‘Article 4b
sl: „Člen 4b

en: Blending Requirements
sl: Zahteve glede mešanja

en: Neither Party may adopt or maintain any measure requiring that distilled spirits imported from the territory of the other Party for bottling be blended with any distilled spirits of the importing Party.’.
sl: Nobena od pogodbenic ne sme sprejeti ali ohranjati katerega koli ukrepa, v skladu s katerim je treba destilirane alkoholne pijače, ki so bile uvožene z ozemlja druge pogodbenice za ustekleničenje, mešati s kakršnimi koli destiliranimi alkoholnimi pijačami iz pogodbenice uvoznice.“

en: SECTION F
sl: ODDELEK F

en: The 2003 Wines and Spirit Drinks Agreement shall be amended as follows:
sl: Sporazum o vinih in žganih pijačah iz leta 2003 se spremeni, kot sledi v nadaljevanju:

en: Article 27.3 (Joint Committee), first indent, is replaced with ‘adopting amendments to the Annexes of this Agreement by means of a decision by the Joint Committee.’.
sl: prva alinea člena 27.3 (Skupni odbor) se nadomesti s „sprejetje sprememb v prilogah k temu sporazuma na podlagi sklepa skupnega odbora.“;

en: Title VIII (Dispute settlement) is deleted;
sl: naslov VIII (Reševanje sporov) se črta;

en: The last two sentences of Article 8.1 (Objection procedure) are replaced with ‘A Contracting Party may seek consultations as provided under Article 29.4 (Consultations) of the Canada-European Union Comprehensive Economic and Trade Agreement (“CETA”). If the consultations fail to resolve the matter, a Contracting Party may notify, in writing, the other Contracting Party of its decision to refer the issue to arbitration under Articles 29.6 through 29.10 of CETA.’.
sl: zadnja stavka člena 8.1 (Ugovorni postopek) se nadomestita z naslednjim: „Pogodbenica lahko zaprosi za posvetovanja, opredeljena v členu 29.4 (Posvetovanja) celovitega gospodarskega in trgovinskega sporazuma med Kanado in Evropsko unijo (CETA). Če s posvetovanji zadeve ni mogoče rešiti, lahko pogodbenica drugo pogodbenico v pisni obliki uradno obvesti o svoji odločitvi, da zadevo predloži v arbitražo v skladu s členi od 29.6 do 29.10 CETA.“;

en: The introductory wording (chapeau) of Article 9.2 (Modification of Annex I), is replaced with: ‘By way of derogation from paragraph 1, if a Contracting Party has invoked the objection procedure provided for in Article 8 (Objection procedure), the Contracting Parties shall act in accordance with the outcome of the consultations, unless the matter is referred to the arbitration procedure under Articles 29.6 through 29.10 of CETA, in which case:’.
sl: uvodno besedilo člena (chapeau) 9.2 (Sprememba Priloge I) se nadomesti z naslednjim: „Z odstopanjem od odstavka 1, v primeru da pogodbenica uveljavlja ugovorni postopek, opredeljen v členu 8 (Ugovorni postopek), pogodbenici upoštevata rezultat posvetovanj, razen kadar je vprašanje predloženo za obravnavo v arbitražnem postopku v skladu s členi od 29.6 do 29.10 CETA. V tem primeru:“;

en: A third paragraph is added to Article 9 (Modification of Annex I): ‘3. When Articles 29.6 through 29.10 of CETA are applied in the course of the procedure referred to in paragraph 2, they shall apply mutatis mutandis.’.
sl: členu 9 se doda tretji odstavek (Sprememba Priloge I): „3. členi od 29.6 do 29.10 CETA sporazuma se uporabljajo mutatis mutandis, kadar se uporabljajo v okviru postopka iz odstavka 2.“

en: ANNEX 30-C
sl: PRILOGA 30-C

en: JOINT DECLARATION ON WINES AND SPIRITS
sl: SKUPNA IZJAVA O VINIH IN ŽGANIH PIJAČAH

en: The Parties acknowledge the effort and progress that has been made on Wines and Spirits in the context of the negotiations of this Agreement.
sl: Pogodbenici priznavata prizadevanja in napredek, ki je bil dosežen na področju vin in žganih pijač v okviru pogajanj v zvezi s tem sporazumom.

en: These efforts have led to mutually agreed solutions on a number of issues of high importance.
sl: Ta prizadevanja so privedla do sporazumnih rešitev pri mnogih zelo pomembnih vprašanjih.

en: The Parties agree to discuss through the appropriate mechanisms, without delay and in view to find mutually agreed solutions, any other issue of concern related to Wines and Spirits, and notably the desire of the European Union to seek the elimination of the differentiation of provincial mark-ups applied on domestic wines and wines bottled in Canada in private wine outlets.
sl: Pogodbenici se strinjata, da bosta prek ustreznih mehanizmov nemudoma in z namenom iskanja sporazumnih rešitev razpravljali o katerem koli drugem vprašanju v zvezi z vini in žganimi pijačami, ki vzbuja zaskrbljenost, zlasti o želji Evropske unije po odpravi razlikovanja, kar zadeva pribitke na ravni provinc, ki se uporabljajo za domača vina in vina, ustekleničena v Kanadi, v zasebnih prodajalnah vin.

en: At the end of the fifth year following the entry into force of this Agreement, the Parties agree to review the progress made on the elimination of the differentiation referred to in the previous paragraph, based on the examination of all developments in the sector, including the consequences of any granting to third countries of a more favourable treatment in the framework of other trade negotiations involving Canada.
sl: Pogodbenici se strinjata, da bosta ob koncu petega leta po začetku veljavnosti tega sporazuma pregledali napredek, ki je bil dosežen pri odpravi razlikovanja iz prejšnjega odstavka, na podlagi preučitve razvoja vseh dogodkov v sektorju, vključno s posledicami katere koli odobritve ugodnejše obravnave tretjim državam v okviru drugih trgovinskih pogajanj, ki vključujejo Kanado.

en: ANNEX 30-D
sl: PRILOGA 30-D

en: JOINT DECLARATION OF THE PARTIES ON COUNTRIES THAT HAVE ESTABLISHED A CUSTOMS UNION WITH THE EUROPEAN UNION
sl: SKUPNA IZJAVA POGODBENIC O DRŽAVAH, KI SO Z EVROPSKO UNIJO VZPOSTAVILE CARINSKO UNIJO

en: The European Union recalls the obligations of the countries that have established a customs union with the European Union to align their trade regime to that of the European Union, and for certain of them, to conclude preferential agreements with countries that have preferential agreements with the European Union.
